equipment.name: Rusted Shortsword
equipment.ability1: Worn Edge — first attack each encounter gains +1 attack.
equipment.flavorText: Its blade is chipped and stained with rust, but in desperate hands it can still draw blood.

equipment.name: Iron Shortsword
equipment.ability1: Quick Strike — once per turn after defeating an Enemy, move 1 space/Location-equivalent without reactions.
equipment.flavorText: Balanced for speed rather than brute force, the iron shortsword is favored by scouts and skirmishers.

equipment.name: Iron Longsword
equipment.ability1: Parry — once per round when hit by melee attack, reduce damage by 1.
equipment.flavorText: The trusted weapon of soldiers and adventurers alike, built to endure years of hard fighting.

equipment.name: Steel Longsword
equipment.ability1: Riposte — once per round after successfully defending against melee attack, immediately make a free melee attack.
equipment.flavorText: Forged from superior steel, this blade is prized by knights for its balance and resilience.

equipment.name: Knight's Longsword
equipment.ability1: Defender of the Realm — while with at least one allied Hero, gain +1 armor.
equipment.ability2: Hold the Line — once per encounter, when allied Hero in your Location would suffer damage, you may become target instead.
equipment.flavorText: Forged for the kingdom's finest champions, every nick in its polished blade tells the story of a life defended.

equipment.name: Flaming Longsword
equipment.ability1: Blazing Strike — once each turn when you deal damage, deal +1 Fire Damage.
equipment.ability2: Ignite — once per encounter, after an Attack with this weapon deals 4 or more Damage to an Enemy, that Enemy gains Burning.
equipment.flavorText: Its blade burns without fuel, leaving trails of embers with every swing.

equipment.name: Vampiric Longsword
equipment.ability1: Life Drain — first time each turn you deal damage, recover 1 Health.
equipment.ability2: Blood Hunger — if target is defeated, gain +1 Attack until end of next turn.
equipment.flavorText: Forged through forbidden rituals, the blade thirsts for the life essence of those it strikes.

equipment.name: Dragonsteel Longsword
equipment.ability1: Dragon's Might — ignore 2 Armor when dealing damage.
equipment.ability2: Legendary Blade — once per encounter, when declaring an Attack with this weapon, declare Dragon Strike. That Attack gains +3 Attack and ignores all Armor.
equipment.flavorText: Forged in dragonfire and cooled in the blood of an ancient wyrm.

equipment.name: Defender's Bastard Sword
equipment.ability1: Versatile Grip — one-handed: +1 armor while shield equipped; two-handed: +1 Damage on melee attacks.
equipment.flavorText: A favorite of veteran mercenaries, equally effective behind a shield or wielded with both hands.

equipment.name: Duelist's Rapier
equipment.ability1: Precise Strike — once per turn, when attacking the only Enemy in your Location, gain +1 Attack.
equipment.ability2: Riposte Master — once per Round after a melee Enemy Attack against you resolves, you may spend 1 Action to make a Basic Attack against that Enemy if it is a legal target.
equipment.flavorText: Every thrust is measured. Every mistake is punished.

equipment.name: Greatsword of the Vanguard
equipment.ability1: Cleave — after defeating an Enemy in your Location, make one additional attack against another Enemy there.
equipment.ability2: Heavy Swing — cannot benefit from effects granting free Move Actions immediately before or after attacking.
equipment.flavorText: Built to break battle lines with a single devastating sweep.

equipment.name: Blade of Ascendance
equipment.ability1: Hero's Resolve — once per encounter, if reduced to 0 Health, remain at 1 instead.
equipment.ability2: Ascendant Strike — once per encounter, when declaring an Attack with this weapon, that Attack ignores all Armor and Resistance.
equipment.flavorText: Legends claim the first Hero wielded this blade to unite the realms against the darkness.

equipment.name: Woodcutter's Axe
equipment.ability1: Chopping Blow — when attacking an enemy adjacent to terrain/structure, deal +1 Damage.
equipment.flavorText: Built for timber, but just as capable of felling goblins.

equipment.name: Iron Hand Axe
equipment.ability1: Cleaving Edge — if you defeat an enemy, next attack this turn gains +1 Attack.
equipment.flavorText: Small enough to throw, deadly enough to keep.

equipment.name: Steel Battle Axe
equipment.ability1: Sundering Blow — first time you damage an enemy each encounter, reduce its Armor by 1 for rest of encounter.
equipment.flavorText: Every strike weakens armor until nothing remains but broken steel.

equipment.name: Berserker's Greataxe
equipment.ability1: Reckless Assault — before attack, suffer 1 damage to deal +2 Damage.
equipment.ability2: Heavy Weapon — cannot equip Shield.
equipment.flavorText: Those who wield it know only one direction—forward.

equipment.name: Executioner's Axe
equipment.ability1: Execution — against enemy at 25% Health or less, deal +3 Damage.
equipment.ability2: Terrifying Presence — first enemy defeated each encounter causes adjacent enemies to become Shaken.
equipment.flavorText: One swing ends the battle. The second is rarely needed.

equipment.name: Stormcleaver
equipment.ability1: Chain Lightning — once each turn after dealing damage, deal 1 Lightning Damage to different enemy in target's Location.
equipment.ability2: Thunder Crash — once per encounter after defeating enemy, nearby enemies become Staggered.
equipment.flavorText: Every strike echoes like thunder across the battlefield.

equipment.name: Bloodletter Axe
equipment.ability1: Deep Wounds — whenever you deal damage, target gains 1 Bleed Token.
equipment.ability2: Blood Frenzy — when attacking Bleeding enemy, gain +1 Attack.
equipment.flavorText: The crimson stains upon its blade never seem to dry.

equipment.name: Worldsplitter
equipment.ability1: Earthshatter — once per encounter, all enemies in your Location suffer 4 Physical Damage and become Knocked Down.
equipment.ability2: Titan's Strength — ignore Heavy penalty on two-handed weapons.
equipment.flavorText: Forged by the giants before the first kingdoms rose.

equipment.name: Iron Mace
equipment.ability1: Crushing Blow — ignore 1 Armor when attacking armored enemies.
equipment.flavorText: Simple, brutal, and effective against steel-clad foes.

equipment.name: Steel Warhammer
equipment.ability1: Concussive Strike — first enemy damaged each encounter becomes Staggered.
equipment.flavorText: Every swing rattles bones and dents armor alike.

equipment.name: Maul of the Mountain
equipment.ability1: Earthbreaker — after damaging enemy, may Push it 1 Location if legal.
equipment.ability2: Heavy Impact — if enemy cannot be pushed, it instead suffers +1 Damage.
equipment.flavorText: A weapon that strikes with the weight of a collapsing cliff.

equipment.name: Blessed Morningstar
equipment.ability1: Holy Strike — Undead and Demons suffer +2 Damage.
equipment.ability2: Divine Resolve — once per encounter after defeating Undead/Demon, recover 2 Health.
equipment.flavorText: Consecrated in sacred rites, its radiant spikes banish darkness with every blow.

equipment.name: Skullcrusher
equipment.ability1: Stunning Blow — once each turn after damage, target makes Stagger Save; failure becomes Stunned until end of next activation.
equipment.ability2: Heavy Swing — cannot benefit from effects granting free Move Actions before attacking.
equipment.flavorText: One clean strike is enough to end both the fight and the memory of it.

equipment.name: Hammer of Justice
equipment.ability1: Judgment — against Armor 3+, ignore all Armor.
equipment.ability2: Protector's Oath — allied Heroes in your Location gain +1 armor while you are not Exhausted.
equipment.flavorText: Its ringing impact reminds the wicked that justice always arrives.

equipment.name: Titan's Maul
equipment.ability1: Earthquake — once per encounter, all enemies in your Location and connected Locations suffer 3 Physical Damage and are Knocked Down.
equipment.ability2: Unstoppable — cannot be Pushed, Pulled, or Knocked Down while wielding.
equipment.flavorText: Forged for the champions of the ancient giants, every strike shakes the battlefield.

equipment.name: Relic of the First Forge
equipment.ability1: Forgefire — attacks deal +1 Fire Damage.
equipment.ability2: Master's Craft — at the start of an encounter choose +1 Attack, +1 armor, or Swift Craft. Swift Craft: once during each of your turns this encounter, perform 1 Move Action without spending an Action.
equipment.flavorText: The first master smith forged this hammer to shape kingdoms rather than destroy them.

equipment.name: Iron Spear
equipment.ability1: Long Reach — may attack enemies at your Location or a connected Location.
equipment.flavorText: Simple in design, deadly in disciplined hands.

equipment.name: Steel Spear
equipment.ability1: Brace — if an enemy moves into your Location from a connected Location, may immediately make a melee attack against it.
equipment.flavorText: The first line rarely survives without disciplined spear walls.

equipment.name: Pike of the Watch
equipment.ability1: Phalanx — while with another Hero wielding Spear/Polearm, both gain +1 armor.
equipment.ability2: Brace — enemies moving into your reach provoke an Opportunity Attack.
equipment.flavorText: Standing alone is bravery. Standing together is victory.

equipment.name: Halberd of the Vanguard
equipment.ability1: Sweeping Strike — once each turn after damaging enemy, deal 1 damage to another enemy in target's Location.
equipment.ability2: Hook — instead of damage, Pull target to your Location from connected Location if legal.
equipment.flavorText: An elegant fusion of axe, spear, and hook.

equipment.name: Dragon Lance
equipment.ability1: Charge — if move 2+ Locations before attacking, deal +2 Damage.
equipment.ability2: Skewer — once per turn, if this attack defeats an Enemy, you may immediately perform 1 Move Action without spending an Action, if legally able to Move.
equipment.flavorText: Forged for dragon hunters, every charge strikes with unstoppable force.

equipment.name: Trident of the Tides
equipment.ability1: Tidal Pull — once each turn after damaging enemy, Push or Pull it 1 Location if legal.
equipment.ability2: Flowing armor — if no enemies in your Location at end of turn, gain +1 armor until next turn.
equipment.flavorText: Blessed by the sea gods, it commands the ebb and flow of every battle.

equipment.name: Glaive of the Eclipse
equipment.ability1: Sweeping Arc — when attacking, may also deal 2 Damage to one other enemy in target's Location.
equipment.ability2: Zone of Control — an Enemy leaving your Location must spend 1 additional Movement.
equipment.flavorText: Its blade casts a shadow long before its wielder arrives.

equipment.name: Spear of the First King
equipment.ability1: Rally — allied Heroes in your Location gain +1 Attack while you are not Exhausted.
equipment.ability2: King's Command — once per encounter after your turn, one allied Hero in your Location may Move to connected Location and make one basic attack.
equipment.flavorText: Raised high during the founding of the first kingdom, this spear inspired ordinary soldiers to become legends.

equipment.name: Iron Dagger
equipment.ability1: Quick Draw — during first round, first attack gains +2 attack.
equipment.flavorText: Small enough to conceal, sharp enough to matter.

equipment.name: Steel Dagger
equipment.ability1: Backstab — if target shares Location with one of your allies, deal +2 Damage.
equipment.flavorText: A silent blade that strikes where armor offers no protection.

equipment.name: Assassin's Dirk
equipment.ability1: Critical Precision — the first Attack you make each turn against an Enemy that has a Status gains +1 Attack.
equipment.ability2: Silent Killer — if you defeat an enemy, immediately move up to 2 connected Locations as allowed.
equipment.flavorText: Its victims rarely realize they've been struck until it's too late.

equipment.name: Venomfang
equipment.ability1: Envenomed Blade — when you deal damage, target gains 1 Poison Token.
equipment.ability2: Toxic Wounds — Poisoned enemies suffer -1 armor.
equipment.flavorText: A single cut begins a slow and agonizing end.

equipment.name: Twinfang Blades
equipment.ability1: Twin Strike — once each turn after successful attack, make second attack against same target; second deals -1 Damage.
equipment.ability2: Flurry — if both attacks hit, you may immediately perform 1 Move Action without spending an Action, if legally able to Move.
equipment.flavorText: One blade distracts. The second finishes the job.

equipment.name: Shadowfang
equipment.ability1: Fade Away — after dealing damage, move up to 2 connected Locations as allowed without reactions.
equipment.ability2: Strike from Darkness — if target has not activated this round, deal +2 Damage.
equipment.flavorText: Its edge disappears into darkness moments before it finds its mark.

equipment.name: King's Mercy
equipment.ability1: Royal Execution — against enemies below 50% Health, attacks ignore all Armor.
equipment.ability2: Precise Finish — if this weapon defeats enemy, refresh one Hero Ability on cooldown.
equipment.flavorText: Carried by royal executioners, its purpose was swift justice without needless suffering.

equipment.name: Night's Whisper
equipment.ability1: Invisible Death — first attack each encounter automatically gains Advantage.
equipment.ability2: Death's Dance — once per encounter after defeating enemy, immediately take another full turn.
equipment.flavorText: No one remembers seeing the blade. They only remember the silence that followed.

equipment.name: Hunting Bow
equipment.ability1: Hunter's Eye — attacks against Beasts gain +1 Damage.
equipment.flavorText: Simple enough for the village hunter, deadly enough for the battlefield.

equipment.name: Longbow
equipment.ability1: Deadly Aim — if you did not Move this turn, gain +1 Attack.
equipment.flavorText: Patience turns every arrow into a certainty.

equipment.name: Elven Longbow
equipment.ability1: Graceful Shot — after attacking, move to a connected Location if legal.
equipment.ability2: Eagle Eye — ignore Cover when making ranged attacks.
equipment.flavorText: Its arrows fly as silently as the forests from which it came.

equipment.name: Recurve Bow
equipment.ability1: Rapid Shot — once each turn, make second ranged attack against a different target; second deals -1 Damage.
equipment.ability2: Mobile Archer — may move before attacking normally.
equipment.flavorText: Favored by mounted scouts and skirmishers, it delivers arrows with astonishing speed.

equipment.name: Storm Bow
equipment.ability1: Chain Shot — once each turn after damage, deal 1 Lightning Damage to another enemy in target's Location.
equipment.ability2: Static Charge — if same enemy is hit on consecutive turns, it becomes Staggered.
equipment.flavorText: Each arrow carries the fury of a gathering storm.

equipment.name: Phoenix Bow
equipment.ability1: Flaming Arrow — attacks deal +1 Fire Damage.
equipment.ability2: Rebirth — once per encounter if reduced to 0 Health, remain at 1.
equipment.flavorText: The flames upon its string never consume the bow—only its enemies.

equipment.name: Starfall Longbow
equipment.ability1: Falling Star — once per encounter, choose a Location within range; every enemy there suffers 4 Radiant Damage.
equipment.ability2: Celestial Aim — ignore all Cover and Line-of-Sight penalties.
equipment.flavorText: Forged from a fragment of a fallen star, its arrows never lose their way.

equipment.name: Bow of the World Tree
equipment.ability1: Living Arrow — start of turn choose Vine (Root target), Bloom (ally in target Location recovers 2 Health), or Thorn (+2 Damage).
equipment.ability2: Ancient Wisdom — +1 Range and +1 attack.
equipment.flavorText: Carved from the first branch of the World Tree, every arrow carries the will of the living forest.

equipment.name: Light Crossbow
equipment.ability1: Armor Piercer — ignore 1 Armor.
equipment.flavorText: Easy to master, difficult to survive.

equipment.name: Heavy Crossbow
equipment.ability1: Powerful Shot — ignore 2 Armor.
equipment.ability2: Reload — after attacking, cannot use again until spending 1 Action to reload.
equipment.flavorText: One bolt can punch through a knight's breastplate—but only if you have time to reload.

equipment.name: Repeating Crossbow
equipment.ability1: Rapid Fire — make two attacks against same or different targets; each deals -1 Damage.
equipment.ability2: Magazine — may use Rapid Fire for three attacks before reloading; reload costs 1 Action.
equipment.flavorText: Innovation transformed a cumbersome siege weapon into a storm of steel.

equipment.name: Sniper Crossbow
equipment.ability1: Deadeye — if you did not Move this turn, gain +2 attack.
equipment.ability2: Heartseeker — once per turn, if you did not Move this turn, an Attack with this weapon ignores 2 Armor.
equipment.flavorText: One bolt. One target. One outcome.

equipment.name: Explosive Crossbow
equipment.ability1: Explosive Bolt — target one enemy; normal damage; all other enemies in that Location suffer 2 Fire Damage.
equipment.ability2: Reload — after Explosive Bolt, reload before firing again.
equipment.flavorText: A single bolt can scatter an entire warband.

equipment.name: Arcane Ballista
equipment.ability1: Arcane Bolt — ignore all Armor and Magical Barriers.
equipment.ability2: Arcane Recharge — after attacking becomes Exhausted; readies automatically at start of next turn.
equipment.flavorText: More siege engine than crossbow, its enchanted limbs hurl bolts capable of piercing castle walls.

equipment.name: Dragonkiller Crossbow
equipment.ability1: Slayer Bolt — against Boss or Elite enemies, deal +3 Damage.
equipment.ability2: Crippling Shot — once per encounter, after an Attack with this weapon deals Damage, the target's Movement becomes 0 until the end of its next activation.
equipment.flavorText: Forged after the Dragon Wars, every mechanism exists for one purpose—to bring giants and monsters to their knees.

equipment.name: Heaven's Judgment
equipment.ability1: Divine Bolt — attacks ignore all Cover and Armor.
equipment.ability2: Judgment — once per encounter, when declaring an Attack with this weapon, declare Judgment. After that Attack deals Damage, the target cannot use Reactions until the end of its next activation and suffers +3 Radiant Damage.
equipment.flavorText: Its bolts shine like falling stars, delivering judgment with unerring precision.

equipment.name: Apprentice's Staff
equipment.ability1: Arcane Focus — the first Arcane Hero Deck card you play each encounter costs 1 fewer Action (minimum 0).
equipment.flavorText: Every archmage once carried a staff no more impressive than this.

equipment.name: Staff of Embers
equipment.ability1: Firebolt — basic attacks deal +1 Fire Damage.
equipment.ability2: Kindling Flame — enemies damaged by Fire abilities gain 1 Burn Token.
equipment.flavorText: Its crystal glows like a coal that never cools.

equipment.name: Staff of Frost
equipment.ability1: Frostbolt — basic attacks reduce target Movement by 1 until end of next activation.
equipment.ability2: Ice Prison — once per encounter when damaging with Cold ability, Root target until end of next activation.
equipment.flavorText: Winter follows wherever its bearer walks.

equipment.name: Stormcaller's Staff
equipment.ability1: Chain Lightning — first time each turn you deal Lightning damage, another enemy in target's Location suffers 1 Lightning Damage.
equipment.ability2: Charged Focus — after Lightning ability, gain +1 attack on next attack/spell this round.
equipment.flavorText: Thunder answers the call of those worthy enough to wield it.

equipment.name: Staff of Renewal
equipment.ability1: Healing Surge — whenever you restore Health to an ally, they recover +2 additional Health.
equipment.ability2: Blessed Aura — allied Heroes in your Location gain +1 Magic Resistance.
equipment.flavorText: Life flourishes wherever its crystal touches the earth.

equipment.name: Staff of the Ancient Grove
equipment.ability1: Grasping Vines — once each turn when damaging with Nature ability, may Root target.
equipment.ability2: Nature's Blessing — start of turn recover 1 Health if in natural terrain.
equipment.flavorText: Carved from the heartwood of an ancient tree that has witnessed the rise and fall of kingdoms.

equipment.name: Archmage's Staff
equipment.ability1: Arcane Mastery — the first Arcane Hero Deck card you play each round costs 1 fewer Action (minimum 0).
equipment.ability2: Spell Echo — once per encounter, after you resolve an Arcane Hero Deck card, you may play a different Arcane Hero Deck card from your hand with printed Action Cost 1 or less without spending an Action.
equipment.flavorText: The greatest mages never worried about running out of power—only how best to wield it.

equipment.name: Worldheart Staff
equipment.ability1: Harmony of Creation — start encounter choose Flame (+2 Fire Damage), Frost (Cold Slows), Storm (Lightning chains), or Life (+2 Healing).
equipment.ability2: Worldheart's Gift — once per encounter refresh one Ability on cooldown.
equipment.flavorText: It is said this staff contains a fragment of the world's first spark of magic.

equipment.name: Apprentice's Wand
equipment.ability1: Quick Cast — first spell each round gains +1 attack.
equipment.flavorText: Small enough for a novice, precise enough for a master.

equipment.name: Wand of Sparks
equipment.ability1: Arc Lightning — whenever you deal Lightning damage, one other enemy in target's Location suffers 1 Lightning Damage.
equipment.flavorText: Tiny arcs dance across its polished surface, eager for their next target.

equipment.name: Wand of Illusions
equipment.ability1: Mirror Image — once per encounter when targeted, force attacker to reroll attack.
equipment.ability2: Distracting Glamour — enemies damaged by Arcane abilities suffer -1 attack until end of next activation.
equipment.flavorText: Reality bends around its bearer, leaving enemies unsure of what is real.

equipment.name: Wand of Shadows
equipment.ability1: Shadow Step — after casting a spell, move to a connected Location without reactions.
equipment.ability2: Dark Hex — first enemy damaged each round suffers -1 armor until start of your next turn.
equipment.flavorText: It leaves no light behind—only silence.

equipment.name: Wand of Curses
equipment.ability1: Hex — first enemy damaged each round suffers one chosen effect until end of next activation: -2 Attack, -2 armor, or -2 Movement.
equipment.ability2: Lingering Curse — Bosses and Elites cannot ignore your debuffs.
equipment.flavorText: Every whispered incantation steals a little hope from its victim.

equipment.name: Wand of Time
equipment.ability1: Temporal Shift — once per encounter after any Hero finishes turn, choose: they immediately Move up to one connected Location, or make one basic Attack.
equipment.ability2: Accelerate — the first Arcane Hero Deck card you play each encounter costs 0 Actions.
equipment.flavorText: To its wielder, time is merely another spell waiting to be cast.

equipment.name: Wand of the Phoenix
equipment.ability1: Phoenix Flame — whenever Fire abilities deal damage, recover 1 Health.
equipment.ability2: Rebirth — once per campaign if defeated, discard this Equipment; recover to 50% Health, remove all negative Conditions, stand if Knocked Down.
equipment.flavorText: The phoenix dies only to rise stronger. Those worthy enough to wield this wand may do the same.

equipment.name: Scepter of Ascendance
equipment.ability1: Master of Magic — start encounter choose two Magic Schools; abilities from them gain +2 Damage or +2 Healing.
equipment.ability2: Arcane Conduit — once per round, after you resolve an Arcane Hero Deck card, you may play a different Arcane Hero Deck card from your hand with printed Action Cost 1 or less without spending an Action. Ascendant Will — immune to Silenced and Disarmed.
equipment.flavorText: The greatest relic ever forged, the Scepter of Ascendance is said to contain the first spark of creation itself.

equipment.name: Wooden Buckler
equipment.ability1: Quick Block — once per round reduce damage from one attack by 1.
equipment.flavorText: Crude, lightweight, and surprisingly dependable.

equipment.name: Iron Shield
equipment.ability1: Shield Wall — allied Heroes in your Location gain +1 armor against ranged attacks.
equipment.flavorText: A soldier's first line of defense.

equipment.name: Tower Shield
equipment.ability1: Fortress — cannot be Pushed or Knocked Down.
equipment.ability2: Cover — allied Heroes in your Location gain Cover against ranged attacks. Bulky — your first Move Action each turn costs 1 additional Action.
equipment.flavorText: An advancing wall of iron.

equipment.name: Spiked Shield
equipment.ability1: Shield Bash — once each turn after blocking attack, deal 1 Physical Damage to attacker.
equipment.ability2: Brutal Counter — if attacker is in your Location, may Push it to a connected Location if legal.
equipment.flavorText: Sometimes the best defense is striking back.

equipment.name: Padded Gambeson
equipment.ability1: Layered Padding — reduce the first Physical damage you suffer each round by 1.
equipment.flavorText: Quilted linen and wool turn aside cuts better than bare skin.
equipment.designNotes: Entry-level armor built for the auto-hit system.

equipment.name: Leather Jerkin
equipment.ability1: Flexible Fit — this Armor never increases the Action cost of your Move Actions.
equipment.flavorText: Supple hide protects without slowing the wearer.

equipment.name: Studded Leather
equipment.ability1: Reinforced — once per round when damage would be exactly 1, reduce it to 0.
equipment.flavorText: Iron studs reinforce every vulnerable seam.

equipment.name: Shadowleather Coat
equipment.ability1: Fade Away — after you defeat an Enemy, gain Hidden until you attack or become Engaged.
equipment.flavorText: Blackened leather seems to swallow torchlight.

equipment.name: Warden's Hide
equipment.ability1: Trailwise — ignore the first Hazard damage you would suffer each encounter.
equipment.ability2: Beast-Touched — +1 damage against Beasts.
equipment.flavorText: Hardened hide marked with the claw-signs of old wardens.

equipment.name: Chain Shirt
equipment.ability1: Reliable Mail — no additional effect.
equipment.flavorText: Thousands of linked rings distribute the force of a blow.

equipment.name: Scale Mail
equipment.ability1: Overlapping Plates — once per round reduce damage from a ranged Attack by 1.
equipment.flavorText: Metal scales overlap like the hide of a great reptile.

equipment.name: Goblinbreaker Mail
equipment.ability1: Goblinbreaker — Goblin Attacks against you suffer -1 Attack.
equipment.ability2: Stand Firm — you cannot be Pushed by Common Goblins.
equipment.flavorText: Built after the first raids, every plate is shaped to turn crude goblin blades.

equipment.name: Blessed Chain
equipment.ability1: Blessed Links — when you Rest, remove one additional harmful Condition.
equipment.ability2: Consecrated Guard — while in a Consecrated Location, gain +1 Armor.
equipment.flavorText: Each link bears a prayer hammered into the metal.

equipment.name: Stormwoven Mail
equipment.ability1: Grounded — reduce Lightning damage by 2.
equipment.ability2: Static Reprisal — first Enemy each round that damages you suffers 1 Lightning damage.
equipment.flavorText: Blue wire glows between its dark steel links.

equipment.name: Iron Plate
equipment.ability1: Heavy — you may perform no more than 2 Move Actions during your turn unless an effect specifically ignores Heavy Armor.
equipment.flavorText: Simple iron plate turns deadly strikes into bruises.

equipment.name: Knight's Plate
equipment.ability1: Protector — once per round when another Hero in your Location suffers damage, reduce that damage by 1.
equipment.ability2: Heavy — you may perform no more than 2 Move Actions during your turn unless an effect specifically ignores Heavy Armor.
equipment.flavorText: Polished plate carries the weight of duty as much as steel.

equipment.name: Fortress Plate
equipment.ability1: Immovable — you cannot be Pushed or Pulled.
equipment.ability2: Fortress — while Engaged with 2 or more Enemies, gain +1 Armor.
equipment.flavorText: A walking wall of layered steel.

equipment.name: Dragonhide Cuirass
equipment.ability1: Dragonhide — reduce Fire damage by 2.
equipment.ability2: Ancient Scales — once per encounter, when you would be defeated, remain at 1 Health instead.
equipment.flavorText: Scales taken from a creature that once ruled the mountains.

equipment.name: Robes of the Adept
equipment.ability1: Focused Mind — the first Arcane Hero card you play each round may ignore one negative modifier affecting its damage or healing.
equipment.flavorText: Plain robes stitched with careful arcane notation.

equipment.name: Runed Battlerobes
equipment.ability1: Runic Ward — once per round reduce damage from a Magical or elemental source by 2.
equipment.ability2: Arcane Thread — while in an Arcane Location, gain +1 Armor.
equipment.flavorText: Silver runes shimmer whenever danger draws near.

equipment.name: Amulet of Vigor
equipment.ability1: Vigor — increase Maximum Health by 2.
equipment.flavorText: A warm pulse answers every heartbeat.

equipment.name: Traveler's Charm
equipment.ability1: Sure Footing — once per Round, ignore the additional Move Action required to leave Difficult Terrain.
equipment.flavorText: A small token polished smooth by years on the road.

equipment.name: Band of Recovery
equipment.ability1: Second Wind — when you Rest, recover +1 Health.
equipment.flavorText: The ring grows warm whenever its bearer finally stops moving.

equipment.name: Scout's Compass
equipment.ability1: Pathfinder — once per round after entering a Location, you may look at the top card of the Encounter Deck and leave it or place it on the bottom.
equipment.flavorText: Its needle points toward trouble just often enough to be useful.

equipment.name: Goblin Fang Talisman
equipment.ability1: Trophy Hunter — the first Goblin you defeat each encounter grants +5 Gold.
equipment.flavorText: A crude fang bound in red cord has become a hunter's lucky charm.

equipment.name: Ring of Guarding
equipment.ability1: Guarding — gain +1 Armor while you have 5 or fewer Health.
equipment.flavorText: A thin silver ring that becomes impossibly heavy when danger closes in.

equipment.name: Lantern of True Paths
equipment.ability1: True Paths — once per Travel Encounter, after rolling Encounter Severity, reroll the die and keep either result.
equipment.flavorText: Its flame bends toward the safer road, though never the easiest.

equipment.name: Hunter's Quiver
equipment.ability1: Deep Quiver — your ranged Weapon gains +1 Weapon Bonus on the first Attack you make each round.
equipment.flavorText: Every arrow is fletched for a different kind of prey.

equipment.name: Consecrated Rosary
equipment.ability1: Prayer of Shelter — when you create or enter a Consecrated Location, recover 1 Health. Limit once per round.
equipment.flavorText: The beads are worn smooth by countless whispered prayers.

equipment.name: Arcane Lens
equipment.ability1: Arcane Focus — while in an Arcane Location, your damaging Hero cards gain +1 damage.
equipment.flavorText: Through the lens, magic appears as threads waiting to be pulled.

equipment.name: Belt of the Vanguard
equipment.ability1: Vanguard — after you Move into a Location containing an Enemy, your first Attack there gains +2 Attack.
equipment.flavorText: Its heavy buckle bears the crest of a forgotten expedition.

equipment.name: Cloak of Vanishing
equipment.ability1: Vanish — once per encounter after you suffer damage, gain Hidden and may move to a connected revealed Location if not prevented by a Scenario rule.
equipment.flavorText: It is easier to remember the cloak than the person wearing it.

equipment.name: Crown of Resolve
equipment.ability1: Unbroken — you are immune to Weakened.
equipment.ability2: Rallying Presence — once per encounter, all Heroes in your Location recover 2 Health.
equipment.flavorText: A battered circlet worn by commanders who refused to yield.

equipment.name: Relic of Ascendance
equipment.ability1: Ascendant Ward — gain +1 Armor.
equipment.ability2: Ascendant Will — once per round after you play a Hero card costing 2 Actions, recover 1 Action. This cannot raise you above 3 Actions.
equipment.flavorText: A fragment of power from an age before the kingdoms had names.

equipment.name: Militia Spear
equipment.ability1: Brace — if an Enemy moves into your Location during its activation, your next Attack against it gains +1 Attack.
equipment.flavorText: A simple ash shaft and iron point, made for walls of frightened defenders.

equipment.name: Goblin-Cleaver Falchion
equipment.ability1: Goblin Cleaver — when your Attack damages a Goblin, deal +1 damage.
equipment.flavorText: Its broad edge was designed for ugly work.

equipment.name: Watchtower Longbow
equipment.ability1: High Ground — while in a Location with Watchtower, Ridge, Cliff, or Tower traits, gain +1 Weapon Bonus.
equipment.flavorText: A tall bow built for sentries who see danger before it arrives.

equipment.name: Warg-Hunter Crossbow
equipment.ability1: Beast Bolt — your Attacks ignore 1 Armor against Beasts.
equipment.ability2: Slow Reload — after attacking twice in the same turn, you cannot make another Attack that turn.
equipment.flavorText: Heavy bolts strike with enough force to stagger a charging warg.

equipment.name: Sunhammer
equipment.ability1: Radiant Impact — the first time each round you damage an Enemy, remove Guarded from it if present.
equipment.ability2: Consecrated Blow — while in a Consecrated Location, deal +1 damage.
equipment.flavorText: A golden hammer that rings like a chapel bell.

equipment.name: Arcane Channeling Staff
equipment.ability1: Channel — once per Round, when a damaging Hero Card uses your Weapon Bonus, that Attack gains +1 Attack.
equipment.ability2: Arcane Location — while in an Arcane Location, Channel grants +2 Attack instead of +1.
equipment.flavorText: Runes crawl along the staff whenever its bearer begins a spell.
equipment.designNotes: Automatic-hit caster weapon; once-per-Round Hero-card channel bonus, enhanced in Arcane Locations.

equipment.name: Captain's Warblade
equipment.ability1: Commanding Strike — after you defeat an Enemy, one allied Hero in your Location may move to a connected revealed Location.
equipment.ability2: Hold Formation — while another Hero is in your Location, gain +1 Armor.
equipment.flavorText: The blade was forged to be seen above a battle line.

equipment.name: Nightglass Daggers
equipment.ability1: Opening Cut — if you began the turn Hidden, your first Attack gains +3 Attack.
equipment.ability2: Fade — after defeating an isolated Enemy, gain Hidden.
equipment.flavorText: Black glass edges leave wounds before the victim sees the blade.

equipment.name: Ashen Wardblade
equipment.ability1: Cinder Edge — ignore 1 Armor.
equipment.ability2: Last Ember — once per encounter, after you suffer damage that leaves you at half your Maximum Health or less, your next Attack before the end of your next turn gains +3 Attack.
equipment.flavorText: The sword burns brightest when hope is nearly gone.
equipment.designNotes: Automatic-hit legendary martial weapon; comeback burst when damage leaves the wielder at half Health or less.

equipment.name: Starfall Staff
equipment.ability1: Starfall — once per encounter choose a Location within Range; each Enemy there suffers 1d6 + your Weapon Bonus, reduced by its Armor.
equipment.ability2: Afterglow — create an Arcane Location there until the end of the next round.
equipment.flavorText: A sliver of night sky is trapped beneath its crystal crown.

equipment.name: Ember Wand
equipment.ability1: Kindled Focus — once per Round, the first Fire Hero card you play that deals damage gains +1 damage.
equipment.flavorText: A copper-capped wand that stays warm even in winter.
equipment.designNotes: Starter offensive caster weapon; Fire specialization.

equipment.name: Storm Wand
equipment.ability1: Static Focus — once per Round, after you damage an Enemy with a Lightning Hero card, another Enemy in that Location suffers 1 Lightning damage.
equipment.flavorText: Blue sparks crawl across its ironwood grip when a storm approaches.
equipment.designNotes: Starter offensive caster weapon; chain-damage identity.

equipment.name: Hexwood Wand
equipment.ability1: Hex Focus — once per Round, your first Attack against an Enemy with a negative Status Effect gains +1 Attack.
equipment.flavorText: Dark knots in the wood seem to twist whenever a curse is spoken.

equipment.name: Oak Quarterstaff
equipment.ability1: Rooted Stance — if you did not Move this turn, your first melee Attack gains +1 Attack.
equipment.flavorText: A straight length of seasoned oak, simple enough to overlook and sturdy enough not to.

equipment.name: Initiate's Scepter
equipment.ability1: Guiding Light — once per Round after you damage an Enemy, the next allied Hero to Attack that Enemy this Round gains +1 Attack.
equipment.flavorText: A small silver head catches light even in a darkened chapel.

equipment.name: Hunter's Shortbow
equipment.ability1: Skirmish Shot — once per Round, if you Moved before this Attack, gain +1 Attack.
equipment.flavorText: Short limbs make it easy to draw while moving through brush and ruins.

equipment.name: Longbow
equipment.ability1: Steady Aim — if you did not Move this turn, your first Attack gains +1 Attack.
equipment.flavorText: A tall yew bow built for deliberate shots across open ground.

equipment.name: Scout's Crossbow
equipment.ability1: Prepared Bolt — the first Attack you make each encounter ignores 1 Armor.
equipment.flavorText: A light field crossbow kept loaded for the first sign of trouble.

equipment.name: Iron Greatsword
equipment.ability1: Heavy Weapon — you cannot equip a Shield while this weapon is equipped.
equipment.flavorText: A broad iron blade with no ornament beyond the marks of the forge.

equipment.name: Raider's Greataxe
equipment.ability1: Desperate Swing — while at half your Maximum Health or less, your first Attack each turn gains +1 Attack.
equipment.ability2: Heavy Weapon — you cannot equip a Shield while this weapon is equipped.
equipment.flavorText: A brutal axe balanced for commitment rather than caution.

equipment.name: Smith's Hammer
equipment.ability1: Crushing Weight — your first Attack each encounter against an Enemy with Armor 2 or higher ignores 1 Armor.
equipment.flavorText: A forge hammer given a leather-wrapped grip and pressed into battlefield service.

equipment.name: Fighting Spear
equipment.ability1: Keep Back — once per Round after you damage an Enemy that entered your Location this Round, you may Push it to a connected revealed Location if legal.
equipment.flavorText: A short fighting spear made for keeping claws and blades at arm's length.

equipment.name: Duelist's Foil
equipment.ability1: Single Combat — once per Round, if exactly one Enemy is in your Location, your first Attack against it gains +1 Attack.
equipment.flavorText: Light, narrow, and unforgiving of sloppy footwork.

equipment.name: Balanced Daggers
equipment.ability1: Opening Cut — once per Round, your first Attack against an Enemy with no other Hero in its Location gains +1 Attack.
equipment.flavorText: A matched pair weighted to leave either hand free to lead.

equipment.name: Initiate's Robes
equipment.ability1: Spellguard — once per Round, reduce damage you suffer from a Magical or elemental source by 1.
equipment.flavorText: Plain layered cloth reinforced with small protective sigils.

equipment.name: Channeler's Robes
equipment.ability1: Open Channel — once per Round, your first damaging Hero card with Range gains +1 Attack.
equipment.flavorText: Loose sleeves and stitched focus-lines leave the hands free for spellwork.

equipment.name: Hardened Hide
equipment.ability1: Weathered — once per Round, reduce damage from an Environmental Hazard or Beast by 1.
equipment.flavorText: Boiled hide plates overlap across the chest and shoulders.

equipment.name: Brigandine Vest
equipment.ability1: Close Guard — the first time each encounter an Enemy enters your Location, gain +1 Armor against that Enemy's next Attack this Round.
equipment.flavorText: Small iron plates are riveted beneath a heavy cloth coat.

equipment.name: Apprentice Focus
equipment.ability1: Focused Casting — once per Round, your first damaging Arcane Hero card gains +1 Attack.
equipment.flavorText: A thumb-sized crystal held in a plain brass cage.

equipment.name: Ember Charm
equipment.ability1: Heat Sink — once per Round, when one of your own effects would cause you to suffer damage, reduce that damage by 1.
equipment.flavorText: A blackened stone that drinks heat from the palm.

equipment.name: Carved Totem
equipment.ability1: Spirit Mark — once per Round after you apply a Status Effect to an Enemy, gain +1 Attack on your next Attack against that Enemy this Round.
equipment.flavorText: Animal shapes overlap across the little wooden token as if carved by many hands.

equipment.name: Pilgrim's Holy Symbol
equipment.ability1: Steadfast Prayer — once per Round when you restore Health to another Hero, that Hero gains +1 Armor against the next source of damage this Round.
equipment.flavorText: A simple symbol worn smooth by travel and prayer.

equipment.name: Duelist's Token
equipment.ability1: Tempo — once per Round after you Move, your next melee Attack that turn gains +1 Attack.
equipment.flavorText: A pierced coin passed between fencing schools as proof of a completed challenge.

equipment.name: Field Toolkit
equipment.ability1: Prepared Hands — once per Round, when you use an Equipment or Hero card effect that places, repairs, or interacts with a device or object, reduce its Action Cost by 1, minimum 0.
equipment.flavorText: Pliers, wire, chalk, wedges, and a dozen tiny tools fit into a battered leather roll.

loot.name: Minor Healing Potion
loot.effect: Recover 2 Health; discard.
loot.flavorText: A small red vial that closes shallow wounds almost instantly.

loot.name: Healing Potion
loot.effect: Recover 4 Health; discard.
loot.flavorText: A dependable restorative carried by adventurers throughout the frontier.

loot.name: Greater Healing Potion
loot.effect: Recover 6 Health; discard.
loot.flavorText: The thick crimson liquid leaves warmth spreading through every injured limb.

loot.name: Bandage Roll
loot.effect: Remove Bleeding from a Hero at your Location; discard.
loot.flavorText: Clean cloth is sometimes more valuable than steel.

loot.name: Antidote
loot.effect: Remove Poisoned from a Hero at your Location; discard.
loot.flavorText: Bitter enough to make the poison seem pleasant by comparison.

loot.name: Burn Salve
loot.effect: Remove Burning from a Hero at your Location; discard.
loot.flavorText: A cooling paste packed in a wax-sealed clay jar.

loot.name: Restorative Tonic
loot.effect: Remove Weakened from a Hero and recover 1 Health; discard.
loot.flavorText: The tonic tastes terrible, which the brewer insists proves it works.

loot.name: Smelling Salts
loot.effect: Remove Stunned from a Hero at your Location; discard.
loot.flavorText: One sharp breath is enough to drag the senses back into focus.

loot.name: Focus Tonic
loot.effect: Gain Inspired until the end of your next turn; discard.
loot.flavorText: For a few moments every sound sharpens and every movement becomes deliberate.

loot.name: Guarding Draught
loot.effect: Gain Guard; discard.
loot.flavorText: A metallic tonic favored by caravan guards before a dangerous crossing.

loot.name: Stamina Draught
loot.effect: Gain 1 Action this turn; discard.
loot.flavorText: The rush is brief, but sometimes one more action is all that matters.

loot.name: Traveler's Rations
loot.effect: When you Rest, recover 1 additional Health; discard after resolving the Rest.
loot.flavorText: Dried meat, hard bread, and enough salt to survive a week.

loot.name: Herbal Poultice
loot.effect: Recover 1 Health and remove Bleeding; discard.
loot.flavorText: Crushed leaves wrapped beneath linen stop the bleeding surprisingly well.

loot.name: Purifying Herbs
loot.effect: Choose Poisoned or Burning; remove that Condition from a Hero at your Location; discard.
loot.flavorText: The sharp-smelling bundle is prized by hunters and healers alike.

loot.name: Smoke Bomb
loot.effect: Choose your Location. Until the end of the turn, Heroes there may voluntarily Move while Engaged; discard.
loot.flavorText: Gray smoke floods the area before anyone can react.

loot.name: Fire Flask
loot.effect: Choose an enemy at your Location or a connected Location. It suffers 2 damage and gains Burning; discard.
loot.flavorText: Oil and resin turn a simple bottle into a frightening weapon.

loot.name: Frost Flask
loot.effect: Choose an enemy at your Location or a connected Location. It gains Slowed until the end of its next activation; discard.
loot.flavorText: Ice forms across the glass even beside a warm fire.

loot.name: Thunderstone
loot.effect: Choose an enemy at your Location. It gains Stunned; discard.
loot.flavorText: The stone cracks like thunder when it strikes the ground.

loot.name: Throwing Knife
loot.effect: Choose an enemy at your Location or a connected Location. It suffers 2 damage; discard.
loot.flavorText: Balanced for one purpose and rarely recovered afterward.

loot.name: Heavy Throwing Axe
loot.effect: Choose an enemy at your Location. It suffers 3 damage; discard.
loot.flavorText: Too heavy for subtlety, but subtlety is not always required.

loot.name: Caltrops
loot.effect: Place a Caltrops token at your Location. The next enemy that enters suffers 1 damage and ends its movement; then remove the token.
loot.flavorText: A handful of sharpened iron can control an entire passage.

loot.name: Hunting Trap
loot.effect: Place a Trap token at your Location. The next enemy that enters gains Rooted until the end of its activation; then remove the token.
loot.flavorText: A steel jaw hidden beneath leaves rewards careless pursuit.

loot.name: Torch
loot.effect: Ignore one Dark or visibility restriction affecting you until the end of the round; discard.
loot.flavorText: A little light goes a long way underground.

loot.name: Lantern Oil
loot.effect: Choose: extend a Torch effect through the end of your next turn, or remove Burning from a Location/object if the effect can reasonably be extinguished; discard.
loot.flavorText: Useful for light, fire, and occasionally putting one out.

loot.name: Rope & Grapnel
loot.effect: Move to one connected revealed Location. Ignore Difficult Terrain, climbing, rubble, and similar terrain-based movement restrictions during this movement. Discard.
loot.flavorText: A length of good rope solves more problems than most weapons.

loot.name: Lockpick Set
loot.effect: Bypass one Locked or simple Trap restriction at your Location without paying its additional Action cost. Then immediately perform the associated Interact or Search without spending an additional Action. Discard.
loot.flavorText: Thin steel picks wrapped in soft leather for quiet work.

loot.name: Scout's Kit
loot.effect: When you Explore, draw 2 valid Exploration cards. Choose 1 to resolve and discard the other; discard this card after use.
loot.flavorText: Charcoal, cord, markers, and a small lens help turn searching into method.

loot.name: Whetstone
loot.effect: Choose your equipped Weapon. It gains +1 Weapon for your next Attack this turn; discard.
loot.flavorText: A few practiced strokes can make an old edge dangerous again.

loot.name: Emergency Supplies
loot.effect: Recover 2 Health and draw 1 Hero card; discard.
loot.flavorText: A compact bundle assembled for exactly the moment everything goes wrong.

loot.name: Phoenix Ash
loot.effect: Remove all negative Conditions from one Hero and recover 3 Health; discard.
loot.flavorText: The warm ash glows briefly when scattered over the wounded.

loot.name: Iron Ore
loot.effect: Raw metal used by Blacksmithing. Combine with Coal or Refined Iron in basic metal recipes.
loot.flavorText: Heavy red-brown ore streaked with metallic gray.

loot.name: Copper Ore
loot.effect: Raw metal used for fittings, traps, tools, and low-tier weapon components.
loot.flavorText: Soft reddish ore that works easily beneath a hammer.

loot.name: Tin Ore
loot.usedBy: Blacksmithing — bronze fittings and utility gear
loot.effect: Combine with Copper Ore in bronze recipes or use for light metal fittings.
loot.flavorText: Pale ore valued less for strength than for what it becomes when alloyed.

loot.name: Coal
loot.effect: Fuel for Forge recipes and an ingredient in fire-based alchemy.
loot.flavorText: Black stone that burns hotter than ordinary wood.

loot.name: Silver Ore
loot.usedBy: Blacksmithing; Enchanting — silvered weapons, holy gear
loot.effect: Refine for silvered weapon and sacred crafting recipes.
loot.flavorText: Bright veins glimmer even beneath cave dust.

loot.name: Gold Ore
loot.effect: Refine for jewelry, enchantment settings, and valuable ceremonial items.
loot.flavorText: Dense yellow ore prized by merchants and enchanters alike.

loot.name: Mythril Ore
loot.usedBy: Legendary Blacksmithing — light armor, elite weapons
loot.effect: Rare metal used in high-tier weapons and armor; counts as a Rare Metal component.
loot.flavorText: Silvery-blue ore that feels far lighter than it should.

loot.name: Refined Iron
loot.effect: Processed iron ready for use in forged Equipment recipes.
loot.flavorText: A clean bar of iron waiting for a smith's hammer.

loot.name: Steel Ingot
loot.usedBy: Blacksmithing — reinforced weapons and heavy armor
loot.effect: Used in reinforced weapons, heavy armor, shields, and durable tools.
loot.flavorText: Dark steel rings sharply when struck.

loot.name: Obsidian Chunk
loot.effect: Used for edged weapons, fire-resistant fittings, and arcane components.
loot.flavorText: Volcanic glass with an edge sharper than common steel.

loot.name: Oak Timber
loot.effect: Sturdy wood used for weapon hafts, shields, and structural crafting.
loot.flavorText: Straight-grained oak cut from mature frontier trees.

loot.name: Pine Lumber
loot.usedBy: Woodworking; Campcraft — basic structures and supplies
loot.effect: Common construction wood used in campcraft, traps, and utility recipes.
loot.flavorText: Light, resinous boards that are easy to shape.

loot.name: Hardwood Plank
loot.effect: Dense hardwood used for stronger bows, shields, and reinforced equipment.
loot.flavorText: The plank resists both bending and splitting.

loot.name: Yew Branch
loot.effect: Flexible wood prized for high-quality ranged weapon recipes.
loot.flavorText: A naturally curved branch perfect for a bowyer's hands.

loot.name: Ancient Bark
loot.effect: Rare nature component used in protective wards and restorative recipes.
loot.flavorText: The bark smells faintly of rain even when completely dry.

loot.name: Ironwood Log
loot.usedBy: Woodworking; Blacksmithing — reinforced hafts and shields
loot.effect: Counts as both Wood and Reinforcement for appropriate crafting recipes.
loot.flavorText: Wood so dense that axes spark when they strike it.

loot.name: Flexible Reed
loot.effect: Used in arrows, snares, light tools, and campcraft recipes.
loot.flavorText: Simple reeds become surprisingly useful in skilled hands.

loot.name: Resin Clump
loot.effect: Sticky resin used for adhesives, fire mixtures, and waterproofing.
loot.flavorText: Amber resin clings stubbornly to anything it touches.

loot.name: Leather Hide
loot.effect: Basic hide used in leather armor, straps, packs, and utility gear.
loot.flavorText: A cleaned hide ready for tanning.

loot.name: Thick Hide
loot.effect: Heavy hide used in durable armor and reinforced equipment.
loot.flavorText: Scarred hide thick enough to turn a glancing blade.

loot.name: Fine Leather
loot.effect: High-quality leather used in advanced armor and accessories.
loot.flavorText: Supple, carefully tanned leather without a visible flaw.

loot.name: Linen Cloth
loot.usedBy: Tailoring; Alchemy — bandages, clothing, potion wraps
loot.effect: Common cloth used in tailoring, bandages, and utility crafting.
loot.flavorText: Plain woven linen—simple, clean, and endlessly useful.

loot.name: Wool Cloth
loot.effect: Warm cloth used for cloaks, padding, and camp supplies.
loot.flavorText: Coarse wool made for cold nights rather than noble halls.

loot.name: Spider Silk
loot.effect: Exceptionally strong fiber used in advanced cloth and lightweight armor.
loot.flavorText: Silken strands stronger than cord and lighter than linen.

loot.name: Moonleaf
loot.effect: Restorative herb used in healing and recovery recipes.
loot.flavorText: Silver-edged leaves curl toward moonlight after dusk.

loot.name: Kingsroot
loot.effect: Medicinal root used to cleanse toxins and strengthen restorative mixtures.
loot.flavorText: A bitter golden root treasured by frontier healers.

loot.name: Glow Moss
loot.usedBy: Alchemy; Enchanting — light and vision effects
loot.effect: Luminescent moss used in light-producing and visibility recipes.
loot.flavorText: Blue-green moss that glows long after being scraped from stone.

loot.name: Bloodflower
loot.effect: Potent alchemical flower used in offensive and restorative mixtures.
loot.flavorText: Its dark petals stain the fingers crimson.

loot.name: Sun Blossom
loot.effect: Bright herb used in purification and protective elixirs.
loot.flavorText: The flower remains warm even after sunset.

loot.name: Nightshade
loot.effect: Toxic herb used in poison, weakening, and stealth mixtures.
loot.flavorText: Beautiful purple berries conceal a dangerous bitterness.

loot.name: Crystal Shard
loot.effect: Arcane crystal used to hold simple enchantments and magical charges.
loot.flavorText: Light fractures into tiny rainbows along its sharp edges.

loot.name: Mana Crystal
loot.effect: A concentrated arcane component used in high-tier enchantments.
loot.flavorText: The crystal vibrates faintly when magic is nearby.

loot.name: Runestone Fragment
loot.effect: Piece of an inscribed stone used for runic enchantments and ancient mechanisms.
loot.flavorText: Only half a rune remains, yet it still hums with power.

loot.name: Enchanted Dust
loot.usedBy: Enchanting — magical upgrades and relic work
loot.effect: Fine magical residue used to bind enchantments to equipment.
loot.flavorText: The dust refuses to settle on ordinary surfaces.

loot.name: Arcane Resin
loot.usedBy: Enchanting; Alchemy — magical coatings and bombs
loot.effect: Sticky magical binder used in enchanted weapon coatings and alchemical devices.
loot.flavorText: The translucent resin glows when spread thin.

loot.name: Void Crystal
loot.usedBy: Legendary Enchanting — shadow and control effects
loot.effect: Extremely rare component used only in Epic or Legendary enchantments.
loot.flavorText: A black crystal that seems to swallow nearby light.

loot.name: Aether Bloom
loot.usedBy: Alchemy; Enchanting — movement and free-action effects
loot.effect: Rare flower used in mobility, ethereal, and action-enhancing recipes.
loot.flavorText: Its translucent petals drift as if untouched by gravity.

loot.name: Spirit Essence
loot.effect: Spiritual reagent used in holy, warding, and relic recipes.
loot.flavorText: A pale light swirls inside the sealed vial.

loot.name: Runic Ink
loot.usedBy: Enchanting; Scrollcraft — runes and magical inscriptions
loot.effect: Special ink required for permanent runes, scrolls, and sigils.
loot.flavorText: The ink settles into symbols before the quill finishes moving.

loot.name: Blessed Silver
loot.usedBy: Sacred Blacksmithing; Enchanting — holy weapons and wards
loot.effect: Consecrated metal used against corrupted, cursed, and unholy threats.
loot.flavorText: The polished silver remains warm in the presence of darkness.

loot.name: Goblin Ear
loot.effect: Proof of a Goblin kill. Used by bounty quests and a few crude alchemical recipes.
loot.flavorText: A grisly but unmistakable token of a defeated goblin.

loot.name: Goblin Tooth
loot.effect: Used in low-tier trinkets, charms, and intimidation-themed recipes.
loot.flavorText: Small, sharp, and usually in worse condition than the goblin it came from.

loot.name: Goblin Banner Scrap
loot.effect: Can be turned in as evidence of disrupting Goblin forces or used in trophy crafting.
loot.flavorText: Smoke-blackened cloth marked with a crude clan symbol.

loot.name: Goblin Iron Token
loot.effect: A stamped command token accepted by certain quest givers as proof of an Elite kill.
loot.flavorText: The crude iron disc bears the mark of a higher-ranking warband.

loot.name: Raider War Paint
loot.effect: Pigment used in intimidation mixtures and Goblin-themed quest objectives.
loot.flavorText: The greasy red paste smells of ash, fat, and bitter herbs.

loot.name: Scout Tracking Map
loot.effect: Discard during an Explore to look at the top 2 Exploration cards and put them back in any order.
loot.flavorText: A rough charcoal map showing patrol routes and hidden paths.

loot.name: Archer Bowstring
loot.effect: Crafting component for bows, traps, and ranged utility gear.
loot.flavorText: Crude but surprisingly strong cord twisted from sinew and fiber.

loot.name: Captain Crest
loot.effect: Counts as an Elite Goblin trophy for quests and special crafting recipes.
loot.flavorText: A hammered iron badge worn only by Goblin commanders.

loot.name: Wolf Pelt
loot.effect: Hide used in cloaks, light armor, and cold-weather gear.
loot.flavorText: Soft gray fur still carries the scent of pine.

loot.name: Wolf Fang
loot.effect: Used in fang charms, knife decorations, and hunter recipes.
loot.flavorText: A curved fang polished smooth at the tip.

loot.name: Bear Claw
loot.effect: Used in heavy hunting weapons, charms, and prestige recipes.
loot.flavorText: The claw is nearly as long as a dagger blade.

loot.name: Thick Beast Hide
loot.effect: Counts as Thick Hide and a Beast trophy for crafting requirements.
loot.flavorText: Scarred hide toughened by a lifetime of fighting.

loot.name: Spider Silk Gland
loot.effect: Process to create Spider Silk or use directly in web-based traps.
loot.flavorText: The pale gland still extrudes sticky silk when squeezed.

loot.name: Venom Sac
loot.effect: Used in poison recipes or refined into antidote ingredients.
loot.flavorText: A translucent sac filled with dangerous yellow venom.

loot.name: Beast Heart
loot.effect: Used in powerful vigor brews, beast rituals, and hunter quests.
loot.flavorText: Still warm when harvested, pulsing with fading strength.

loot.name: Warg Hide
loot.effect: Rare hide used in durable armor and fear-themed accessories.
loot.flavorText: Coarse black fur overlays a hide thicker than ordinary wolf leather.

loot.name: Warg Fang
loot.effect: Used in aggressive weapon upgrades and hunter reward recipes.
loot.flavorText: The serrated fang is stained dark near the root.

loot.name: Cave Bear Paw
loot.effect: Counts as a Large Beast trophy and rare component for heavy equipment.
loot.flavorText: The paw alone is larger than a goblin's head.

loot.name: Owlbear Feather
loot.effect: Used in precision fletching, cloaks, and beast-themed accessories.
loot.flavorText: A broad mottled feather with a surprisingly rigid spine.

loot.name: Owlbear Talon
loot.effect: Used in brutal melee weapon upgrades and elite hunter commissions.
loot.flavorText: Curved like a hook and hard enough to score steel.

loot.name: Spider Matriarch Fang
loot.effect: Rare venom component used in Epic poison and assassination recipes.
loot.flavorText: The hollow fang still beads with venom.

loot.name: Goblin Shaman Fetish
loot.effect: Arcane trophy used in anti-Goblin wards, ritual recipes, and story objectives.
loot.flavorText: Bone, feathers, and runes bound together with black cord.

loot.name: War Chief's Signet
loot.effect: Unique command trophy. Quest effects may require it as proof the War Chief is defeated.
loot.flavorText: A crude bronze signet worn as if it were a king's seal.

loot.name: Chieftain's Crown Fragment
loot.effect: Unique Boss component used in Campaign rewards and Goblin Uprising legendary recipes.
loot.flavorText: A jagged piece of iron and bone torn from the Chieftain's crown.

loot.name: Corrupted Totem Core
loot.effect: Rare corrupted component. May be purified by a Quest or consumed in high-tier Enchanting.
loot.flavorText: Dark energy throbs beneath the carved wooden shell.

loot.name: Copper Ingot
loot.effect: May be sold normally or used as a refined Copper component in crafting.
loot.flavorText: A neat stamped bar accepted by smiths throughout the frontier.

loot.name: Silver Ingot
loot.effect: High-value trade metal; also counts as refined Silver for recipes.
loot.flavorText: A bright bar stamped with an old merchant's mark.

loot.name: Gold Ingot
loot.effect: High-value trade good and premium crafting component.
loot.flavorText: Dense, heavy, and universally understood.

loot.name: Ancient Coin
loot.effect: Sell for its listed Value or retain for collector and ancient-history interactions.
loot.flavorText: The worn face on the coin belongs to no ruler anyone remembers.

loot.name: Dwarven Steel Bar
loot.effect: Counts as Steel plus one additional Rare Metal component in Masterwork recipes.
loot.flavorText: Perfectly forged metal bearing a maker's rune along one edge.

loot.name: Rough Emerald
loot.effect: Gem used in nature, healing, and precision enchantments.
loot.flavorText: Cloudy green stone waiting for a careful cut.

loot.name: Polished Sapphire
loot.effect: Gem used in control, protection, and arcane equipment recipes.
loot.flavorText: Deep blue facets catch even the faintest light.

loot.name: Ruby Gemstone
loot.effect: Gem used in offensive and fire-themed enchantments.
loot.flavorText: A blood-red stone that feels faintly warm.

loot.name: Black Pearl
loot.effect: Rare luxury component used in shadow and concealment recipes.
loot.flavorText: Its surface reflects no face clearly.

loot.name: Moonstone
loot.effect: Gem used in sacred, vision, and exploration-focused enchantments.
loot.flavorText: Pale light seems trapped beneath its milky surface.

loot.name: Fine Silk
loot.effect: Luxury cloth used in advanced garments and high-value trade.
loot.flavorText: Smooth fabric dyed in colors Stonebrook cannot produce.

loot.name: Exotic Spices
loot.effect: Used in Campcraft recipes or sold as valuable caravan cargo.
loot.flavorText: The scent fills a room before the pouch is opened.

loot.name: Rare Wine
loot.effect: Luxury trade item valued by nobles, merchants, and certain NPCs.
loot.flavorText: A sealed bottle from a vineyard far beyond the frontier.

loot.name: Ivory Carving
loot.effect: Sell for its listed Value or use in collector and noble interactions.
loot.flavorText: A tiny mounted knight carved with astonishing precision.

loot.name: Artisan Tools
loot.effect: A Hero using these for a crafting interaction may satisfy a basic Tool requirement when the Scenario allows.
loot.flavorText: A fitted case of files, hammers, awls, and fine measuring tools.

loot.name: Dragon Incense
loot.effect: Consumed by certain ritual recipes or dragon-related story interactions.
loot.flavorText: Dense smoke curls into shapes that resemble wings.

loot.name: Ancient Map Fragment
loot.effect: Keep. Some Quests or Exploration effects require multiple Map Fragments to reveal hidden content.
loot.flavorText: A torn piece of vellum showing roads no longer found on modern maps.

loot.name: Royal Seal
loot.effect: Unique proof of authority used in high-level story and faction interactions; cannot be sold unless a rule allows it.
loot.flavorText: Heavy gold stamped with a crowned lion.

loot.name: Merchant Ledger
loot.effect: Can be turned in during merchant or caravan objectives; otherwise sell for listed Value.
loot.flavorText: Names, routes, and debts fill every narrow line.

loot.name: Sealed Trade Contract
loot.effect: Keep until used by a Quest or merchant interaction; may unlock a special trade option.
loot.flavorText: Wax seals bind an agreement worth far more than the paper itself.

loot.name: Stonebrook Gate Key
loot.effect: Quest Item. Unlocks a specified Stonebrook gate, storehouse, or locked objective when instructed by a Quest.
loot.flavorText: A heavy iron key stamped with Stonebrook's crest.

loot.name: Goblin Lookout Key
loot.effect: Quest Item. Opens a locked Goblin Lookout cache or objective when instructed.
loot.flavorText: Crude iron key tied to a strip of red cloth.

loot.name: Watchtower Vault Key
loot.effect: Quest Item. Opens the Watchtower's sealed armory or vault when instructed.
loot.flavorText: The old key bears the same tower emblem carved into the Beacon base.

loot.name: Merchant Strongbox Key
loot.effect: Quest Item. Opens the Merchant Caravan's strongbox when the relevant Quest allows it.
loot.flavorText: A brass key worn smooth from years on a merchant's chain.

loot.name: Ancient Rune Seal
loot.effect: Quest Item. May be consumed or presented to bypass one matching Ancient Seal when instructed by a Quest.
loot.flavorText: The palm-sized stone carries a complete glowing rune.

loot.name: Scout's Journal
loot.effect: Quest Item. When a Quest references Goblin patrol intelligence, this satisfies that requirement.
loot.flavorText: Short notes list routes, signals, and the names of missing patrols.

loot.name: Captain's Orders
loot.effect: Quest Item. Reveals the next Goblin objective or satisfies a Campaign intelligence requirement.
loot.flavorText: The parchment carries commands from someone higher than the Captain.

loot.name: Caravan Manifest
loot.effect: Quest Item. Used to verify recovered caravan cargo or complete delivery objectives.
loot.flavorText: Every crate, barrel, and passenger is recorded in careful ink.

loot.name: Royal Proclamation
loot.effect: Quest Item. Unlocks royal or official story interactions when referenced by the Campaign.
loot.flavorText: The proclamation names the Heroes as agents of the realm.

loot.name: Explorer's Field Notes
loot.effect: Quest Item. May satisfy a Quest requiring surveyed or investigated Locations.
loot.flavorText: Pages of sketches and careful measurements document the frontier.

loot.name: Beacon Crystal
loot.effect: Quest Item. Required when a Quest states the Fallen Watchtower Beacon needs its focusing crystal.
loot.flavorText: A faceted crystal shaped to fit the tower's ancient mechanism.

loot.name: Ancient Totem
loot.effect: Quest Item. Used to activate or restore a nature-themed shrine when instructed.
loot.flavorText: A weathered wooden figure carved with roots and antlers.

loot.name: Corrupted Idol
loot.effect: Quest Item. May be purified, destroyed, or delivered as directed by a Quest.
loot.flavorText: Black veins pulse across what was once a holy carving.

loot.name: Moon Shrine Relic
loot.effect: Quest Item. Unlocks a Moon Shrine interaction or objective when referenced.
loot.flavorText: A silver disc etched with phases of the moon.

loot.name: World Fragment
loot.effect: Quest Item. Campaign-specific fragment required for a major story objective; cannot be voluntarily discarded.
loot.flavorText: The shard feels impossibly old and faintly vibrates in your palm.

loot.name: Bandit Ledger
loot.effect: Quest Item. Counts as evidence for a bandit or smuggling objective.
loot.flavorText: Names and payments connect thieves to respectable merchants.

loot.name: Noble Signet Ring
loot.effect: Quest Item. Proves the identity or allegiance of its former owner when a story interaction calls for it.
loot.flavorText: The ring bears a crest almost worn away by time.

loot.name: Lost Family Heirloom
loot.effect: Quest Item. Return to its owner when instructed to gain the listed Quest reward.
loot.flavorText: A tiny portrait sits behind cracked glass.

loot.name: Ancient Banner
loot.effect: Quest Item. May be used to rally allies or complete a historic-site objective when instructed.
loot.flavorText: Faded colors still show the emblem of a forgotten legion.

loot.name: Hero's Writ
loot.effect: Quest Item. Authorizes the Heroes to begin or access the next Campaign chapter when instructed.
loot.flavorText: Stonebrook's leaders have placed their trust in the bearer.

loot.name: Explorer's Compass
loot.effect: Relic. Once per round after you draw a valid Exploration card, you may discard it and draw the next valid Exploration card instead.
loot.flavorText: Its needle points toward opportunity rather than north.

loot.name: Lantern of the First Watch
loot.effect: Relic. Heroes at your Location ignore Dark and the first Ambush modifier applied there each round.
loot.flavorText: The blue-white flame has burned without oil for centuries.

loot.name: Cartographer's Journal
loot.effect: Relic. The first time your party reveals a new Location each Scenario, gain 10 Gold.
loot.flavorText: Every blank page seems eager to be filled.

loot.name: Crown of the Forgotten King
loot.effect: Relic. After completing a Main Quest, gain +1 additional Reputation if that Quest awards Reputation.
loot.flavorText: A vanished kingdom still commands respect through this crown.

loot.name: Ring of the Pathfinder
loot.effect: Relic. Once per round, your first voluntary Move costs 0 Actions, provided you are not Engaged.
loot.flavorText: Roads seem shorter while the ring is worn.

loot.name: Chalice of Renewal
loot.effect: Relic. Whenever a Hero at your Location Rests, that Hero recovers 1 additional Health.
loot.flavorText: Water placed inside becomes cool and perfectly clear.

loot.name: Banner of Unity
loot.effect: Relic. Heroes sharing the bearer's Location gain +1 Attack during their first Attack each round.
loot.flavorText: No army ever broke ranks beneath these colors.

loot.name: Priest's Reliquary
loot.effect: Relic. Your Attacks deal +1 damage to Undead or Corrupted enemies after Armor is applied.
loot.flavorText: Tiny bones and silver script rest behind crystal panes.

loot.name: Saint's Icon
loot.effect: Relic. Once per Scenario, remove all negative Conditions from one Hero at your Location.
loot.flavorText: The worn icon has been carried through wars, plagues, and worse.

loot.name: Tome of Forgotten Lore
loot.effect: Relic. After you Explore, you may look at the top card of the Exploration Deck and leave it on top or place it on the bottom.
loot.flavorText: Knowledge erased from history survives between these covers.

loot.name: Heart of the Mountain
loot.effect: Relic. While carried, the bearer gains +1 Armor. A Hero may carry only one Relic that directly grants Armor.
loot.flavorText: The stone beats slowly against the palm like a distant drum.

loot.name: Dragonfire Ember
loot.effect: Relic. Once per round, after your Attack deals at least 1 damage, deal 1 additional damage to that target.
loot.flavorText: The ember has not cooled since the age of dragons.

loot.name: Worldroot Seed
loot.effect: Relic. Once per Scenario, each Hero at your Location recovers 2 Health.
loot.flavorText: Life waits patiently inside the seed.

loot.name: Shard of the Ascendant
loot.effect: Relic. At the start of each Main Quest, gain 1 Ascendance Token if the Campaign uses Ascendance Tokens; otherwise draw 1 Hero card.
loot.flavorText: Reality seems thinner along the shard's edges.

loot.name: Orb of Ages
loot.effect: Relic. Once per Scenario at the end of your turn, immediately take another Hero turn. You cannot use Orb of Ages during that extra turn.
loot.flavorText: Inside the orb, moments repeat before they happen.

loot.name: Crown of the First King
loot.effect: Legendary Treasure. Gain +2 Reputation when acquired and unlock Campaign options that specifically require the Crown of the First King.
loot.flavorText: The realm's first crown still carries the weight of authority.

loot.name: Heart of the World Tree
loot.effect: Legendary Treasure. Once per Scenario, all Heroes recover 3 Health and each removes 1 negative Condition.
loot.flavorText: A living pulse travels through roots that touch every forest.

loot.name: Dragonlord's Hoard
loot.effect: Legendary Treasure. When acquired, gain 500 Gold and draw 2 Trade Goods. Then record this Treasure in the Campaign Log.
loot.flavorText: Centuries of tribute glitter beneath scorched stone.

loot.name: Blade of the Ascendant
loot.effect: Legendary Treasure. Unlock the unique Blade of the Ascendant Equipment or crafting recipe defined by the Campaign.
loot.flavorText: The unfinished blade seems to wait for a worthy hand.

loot.name: Eternal Forge Ember
loot.effect: Legendary Treasure. While owned by the party, Legendary-tier Blacksmithing recipes may be crafted when all other requirements are met.
loot.flavorText: The final coal from a forge said to predate the kingdom.

loot.name: Orb of the Celestial Gate
loot.effect: Legendary Treasure. Unlock hidden Locations or future Campaign content that specifically references the Celestial Gate.
loot.flavorText: Stars not found in the night sky drift beneath its surface.

loot.name: Phoenix Heart
loot.effect: Legendary Treasure. Once per Campaign when a Hero would be Defeated, discard or mark this Treasure spent to restore that Hero to full Health instead.
loot.flavorText: The flame inside dies only to ignite again.

loot.name: Codex of Eternity
loot.effect: Legendary Treasure. Unlock all Campaign recipes or interactions specifically marked Advanced Enchanting.
loot.flavorText: Every forgotten spell seems to have left a shadow on its pages.

loot.name: Crystal of Creation
loot.effect: Legendary Treasure. Once per crafting recipe, this may satisfy one required Rare or Epic Crafting Material. It is not consumed unless the recipe says otherwise.
loot.flavorText: Possibility itself appears frozen inside the crystal.

loot.name: Ascendant Keystone
loot.effect: Legendary Treasure. Record it when the Campaign finale is completed; future Campaign content may require the Ascendant Keystone to unlock.
loot.flavorText: The final key is heavier than stone and warmer than blood.

loot.name: Black Wax Seal
loot.effect: Campaign II evidence. Possession confirms that the road killings and Valewatch murders share the same crown-marked organization. Return/remove only when a Quest or Campaign effect instructs.
loot.flavorText: The wax is almost black. Pressed into it is a crown no herald recognizes.

loot.name: Witness Testimony
loot.effect: During WE006, ignore the first Suspicion marker that would be placed each Quest. This is Campaign information, not a sellable Item.
loot.flavorText: The witness remembers a face, a voice, and the door the killer used.

loot.name: Quiet Crown Ledger
loot.effect: Record Quiet Crown Supply Network Destroyed. During Q021, remove the first non-Boss Cult reinforcement that would spawn.
loot.flavorText: Names, payments, warehouse numbers, and coded deliveries fill every page.

loot.name: Royal Seal of the First King
loot.effect: At the start of Q024, remove 1 Crown Ward before play begins. The Seal remains a Campaign Quest Item unless the finale instructs otherwise.
loot.flavorText: The old king's signet bears no crown—only a hand closing around one.

loot.name: Veiled Crown Fragment
loot.effect: Gain only if the final fate of the Veiled Crown leaves a recoverable fragment. Its future effect is not yet defined; record it as a persistent Campaign Relic.
loot.flavorText: The fragment reflects a face that is never quite the one holding it.

loot.name: Warden's Signet
loot.effect: Campaign reward marker for Wardens of Valewatch. While Valewatch remains friendly, the party is recognized as trusted defenders and may access services gated by that title.
loot.flavorText: The city's seal is set beneath a narrow silver warding rune.

loot.name: Deepdelver Survey Map
loot.effect: During Q027, ignore the first route-gating or blocked-connection effect created by that Quest and one Relay Anchor begins with 1 damage. Future Campaign III Quests may reference Survey Network Restored separately.
loot.flavorText: Torren's team mapped passages that should not exist beneath the official mine plans.

loot.name: Ember Relay Core
loot.effect: Campaign III evidence. Records that the party recovered a functioning fragment of the first Worldforge relay. It cannot be sold. Future WE010–WE012 Quests may use it to identify, disable, or safely interface with Worldforge machinery.
loot.flavorText: The metal stays warm after the furnace goes dark, pulsing once every few seconds like a second heart.

loot.name: Clan Key of Emberdeep
loot.effect: During Q030, remove 1 Chain Lock before the Chain Relay encounter begins. During Q035, the first Pursuit spawn may be ignored if the Quest permits. The Key remains a persistent Campaign III Quest Item.
loot.flavorText: The heavy key is cut with teeth on every side, meant for a lock built into an entire wall.

loot.name: Heartstone Regulator
loot.effect: During Q033, ignore the first Forge Surge damage each Round. At the start of Q036, one Mountain Ward begins with 1 damage. The Regulator is not consumed unless a later effect says otherwise.
loot.flavorText: A ring of silvered stone hums softly when held near the Mountain Heart's pulse.

loot.name: Worldforge Master Key
loot.effect: During Q035, L122 Worldforge Core may be revealed after 3 qualifying Heartshaft/Forge Locations instead of 4. At L118 Ancient Lift, the printed Core Lift ability may use this Key. Cannot be sold.
loot.flavorText: The key has no teeth. The Worldforge recognizes the pattern of heat moving through it.

loot.name: Heartwarden Sigil
loot.effect: Campaign reward marker for Heartwardens of Ironhaven. While Ironhaven remains allied, the party is recognized as protectors of the Ironspine and may access future services or story options gated by that title.
loot.flavorText: A red stone set in black iron beats faintly once when its bearer enters the mountains.

loot.name: Bloomward Tonic Formula
loot.effect: Record First Cure Distilled if Nemi is saved. The first Spore/Poison Hazard in Q039 is ignored. Future Campaign IV effects may reference the formula; it cannot be sold.
loot.flavorText: The ink changes color when held near Blight.

loot.name: Blightheart Sample
loot.effect: Proof that the Blight is being cultivated through directed root growth. During WE014, once per Quest after inspecting a Blight Patch, the party may identify whether it is natural or Thorned Circle-created if relevant.
loot.flavorText: The sample continues growing after being sealed in glass.

loot.name: Thornsigil
loot.effect: During Q042, remove 1 Thorn Ward before the boss encounter begins. Future Thorned Circle gates may recognize the sigil if specified.
loot.flavorText: The sigil is a loop of living thorn that never pierces its holder.

loot.name: Heartseed Ward
loot.effect: During Q045, one Feeding Root begins with 1 damage. During Q048, one Bloom Root begins with 1 damage. Once per Round during WE015, cancel one Hollow Pressure loss of a beneficial Status if the Quest permits.
loot.flavorText: The ward is a seed that glows when a spirit is near.

loot.name: Heartseed Core
loot.effect: Records that the Green Cathedral's feeding network was severed. During Q047, ignore the first Choked route penalty encountered by the party. During Q048, after all Bloom Roots are destroyed, one Hero may recover 2 Health.
loot.flavorText: The core beats once, then waits for another root to answer.

loot.name: Verdant Warden Sigil
loot.effect: Campaign reward marker for Wardens of the Verdant Reach. While Eldergrove remains allied, future regional services and story options may recognize this title.
