loot.flavorText: A living-leaf sigil stays green even away from sunlight.

loot.name: Tideglass Chart
loot.effect: During Q051 ignore the first Flood Marker placed and one Bell Lock begins with 1 damage. Future Storm Coast route effects may reference the chart.
loot.flavorText: The coastline etched on the glass changes with the tide.

loot.name: Bellbreaker Key
loot.effect: During Q054 remove 1 Choir Bell before setup. May unlock specific Drowned Bell/ritual gates when explicitly stated.
loot.flavorText: The key rings softly when no bell is moving.

loot.name: Ghost Fleet Pennant
loot.effect: Q054 cancel first Ghost/Drowned reinforcement. Q059 ignore first Pursuit/Descent spawn. Cannot be sold.
loot.flavorText: The torn pennant is dry even underwater.

loot.name: Beacon Lens
loot.effect: Q057 one Chain Anchor begins with 1 damage. Q060 ignore one Tempest Pressure roll/effect each Round where legal.
loot.flavorText: A shard of daylight remains trapped inside the lens.

loot.name: Leviathan Chain Sigil
loot.effect: Q059 Deepheart Gate may unlock after 2 qualifying route Locations instead of 3. Q060 one Deep Chain begins with 1 damage.
loot.flavorText: The sigil is stamped into metal designed to restrain a god-sized creature.

loot.name: Stormwarden Sigil
loot.effect: Campaign reward marker for Stormwardens of Ashenport. Future Storm Coast services/story may recognize this title.
loot.flavorText: A silver wave curls around a black stormglass stone.

loot.name: Sunscar Wayglass
loot.effect: During Q063 ignore the first Mirage Marker and one Solar Seal begins with 1 damage. Future Sunscar route effects may reference the Wayglass.
loot.flavorText: The glass shows the true road as a dark line through false horizons.

loot.name: Crownshard of Dawn
loot.effect: Represents recovered Crownshards. Q064/Q066 story and objective text may reference possession; cannot be sold or discarded except by explicit finale choice.
loot.flavorText: Warm light moves beneath the metal like blood.

loot.name: Oasis Covenant Seal
loot.effect: Q066 remove 1 Mirror Ward before setup. Q071 ignore the first Mirage/Heat route tax. Q069 cancel first reinforcement if explicitly allowed.
loot.flavorText: The seal is cool even under the noon sun.

loot.name: First Dawn Prism
loot.effect: Q069 one Eclipse Anchor begins with 1 damage. Q072 cancel one Eclipse Pressure recovery reduction each Round when legal.
loot.flavorText: Inside the prism is the color of sunrise before the eclipse.

loot.name: Black Sun Key
loot.effect: Q071 Crown Chamber may unlock after 3 qualifying route Locations instead of 4. Q072 may recognize the Key for one explicit gate/ward interaction.
loot.flavorText: The key's shadow is brighter than the key itself.

loot.name: Dawnbearer Sigil
loot.effect: Campaign reward marker for Dawnbearers of Sunspire and completion of the initial six-campaign saga. Future content may recognize the title and recorded Crown outcome.
loot.flavorText: A sunburst surrounds a crown split into three possible futures.

searchCards.name: Hidden Cache
searchCards.effect: Draw 1 Loot card.
searchCards.flavorText: A loose stone reveals a small cache hidden by a traveler long ago.

searchCards.name: Forgotten Coin Purse
searchCards.effect: Gain 15 Gold.
searchCards.flavorText: Someone fled in a hurry and never returned for their coin.

searchCards.name: Abandoned Pack
searchCards.effect: Draw 1 Loot card. Then discard 1 card from your hand or lose 5 Gold.
searchCards.flavorText: The pack is useful, but something has already chewed through half its contents.

searchCards.name: Old Supply Crate
searchCards.effect: Gain 20 Gold or draw 1 Loot card.
searchCards.flavorText: The lid creaks open on supplies that somehow escaped the looters.

searchCards.name: Weathered Map
searchCards.effect: Reveal 1 unrevealed Location connected to your current Location. Do not resolve its Reveal Effect until it is entered or otherwise revealed normally.
searchCards.flavorText: Faded ink still marks a path through the wilderness.

searchCards.name: Forgotten Trail Marker
searchCards.effect: Look at one unrevealed connected Location. You may leave it unrevealed.
searchCards.flavorText: A nearly invisible carving points toward an older route.

searchCards.name: Buried Strongbox
searchCards.effect: Gain 30 Gold and draw 1 Loot card.
searchCards.flavorText: Rust covers the lock, but not the coins inside.

searchCards.name: Hunter's Cache
searchCards.effect: Recover 1 Health and draw 1 Loot card.
searchCards.flavorText: Dried meat and bandages remain wrapped in waxed cloth.

searchCards.name: Lost Weapon Bundle
searchCards.effect: Draw 1 Equipment card. You may keep it if its rarity is Common or Uncommon; otherwise place it on the bottom of the Equipment deck and gain 25 Gold.
searchCards.flavorText: A torn military wrap conceals a weapon still fit for battle.

searchCards.name: Traveler's Journal
searchCards.effect: Look at the top 2 Exploration cards. Put them back in any order.
searchCards.flavorText: The final page describes what the traveler found just ahead.

searchCards.name: Collapsed Cart
searchCards.effect: Gain 10 Gold and draw 1 Loot card.
searchCards.flavorText: One wheel lies downstream. The cargo did not travel as far.

searchCards.name: Hidden Compartment
searchCards.effect: Draw 2 Loot cards; keep 1 and discard the other.
searchCards.flavorText: A false panel gives way beneath your fingers.

searchCards.name: Ancient Coin
searchCards.effect: Gain 25 Gold. If the current Location has Ancient, Sacred, or Ruins among its traits or keywords, gain 10 additional Gold.
searchCards.flavorText: The face stamped into the coin belongs to no living king.

searchCards.name: Smuggler's Stash
searchCards.effect: Draw 1 Loot card and gain 25 Gold. Then draw 1 Travel Encounter.
searchCards.flavorText: Someone hid these goods because something dangerous was nearby.

searchCards.name: Discarded Rations
searchCards.effect: Each Hero in this Location may recover 1 Health.
searchCards.flavorText: The food is stale, but still edible.

searchCards.name: Makeshift Bedroll
searchCards.effect: Remove 1 negative Condition from the exploring Hero.
searchCards.flavorText: A few quiet minutes are enough to steady shaking hands.

searchCards.name: Old Battlefield Spoils
searchCards.effect: Choose: gain 30 Gold, or draw 1 Equipment card and keep it only if Common.
searchCards.flavorText: Broken weapons litter the ground, but not all are beyond repair.

searchCards.name: Hidden Alcove
searchCards.effect: Draw 1 Loot card. This Explore does not trigger any additional Encounter unless the card specifically says so.
searchCards.flavorText: The narrow recess is invisible from the main passage.

searchCards.name: Forgotten Armory
searchCards.effect: Draw 2 Equipment cards. Keep 1 Common or Uncommon card and place the other card(s) on the bottom of the deck. If neither qualifies, gain 30 Gold.
searchCards.flavorText: Dust covers the racks, but steel survives longer than kingdoms.

searchCards.name: Shrine Offering
searchCards.effect: Choose one Hero in this Location: recover 2 Health or remove 1 negative Condition.
searchCards.flavorText: A small offering bowl remains untouched beneath the cracked idol.

searchCards.name: Old Ranger Signal
searchCards.effect: Reveal 1 connected unrevealed Location. If it is a Goblin Structure, Goblin Camp, or Fortress, draw 1 Loot card.
searchCards.flavorText: Three cuts in the bark warn of danger ahead.

searchCards.name: Secret Footpath
searchCards.effect: The exploring Hero may immediately Move to one connected revealed Location without spending an Action, if not Engaged.
searchCards.flavorText: A narrow deer trail cuts around the worst of the terrain.

searchCards.name: Crumbling Wall Niche
searchCards.effect: Gain 15 Gold. On a Location with Ancient or Ruins, also draw 1 Loot card.
searchCards.flavorText: A mason's hollow hides more than mortar.

searchCards.name: Forgotten Memorial
searchCards.effect: Draw 1 Hero card. If your hand has 5 or fewer cards after drawing, recover 1 Health.
searchCards.flavorText: Names carved into stone remind you what is at stake.

searchCards.name: Abandoned Goblin Satchel
searchCards.effect: Gain 20 Gold. You may look at the top Encounter card and place it on the top or bottom of the Encounter Deck.
searchCards.flavorText: The satchel contains coins, crude maps, and a list of patrol routes.

searchCards.name: Hidden Grotto
searchCards.effect: Recover 2 Health. Then look at the top Exploration card; you may discard it.
searchCards.flavorText: Behind the spray lies a quiet pool untouched by the fighting.

searchCards.name: Forgotten Key
searchCards.effect: Keep this card. Discard it to ignore one Locked, Sealed, Gate, or Trap restriction that would otherwise require an Action or test.
searchCards.flavorText: The iron key is old enough to fit locks no one remembers making.

searchCards.name: Sealed Coffer
searchCards.effect: Draw 2 Loot cards and gain 25 Gold.
searchCards.flavorText: The coffer's seal breaks with a satisfying snap.

searchCards.name: Stolen Village Goods

searchCards.flavorText: Marks on the crates show they were taken from Stonebrook.

searchCards.name: Rare Find
searchCards.effect: Draw 1 Equipment card. You may keep it regardless of rarity.
searchCards.flavorText: For once, fortune favors the bold.

searchCards.name: Moment of Calm
searchCards.effect: The exploring Hero may draw 1 Hero card or recover 1 Health.
searchCards.flavorText: For a brief moment, the world goes quiet.

searchCards.name: Clear Vantage Point
searchCards.effect: Look at up to 2 unrevealed Locations connected to the current Location. Return them unrevealed.
searchCards.flavorText: From here, the paths ahead are easier to read.

searchCards.name: Useful Shortcut

searchCards.flavorText: A narrow cut through the terrain saves precious time.

searchCards.name: Fresh Water
searchCards.effect: Recover 2 Health or remove Poisoned from the exploring Hero.
searchCards.flavorText: Cold water washes away blood and exhaustion.

searchCards.name: Medicinal Herbs

searchCards.flavorText: The leaves are bitter, but their purpose is unmistakable.

searchCards.name: Safe Campsite

searchCards.flavorText: A ring of stones and dry ground makes a rare safe resting place.

searchCards.name: Old Watcher's Perch
searchCards.effect: Look at the top 3 Exploration cards. Put them back in any order.
searchCards.flavorText: Someone once watched these roads for exactly the same reasons.

searchCards.name: Favorable Ground
searchCards.effect: The exploring Hero gains Guard.
searchCards.flavorText: The terrain offers a position worth defending.

searchCards.name: Inspirational Relic
searchCards.effect: The exploring Hero gains Inspired until the end of their next turn.
searchCards.flavorText: A small symbol of courage survives in the dust.

searchCards.name: Hidden Cover
searchCards.effect: The exploring Hero gains Guard. If already Guarded, draw 1 Hero card instead.
searchCards.flavorText: A fallen wall or thick trunk provides a moment of safety.

searchCards.name: Trail Signs
searchCards.effect: Look at the top Encounter card. You may place it on the bottom of the Encounter Deck.
searchCards.flavorText: Broken branches and boot marks tell a story to anyone willing to read them.

searchCards.name: Goblin Patrol Schedule

searchCards.flavorText: Crude scratches list patrol times with surprising precision.

searchCards.name: Prepared Position

searchCards.name: Lucky Break

searchCards.flavorText: Sometimes the path simply opens at the right moment.

searchCards.name: Quiet Discovery

searchCards.flavorText: Nothing dramatic—just one useful detail you almost missed.

searchCards.name: Hidden Snare
searchCards.effect: The exploring Hero becomes Rooted until the end of their turn.
searchCards.flavorText: The loop tightens around your ankle before you see the rope.

searchCards.name: Loose Stones

searchCards.flavorText: Pebbles become a sudden shower of sharp rock.

searchCards.name: Poisonous Spores

searchCards.flavorText: A pale cloud bursts from the disturbed growth.

searchCards.name: Rotten Floorboards

searchCards.flavorText: The floor gives way exactly where it looked strongest.

searchCards.name: Goblin Trap
searchCards.effect: Suffer 1 damage that ignores Armor, then draw 1 Travel Encounter.
searchCards.flavorText: The trap was never meant to kill you. It was meant to make noise.

searchCards.name: Falling Debris
searchCards.effect: Each Hero in this Location suffers 1 damage.
searchCards.flavorText: A low rumble becomes a cascade of dust and stone.

searchCards.name: Sudden Flood

searchCards.flavorText: Water surges through the low ground without warning.

searchCards.name: Webbed Passage

searchCards.name: Unstable Ground

searchCards.name: Burning Embers

searchCards.name: Cursed Trinket

searchCards.name: Stinging Swarm

searchCards.name: Alarm Bell

searchCards.flavorText: A crude bell begins ringing before you can silence it.

searchCards.name: Fresh Goblin Tracks

searchCards.flavorText: Fresh footprints cross the path, accompanied by the drag marks of stolen supplies.

searchCards.name: Arrows in the Bark

searchCards.name: Distant War Horn

searchCards.flavorText: A horn answers another somewhere beyond the ridge.

searchCards.name: Predator Signs

searchCards.name: Goblin Campfire Smoke

searchCards.flavorText: Thin smoke rises above the trees.

searchCards.name: Broken Barricade

searchCards.name: Echoing Growl

searchCards.name: Scattered Bones

searchCards.name: Goblin Signal Flags

searchCards.name: Ransacked Wagon

searchCards.name: Unnatural Silence

searchCards.name: Goblin War Party

searchCards.name: Beast Territory

searchCards.name: Village Scout
searchCards.effect: The next Travel Encounter this round has -1 Severity, minimum 1.
searchCards.flavorText: The scout quietly points out a safer route.

searchCards.name: Old Soldier

searchCards.name: Burned Farmstead
searchCards.effect: Draw 1 Loot card. Then the exploring Hero gains Inspired until the end of their next turn.
searchCards.flavorText: The ruins are still warm.

searchCards.name: Goblin War Plans
searchCards.effect: Keep this card. Discard it before resolving a Travel Encounter to reduce its Severity by 2, minimum 1.

searchCards.name: Missing Patrol
searchCards.effect: Draw 1 Travel Encounter. After resolving it, gain 25 Gold.
searchCards.flavorText: Stonebrook's patrol never returned. Their trail ends here.

searchCards.name: Prisoner Message

searchCards.name: Chieftain's Orders
searchCards.effect: Look at the top 3 Encounter cards. Put them back in any order. Gain 10 Gold.

searchCards.name: Old Kingdom Inscription
searchCards.effect: Draw 1 Hero card and recover 1 Health.

searchCards.name: Hidden Prison Route

searchCards.name: Merchant's Ledger
searchCards.effect: Gain 15 Gold. If Q002 is active, gain 10 additional Gold.

searchCards.name: Evidence of the Goblin King

searchCards.name: Hope Endures
searchCards.effect: Each Hero recovers 2 Health and removes 1 negative Condition.

encounters.worldEventScaling: Sunfall scaling applies if first eligible group.
encounters.flavorText: A shape crosses the sun without wings beating.

encounters.name: Mirage City
encounters.trigger: When drawn
encounters.severity56: Each Hero discard1 or suffer1; gain Lore
encounters.severity7Plus: Spawn E110; gain Lore after resolution
encounters.worldEventScaling: LT185 lets party ignore one discard/damage cost.
encounters.flavorText: Towers rise from the sand and vanish when named.

encounters.name: First Dawn Ray
encounters.trigger: When drawn
encounters.worldEventScaling: Dawn Beacon Restored also removes one Mirage.
encounters.flavorText: For a heartbeat, the eclipse cracks.

encounters.name: Black Sun Knights
encounters.trigger: When drawn
encounters.worldEventScaling: WE024 final locations suppress random draws.
encounters.flavorText: The armor arrives before the footsteps.

encounters.name: Falling Starfire
encounters.trigger: When drawn
encounters.severity7Plus: Each Hero suffers1 unavoidable; place Heat Hazard
encounters.worldEventScaling: At Sunfall3+ first Solar Hazard gains +1 effect.
encounters.flavorText: A line of fire falls from the black sun.

encounters.name: The Crown Whispers
encounters.trigger: When drawn
encounters.severity56: Each Hero discard1 or lose Inspired
encounters.severity7Plus: Spawn E118; all Heroes lose Guarded
encounters.worldEventScaling: Never randomly drawn in L233–L235 during WE024.
encounters.flavorText: A voice promises every Hero the version of the world they wanted.

enemies.name: Goblin Raider
enemies.abilities: Reckless Assault — If the Goblin Raider is the only Enemy at its Location, it gains +1 Attack.
enemies.behavior: Target nearest Hero; move by shortest path; attack nearest; continue advancing.
enemies.flavorText: The first into battle and often the first to die, Goblin Raiders rely on numbers and fearless aggression rather than skill.
enemies.recommendedUses: Early encounters; patrols; ambushes; reinforcements; hordes

enemies.name: Goblin Archer
enemies.abilities: Volley Fire — If another Goblin occupies the same Location, gain +1 attack.
enemies.behavior: Target nearest Hero within Range; maintain ranged distance; move only to gain valid target; reposition if engaged.
enemies.flavorText: Hidden behind their larger kin, Goblin Archers rain crude arrows upon their foes, relying on distance rather than bravery.

enemies.name: Goblin Spearman
enemies.abilities: Brace for Charge — If a Hero enters its Location during Hero Phase, gain +1 armor until start of next activation.
enemies.behavior: Hold position; attack nearest Hero within Reach; move only to engage or protect allied Goblins.
enemies.flavorText: With sharpened spears held low, Goblin Spearmen form crude defensive lines that are far more disciplined than most adventurers expect.
enemies.recommendedUses: Protect Archers; guard objectives; narrow passages

enemies.name: Goblin Scout
enemies.abilities: Scout Ahead — If activation begins unengaged, gain Hidden until it attacks or becomes Engaged. Swarm-- gain +1 for every other goblin in their location.
enemies.behavior: Target isolated Hero; avoid heavily defended Locations; attack isolated Heroes; regroup with Goblins.
enemies.flavorText: Long before the warband arrives, Goblin Scouts have already marked the trails, counted their prey, and vanished back into the shadows.

enemies.name: Goblin Shaman
enemies.abilities: Crude Hex — Instead of attacking, target Hero within Range; Hero gains Weakened until end of next activation. Tribal Blessing — At start of activation, another Goblin in same Location recovers 1 Health.
enemies.behavior: Support wounded Goblins; stay behind frontline; use Crude Hex whenever possible.
enemies.flavorText: The tribe's shamans weave crude but potent magic, bolstering their kin while cursing any who dare oppose the clan.

enemies.name: Goblin Captain
enemies.abilities: Command the Warband — Other Goblins in same Location gain +1 Attack. Hold the Line — Instead of attacking, one allied Goblin there gains Guarded until start of Captain's next activation.
enemies.behavior: Stay with allied Goblins; reinforce threatened allies; attack Heroes engaging allies.
enemies.flavorText: A Goblin Captain earns command through brutality alone. Every order is backed by the threat of a blade.
enemies.recommendedUses: Patrol leaders; strategic objectives; mixed warbands

enemies.name: Goblin Beastmaster
enemies.abilities: Release the Beasts — Beast Enemies in same or adjacent Location gain +1 Movement. Crack the Whip — Instead of attacking, a Beast in same Location immediately makes a basic Attack.
enemies.behavior: Stay near Beasts; use Crack the Whip when possible; otherwise attack.
enemies.flavorText: The snarling wolves obey no goblin willingly. Only the Beastmaster's cracked whip keeps them charging toward the enemy.
enemies.recommendedUses: Wolf packs; forest ambushes; mixed Goblin/Beast

enemies.name: Goblin War Drummer
enemies.abilities: Beat of War — At start of Enemy Phase, allied Goblins in same and adjacent Locations gain +1 Movement until end of phase. Rally the Tribe — Instead of attacking, up to two allied Goblins in same Location gain +1 attack until end of phase.
enemies.behavior: Avoid direct combat; stay near largest Goblin group; use Rally when two+ can benefit.
enemies.flavorText: The thunder of crude drums echoes across the battlefield, driving frightened goblins into a fearless frenzy.

enemies.name: Goblin Berserker
enemies.abilities: Blood Frenzy — At 4 or fewer Health gain +2 Attack. Wild Swing — Whenever it defeats a Hero or another Enemy, it may immediately move 1 Location.
enemies.behavior: Target nearest Hero; prioritize lowest Health on ties; always attack; never choose support.
enemies.flavorText: Driven into a murderous rage by foul brews and promises of glory, Goblin Berserkers know neither fear nor self-preservation.

enemies.name: Goblin War Chief
enemies.abilities: For the Tribe! — Allied Goblins in same and adjacent Locations gain +1 Attack Crushing Blow — After successful melee attack, force target Hero to a connected Location. Call Reinforcements — Once per encounter, if fewer than 3 allied Goblins on battlefield, summon 2 Goblin Raiders into an adjacent Location.
enemies.behavior: Target highest Threat; stay near allied Goblins; never retreat; focus one Hero.
enemies.flavorText: Only the strongest survive long enough to become War Chief. Every scar marks a rival slain.

enemies.name: Goblin Saboteur
enemies.abilities: Dirty Tricks — Damaged Hero cannot benefit from Guard, Cover, or other defensive bonuses until start of next activation. Smoke Bomb — Once per encounter, when becoming Engaged, move to adjacent unoccupied Location instead.
enemies.behavior: Target support/ranged Heroes or lowest armor; bypass frontline; avoid prolonged engagement.
enemies.flavorText: Cowards by nature and assassins by trade, Goblin Saboteurs strike where defenses are weakest.

enemies.name: Goblin Trapper
enemies.abilities: Set Snare — Instead of attacking, place Snare Token in current or adjacent Location. First Hero entering suffers 2 damage and cannot perform another Move Action that turn; then discard the token. One Snare per Location. Prepared Ground — Ignores Snare Tokens.
enemies.behavior: Target Hero closest to objective; stay ahead of Heroes; place traps in likely routes; retreat behind allies.
enemies.flavorText: Every branch conceals a snare, every trail hides a pit. By the time you see the trap, it's already too late.

enemies.name: Goblin Wolf Rider
enemies.abilities: Ride Down — If moved 2+ Locations before attacking, attack gains +2 Attack. Hit and Run — After successful melee attack, may move 1 Location without reactions.
enemies.behavior: Target isolated/low-armor Heroes; use speed to flank; trigger Ride Down whenever possible.
enemies.flavorText: Mounted upon vicious wolves bred for war, Goblin Wolf Riders strike with terrifying speed before vanishing back into the wilderness.

enemies.name: Goblin Firestarter
enemies.abilities: Fire Bomb — Instead of basic attack, place Fire Token in current or adjacent Location. Hero entering or beginning activation there suffers 2 Fire damage; token persists until removed/end encounter. Pyromaniac — Unaffected by Fire Tokens.
enemies.behavior: Target Location with most Heroes; remain behind frontline; use Fire Bomb whenever useful.
enemies.flavorText: Laughing wildly, the Firestarter hurls clay jars filled with burning pitch, setting everything ablaze.

enemies.name: Goblin Champion
enemies.abilities: Challenge the Strongest — At start of activation choose Hero with highest Attack in current or adjacent Location if able. Veteran Warrior — First time each round it would suffer attack damage, reduce by 2.
enemies.behavior: Move toward strongest Hero; focus attacks until target defeated or unreachable.
enemies.flavorText: Unlike most goblins, a Champion has survived countless battles. Every scar is proof that underestimating it was someone's final mistake.

enemies.name: Goblin Siege Engineer
enemies.abilities: Construct Barricade — Instead of attacking, place Barricade Token in current Location. Allied Goblins there gain +2 armor; Heroes entering must spend 1 additional Movement; one Barricade per Location. Demolition Expert — +2 damage to Objectives, Structures, Destructible Terrain.
enemies.behavior: Move to strategic Locations; construct Barricades; stay behind frontline.
enemies.flavorText: Though few would call them brilliant, Goblin Siege Engineers turn piles of scrap into surprisingly effective fortifications.

enemies.name: Goblin Witch Doctor
enemies.abilities: Vile Hex — Instead of attack, Hero within Range gains Hex Token: -1 Attack/-1 armor until end of next activation; one Hex per Hero. Dark Ritual — Whenever a Hexed Hero is defeated, recover 3 Health.
enemies.behavior: Target unhexed Heroes; remain behind Goblins; spread Hexes.
enemies.flavorText: Whispering forbidden chants over bone fetishes and bubbling cauldrons, the Witch Doctor twists dark spirits into weapons.

enemies.name: Goblin Chieftain's Bodyguard
enemies.abilities: Shield the Chieftain — While with friendly Leader/Boss gain +1 armor; may become target when that Leader/Boss is targeted. Hold the Line — Allied Goblins in same Location cannot be forcibly moved by Hero abilities.
enemies.behavior: Remain with War Chief; attack Heroes threatening Leader; return to Leader if separated.
enemies.flavorText: Handpicked from the tribe's fiercest warriors, the Chieftain's Bodyguards swear loyalty unto death.
enemies.recommendedUses: Final boss; throne room; command groups

enemies.name: Goblin High Shaman
enemies.abilities: Dark Ritual — At start of Enemy Phase choose allied Goblin in same/adjacent Location: +2 Attack, +2 armor, or +2 attack until phase end; cannot repeat same bonus twice. Curse of Weakness — Instead of basic attack, target Hero within Range: -1 Attack/-1 armor until end of next activation. Totem of the Tribe — Once per encounter, place 5-Health Totem; Goblins there recover 1 Health at start and gain +1 attack.
enemies.behavior: Stay behind allies; use Totem first; curse strongest Hero; support largest group.
enemies.flavorText: The High Shaman speaks with the ancient spirits of the tribe. Whether ancestors or something darker, none can say.

enemies.name: Wolf
enemies.abilities: Pack Hunter — While another allied Beast is in same/adjacent Location, gain +1 Attack. Hamstring Bite — Damaged Hero has Movement reduced by 1 until end of next activation (minimum 1).
enemies.behavior: Target isolated Hero, otherwise lowest Health; move with other Beasts; focus one target.
enemies.flavorText: Silent as falling snow, the pack circles its prey before striking with terrifying coordination.

enemies.name: Dire Wolf
enemies.abilities: Alpha's Howl — At start of activation, allied Beasts in same/adjacent Locations gain +1 Attack until end of Enemy Phase. Savage Pounce — If moved 2+ Locations before attacking, damaged target is Knocked Down.
enemies.behavior: Target lowest armor; charge vulnerable Heroes; stay near Beasts.
enemies.flavorText: Larger, faster, and far more cunning than ordinary wolves, Dire Wolves lead the pack with terrifying authority.

enemies.name: Giant Spider
enemies.abilities: Web Shot — Instead of basic attack, target Hero in current/adjacent Location; gain Web Token: Movement becomes 1 and cannot benefit from granted movement until end of next activation. Venomous Bite — Damaged Hero gains 1 Poison Token.
enemies.behavior: Target unwebbed Hero; web fast/ranged Heroes; bite webbed Heroes.
enemies.flavorText: Patient hunters, Giant Spiders wait motionless until the slightest vibration signals prey has wandered too close.

enemies.name: Spider Matriarch
enemies.abilities: Brood Call — Once per encounter summon 2 Spiderlings into adjacent Locations. Massive Web — Instead of basic attack, place Web Zone in current/adjacent Location: entering Heroes stop; Heroes there -1 armor; persists until destroyed. Paralyzing Venom — Damaged Hero gains 2 Poison Tokens; if already 2+, also Stunned until end of next activation.
enemies.behavior: Create Web Zone if none; summon early; attack poisoned Heroes; stay near webs.
enemies.flavorText: The heart of every ancient web is its Matriarch—a colossal predator whose offspring blanket the forest floor in silk.

enemies.name: Giant Boar
enemies.abilities: Boar Charge — If moved 2 Locations before attacking, gain +2 Attack; if damage dealt, target is Knocked Back to adjacent Location. Thick Hide — Reduce first 2 damage suffered each Enemy Phase by 1.
enemies.behavior: Charge nearest Hero; avoid changing direction; continue attacking blockers.
enemies.flavorText: Towering over ordinary wild boars, these enraged beasts smash through trees, barricades, and anyone in their way.

enemies.name: Cave Bear
enemies.abilities: Mauling Assault — After successfully damaging a Hero, may immediately make second attack against same Hero at -1 attack. Territorial Fury — At 10 or fewer Health gain +2 Attack/+1 Movement.
enemies.behavior: Target nearest Hero; on ties highest Health; relentlessly focus target.
enemies.flavorText: The Cave Bear is a living mountain of muscle and fury. Once roused, nothing short of death will stop its charge.

enemies.name: Giant Bat
enemies.abilities: Flyby Attack — Ignores Engagement while moving; after successful attack may move 1 Location. Echo Screech — Instead of basic attack, all Heroes in current Location suffer -1 attack until end of next activation.
enemies.behavior: Bypass frontline; target isolated ranged Heroes/spellcasters; screech when 2+ Heroes affected.
enemies.flavorText: The thunder of leathery wings fills the darkness before razor-sharp claws descend from above.

enemies.name: Giant Snake
enemies.abilities: Constrict — Damaged Hero becomes Restrained: Movement 0; suffers 1 damage at start of activation; ends if Snake leaves Location, is defeated, or Hero escapes. Snake can restrain one Hero. Venomous Fangs — Damaged Hero gains 1 Poison Token.
enemies.behavior: Target isolated/unrestrained Heroes; continue attacking restrained target.
enemies.flavorText: Without warning, an immense serpent strikes from the undergrowth, wrapping its prey in crushing coils.

enemies.name: Owlbear
enemies.abilities: Rending Claws — Damaged Hero suffers Bleeding. Terrifying Roar — Once per encounter, all Heroes in same/adjacent Locations choose: discard 1 Action Token or suffer 2 damage.
enemies.behavior: Target nearest Hero; ties highest Health; roar when multiple Heroes affected; never retreat.
enemies.flavorText: Neither owl nor bear, the Owlbear is nature's nightmare made flesh.
enemies.recommendedUses: Forest boss; elite hunts; sacred groves

enemies.name: Warg
enemies.abilities: Coordinated Hunt — When Warg attacks a Hero, allied Beasts in same/adjacent Locations gain +1 attack against that Hero until end of Enemy Phase. Crippling Bite — Damaged Hero suffers -1 Movement/-1 armor until end of next activation.
enemies.behavior: Target isolated/wounded Hero; flank; focus one target; regroup with Beasts.
enemies.flavorText: Far larger and far more intelligent than ordinary wolves, Wargs hunt with terrifying purpose.

enemies.name: Forest Hydra
enemies.abilities: Many Heads — Makes two basic attacks per activation, same or different Heroes. Regenerate — Start of activation recover 3 Health unless suffered Fire damage since previous activation. Sweeping Heads — Instead of two attacks, attack every Hero in current Location.
enemies.behavior: Move toward Location with greatest number of Heroes; use Sweeping Heads at 3+ targets.
enemies.flavorText: Deep within the oldest forests lurks an ancient terror. Sever one head and two more seem ready to take its place.

enemies.name: Forest Spirit
enemies.abilities: Nature's Wrath — Instead of basic attack, choose Location within Range; all Heroes there suffer 3 Nature damage; in Forest terrain also Rooted until end of next activation. Blessing of the Wild — Start of Enemy Phase, allied Beast same/adjacent recovers 2 Health and gains +1 armor until phase end. Ethereal Form — First successful hit each round deals no damage.
enemies.behavior: Target Location with most Heroes; stay near Beasts; use Nature's Wrath at 2+ Heroes.
enemies.flavorText: Ancient as the forest itself, the Spirit awakens only when the natural balance is threatened.
enemies.recommendedUses: Sacred grove; story boss; Beast support

enemies.name: The Goblin King
enemies.abilities: KING OF THE HORDE: Allied Goblins in the Goblin King's Location gain +1 Attack. Allied Goblins in his Location or a connected Location gain +1 attack. CALL THE HORDE; Once per round, after the Goblin King activates, if fewer than 3 other Goblins are in play, spawn 1 Elite Goblin Raider or Elite Goblin Archer in the Throne Room. Spawn an Elite Goblin Raider if no Hero is in the King's Location; otherwise spawn an Elite Goblin Archer. CRUSHING COMMAND: After the Goblin King successfully damages a Hero with a melee attack, move that Hero to a valid connected Location if one exists.  THE KING'S LAST STAND: The first time the Goblin King reaches 14 Health or less, immediately activate him. For the remainder of the Quest: The Goblin King activates twice during each Enemy Phase.
enemies.behavior: Target the Hero with the highest Attack. Remain near allied Goblins when possible. Prioritize Heroes attacking the King. Never voluntarily move away from the Throne Room.
enemies.flavorText: For years the tribes fought one another. Then one goblin forced them all to kneel. Now, surrounded by the banners of conquered clans, the King awaits the heroes who would end his reign.
enemies.recommendedUses: Campaign Finale; Throne Room; Final Boss

enemies.name: Street Cutthroat
enemies.abilities: Mob Tactics — While another Criminal or Cult enemy occupies this Location, gain +1 Attack. Cheap Shot — The first Attack this enemy makes against an isolated Hero each activation gains +1 Attack.
enemies.behavior: Target isolated or lowest-Armor Hero; move with other street enemies; avoid heavily defended Heroes when another target is available.
enemies.flavorText: Valewatch's alleys breed desperate killers who know exactly when a victim has no one watching their back.

enemies.name: Crossbow Thug
enemies.abilities: Take the Shot — If this enemy did not Move this activation, gain +1 Attack. Suppressing Bolt — A damaged Hero cannot benefit from a free Move until the end of that Hero's next turn.
enemies.behavior: Maintain distance; target lowest-Armor Hero in Range; move only to gain line of approach or escape Engagement when permitted.
enemies.flavorText: From rooftops and shuttered windows, hired crossbows turn ordinary streets into killing grounds.

enemies.name: Masked Acolyte
enemies.abilities: Veiled Chant — At start of activation, choose another Cult enemy in this or a connected Location; it gains +1 Attack until end of Enemy Phase. Black Wax Hex — Instead of attacking, target a Hero within Range; that Hero becomes Weakened until end of next turn.
enemies.behavior: Stay behind Enforcers/Agents; buff the strongest nearby Cult enemy; Hex a high-Attack Hero when possible.
enemies.flavorText: The white masks hide frightened faces, but the voices behind them speak with the same cold cadence.

enemies.name: Veiled Agent
enemies.abilities: Hidden Blade — The first Attack made while no other Enemy is in the target Hero's Location gains +2 Attack. Vanish — Once per encounter after this enemy is attacked, it may Move 1 connected Location without spending Movement if not prevented by a Quest.
enemies.behavior: Target support or isolated Heroes; use mobility to leave crowded fights; prioritize Heroes carrying Evidence or Quest Items.
enemies.flavorText: The Quiet Crown's true agents are rarely seen twice by the same witness.
enemies.recommendedUses: Assassinations; objective hunters; elite urban encounters

enemies.name: Cult Enforcer
enemies.abilities: Break the Line — If the target is Guarded, this Attack ignores 1 Armor. Brutal Advance — After defeating or Downing a Hero, Move 1 Location toward the nearest other Hero if legal.
enemies.behavior: Advance directly toward the nearest Hero; prioritize Guarded/Defender Heroes on ties; never retreat voluntarily.
enemies.flavorText: These bruisers are paid to make questions disappear along with the people asking them.
enemies.recommendedUses: Heavy cult fights; bodyguards; ritual defense

enemies.name: Corrupt Watchman
enemies.abilities: Shield the Conspiracy — While sharing a Location with a Cult Leader, Boss, or Quest objective, that ally gains +1 Armor. Arrest — Instead of attacking a Hero with 1 or fewer Actions, that Hero becomes Restrained until end of next turn.
enemies.behavior: Hold objectives and leaders; intercept the closest Hero; remain in defensive Locations whenever possible.
enemies.flavorText: The badge is real. The oath behind it is not.

enemies.name: Sewer Stalker
enemies.abilities: From Below — If this enemy begins activation in an Underground Location and is not Engaged, its first Attack gains +1 Attack. Filth Bite — A damaged Hero gains Poisoned until end of next turn.
enemies.behavior: Target nearest unengaged Hero; prefer Heroes alone in Underground Locations; stay in tunnels and cisterns.
enemies.flavorText: Something has learned to hunt in the dark channels beneath the city—and it no longer fears torchlight.

enemies.name: Gravebound Soldier
enemies.abilities: Bone Discipline — While another Undead enemy is in this Location, gain +1 Armor against the first Attack that damages this enemy each Round. Relentless March — Ignore the first Movement penalty from Difficult Terrain each activation.
enemies.behavior: Advance as a formation; stay with other Undead; block access to objectives and narrow routes.
enemies.flavorText: The dead beneath Valewatch still remember how to hold a line.

enemies.name: Crypt Archer
enemies.abilities: Pinning Shot — A Hero damaged by this enemy must spend 1 additional Action on the next voluntary Move they make before the end of their next turn. Deadeye — Gain +1 Attack against a Hero in an Open Ground Location.
enemies.behavior: Maintain distance; target mobile Heroes or Heroes approaching objectives; move only to preserve Range.
enemies.flavorText: Ancient bows creak as dead hands draw strings that should have rotted centuries ago.

enemies.name: Wraith
enemies.abilities: Ethereal Drift — May Move through Engagement and ignores Difficult Terrain. Cold Touch — A damaged Hero loses 1 Action at the start of their next turn, minimum 0 available Actions after normal gain.
enemies.behavior: Pass through frontlines; target Heroes with the most remaining Actions or lowest Armor; avoid staying with Defender Heroes.
enemies.flavorText: Where memory fades beneath the city, hatred sometimes remains.

enemies.name: Ossuary Keeper
enemies.abilities: Raise the Fallen — Once per encounter at start of activation, if fewer than 2 Gravebound Soldiers are in play, spawn 1 E040 in this Location or a connected Crypt Location. Bone Ward — Another Undead in this Location gains +1 Armor until start of the Keeper's next activation.
enemies.behavior: Remain behind Undead lines; raise a Soldier early; protect Hollow Knights or objectives.
enemies.flavorText: The Keeper tends a congregation that has been dead for generations.

enemies.name: Hollow Knight
enemies.abilities: Hollow Challenge — At start of activation choose the Hero with the highest Attack in this Location or nearest connected Location; gain +1 Attack against that Hero this activation. Tomb Guard — While guarding a Quest objective, reduce the first damage this enemy suffers each Round by 2.
enemies.behavior: Hold position at objectives; engage the strongest Hero; do not chase distant targets while guarding.
enemies.flavorText: Nothing remains inside the armor, yet the knight still kneels before a throne long buried.
enemies.recommendedUses: Royal tombs; elite guards; boss support

enemies.name: Veilspawn
enemies.abilities: Veil Step — Once per activation before or after attacking, Move to a connected Location ignoring Engagement and Difficult Terrain. Unmake Courage — If the Attack damages a Hero, that Hero loses Inspired and Guarded if present.
enemies.behavior: Blink toward support Heroes; strip beneficial Conditions; avoid ending beside heavily armored Defenders when another target is available.
enemies.flavorText: When the Crown dreams, shapes crawl out of the spaces between shadows.

enemies.name: Crown Herald
enemies.abilities: Voice of the Crown — Other Cult and Veil enemies in this or connected Locations gain +1 Attack. Command Kneel — Once per encounter instead of attacking, choose a Hero within Range; that Hero becomes Stunned unless they discard 1 card.
enemies.behavior: Stay near the largest Cult/Veil group; use Command Kneel against the highest-Attack Hero; avoid direct melee.
enemies.flavorText: The Herald speaks softly. Everyone nearby hears the Crown instead.
enemies.recommendedUses: Final chapter; commander support; ritual fights

enemies.name: Faceless Killer
enemies.abilities: Choose the Victim — At start of Enemy Phase Mark the Hero with the lowest current Health. The Killer gains +2 Attack against the Marked Hero. Smoke and Mirrors — Once per Round after suffering damage, Move 1 connected Location ignoring Engagement. Executioner's Opening — The first time each Round the Killer attacks a Hero with no ally in their Location, that Attack ignores 1 Armor.
enemies.behavior: Hunt the Marked Hero; use mobility to isolate targets; retreat from large groups only to re-engage a vulnerable Hero.
enemies.flavorText: No one remembers the murderer's face. Some swear there was never a face beneath the mask at all.

enemies.name: Ysara Keld, First Mask
enemies.abilities: First Mask — Other Cult enemies in this and connected Locations gain +1 Armor. Ritual Pulse — At start of activation, if a Ritual objective remains, every Hero in this Location suffers 1 unavoidable damage. Shatter Faith — Instead of a basic Attack, remove one beneficial Condition from each Hero in this Location; then make one basic Attack against the Hero with highest Attack.
enemies.behavior: Remain near ritual objectives; protect Acolytes and Heralds; target the strongest Hero; never voluntarily leave the Black Cathedral while a Ritual objective remains.
enemies.flavorText: Ysara does not worship the Crown. She believes she is the first person in centuries to truly understand it.

enemies.name: Severin Hale, Crown-Bound
enemies.abilities: Unwilling Vessel — At the start of each Round, place 1 Crown Strain on Hale. At 3 Strain, the Quest may advance to the Sovereign stage as instructed. Royal Command — Once per activation, move one Cult or Corrupt Guard in a connected Location 1 Location and it may immediately Attack. Fractured Will — The first time each Round Hale would suffer 5 or more damage from one Attack, reduce that damage by 2.
enemies.behavior: Remain near Crown Wards and allied guards; command allies before attacking; target Heroes interacting with the Crown.
enemies.flavorText: The Chancellor fights from somewhere behind his own eyes, but the Crown is learning to speak with his voice.

enemies.name: The Veiled Sovereign
enemies.abilities: Sovereign's Decree — At start of activation choose one: all Heroes in Range suffer -1 Attack until end of next turn; or move one Hero in Range to a connected legal Location. Crownstorm — Instead of a basic Attack, Attack up to 2 different Heroes in Range at -1 Attack. Eternal Vessel — The Sovereign cannot be finally defeated while any Crown Ward required by Q024 remains. Fractured Reality — The first time each Round a Hero Moves into the Sovereign's Location, that Hero suffers 1 damage.
enemies.behavior: Control positioning; prioritize Heroes attacking Crown Wards; use Crownstorm when two legal targets exist; never retreat.
enemies.flavorText: The ruler was forgotten. The crown endured.
enemies.recommendedUses: Q024 final boss; Campaign II finale

enemies.name: Shale Crawler
enemies.abilities: Stone Skitter — Ignore the first additional Move Action caused by Difficult Terrain each activation. Pack Hunger — Gain +1 Attack while another Shale Crawler is in this Location.
enemies.behavior: Move toward the nearest Hero; prefer joining another Crawler before attacking when both routes are equal.
enemies.flavorText: Plates of black shale flex across its back as it squeezes through cracks too small for anything that size.

enemies.name: Deepmaw Brute
enemies.abilities: Crushing Lunge — If this Enemy moved before attacking, the Attack gains +1 Attack. Stonebreaker — If its Attack deals 4 or more damage before Armor, place a Cave-In Token in the target's Location if the Quest permits Cave-In Tokens.
enemies.behavior: Advance toward clustered Heroes; prefer targets near structural objectives or narrow passages.
enemies.flavorText: It chews stone when hungry and iron when angry.

enemies.name: Ashen Compact Saboteur
enemies.abilities: Set Charge — Once per encounter instead of attacking, place a Charge Token in this Location if none is there. At end of next Enemy Phase, remove it and each Hero here suffers 2 damage; the Quest may treat this as a structural Hazard. Cut and Run — After attacking, may Move 1 connection away from the nearest Hero.
enemies.behavior: Target Heroes interacting with objectives; use Set Charge on objective/route Locations; keep distance when possible.
enemies.flavorText: They know exactly which support to break and exactly how long they have before the roof comes down.

enemies.name: Ashen Compact Forgemaster
enemies.abilities: Field Repair — At start of activation, one Construct or Ashen Compact Enemy in this Location recovers 2 Health. Stoke the Relay — While in a Forge Location, other Ashen Compact enemies here gain +1 Attack.
enemies.behavior: Stay near Constructs/objectives; repair the most damaged ally; avoid isolated melee.
enemies.flavorText: To the Compact, a battlefield is only another machine waiting to be tuned.

enemies.name: Runic Sentry
enemies.abilities: Anchored Frame — While guarding a Relay Anchor or Forge objective, reduce the first damage this Enemy suffers each Round by 2. Rune Pulse — Once per encounter instead of attacking, all Heroes in this Location suffer 1 unavoidable damage and lose Guarded.
enemies.behavior: Remain at the nearest Forge/Relay objective; engage Heroes who interact with it; do not chase distant targets.
enemies.flavorText: The construct has no face, only a line of runes that brighten as intruders approach.

enemies.name: Varrik Emberhand
enemies.abilities: Relay-Bound — While any Q027 Relay Anchor remains, Varrik cannot be reduced below 12 Health. Hammerfall — The first time each Round Varrik deals damage, the target's Location gains a Cave-In Token if legal. Command the Forge — Once per activation before attacking, one E053, E054, or E055 in this or a connected Location may Move 1 connection.
enemies.behavior: Hold L100, command allies toward Heroes attacking Anchors, and punish clustered Heroes with Hammerfall positioning.
enemies.flavorText: Varrik does not deny causing the tremors. He only asks why Ironhaven should fear power its ancestors were too weak to use.
enemies.recommendedUses: Q027 boss; first Ashen Compact commander

enemies.name: Stonebound Miner
enemies.abilities: Stonebound — First time each Round this Enemy would be moved by a Hero effect, ignore that movement. Mining Swing — gains +1 Attack against a Hero in a Location with a Cave-In or Fracture Token.
enemies.behavior: Advance toward nearest Hero; prefer Heroes clearing route/objective tokens.
enemies.flavorText: Stone has grown across skin, tools, and eyes until worker and mine are hard to tell apart.

enemies.name: Deep Road Stalker
enemies.abilities: From the Dark — First Attack each encounter gains +1 Attack if the Stalker began its activation without a Hero in its Location. Slip Away — after attacking, may Move 1 connection if another legal target is not in its Location.
enemies.behavior: Hunt isolated/rear Heroes; approach through connected dark/Ancient Locations when possible.
enemies.flavorText: The old road has predators now, and they learned where travelers look first.

enemies.name: Ashen Compact Shieldbearer
enemies.abilities: Shield Wall — Other Ashen Compact enemies in this Location gain +1 Armor while at least one Shieldbearer is present. Brace the Line — while guarding a Quest objective, reduce first damage suffered each Round by 1.
enemies.behavior: Stay on objectives and with Compact allies; engage Heroes interacting with objectives.
enemies.flavorText: Their shields are forged from plates cut out of old Worldforge doors.

enemies.name: Dorga Chainforged
enemies.abilities: Chain-Bound — while any Q030 Chain Lock remains, Dorga cannot be reduced below 14 Health. Reel In — once per activation, move one Hero in a connected Location into Dorga's Location if legal. Iron Discipline — other Ashen Compact enemies in her Location gain +1 Armor.
enemies.behavior: Hold Chain Relay; pull objective-focused Heroes into melee; keep guards together.
enemies.flavorText: Dorga wears the relay's chains as armor and calls their weight a privilege.

enemies.name: Magma Whelp
enemies.abilities: Living Flame — immune to Fire damage. Burning Trail — after moving, the first Hero entering the Location the Whelp left this Round suffers 1 damage.
enemies.behavior: Rush support/backline Heroes; move frequently to create dangerous paths.
enemies.flavorText: It erupts from molten seams like a spark deciding to become an animal.

enemies.name: Forge Golem
enemies.abilities: Forged Plate — reduce the first damage suffered each Round by 1. Programmed Guard — while in a Forge/Worldforge Location, cannot be voluntarily moved by Hero effects.
enemies.behavior: Guard Forge objectives; attack nearest Hero; never leave a Worldforge objective to chase beyond one connection.
enemies.flavorText: No smith stands at the anvil, yet the metal keeps walking.

enemies.name: Heartstone Adept
enemies.abilities: Heartstone Channel — at start of activation choose one allied Construct or Ashen Compact enemy in Range; it gains +1 Attack this activation. Resonant Ward — first time each Round an allied objective token in this Location would be damaged, the attacking Hero suffers 1 damage.
enemies.behavior: Stay behind guards near objectives; empower the strongest ally; avoid melee.
enemies.flavorText: They learned to listen to the Heart and mistook obedience for understanding.

enemies.name: Ashen Compact Captain
enemies.abilities: Compact Orders — once per activation before attacking, one Ashen Compact enemy in a connected Location may Move 1. Hold the Line — allies in this Location ignore the first forced movement effect each Round.
enemies.behavior: Coordinate Compact groups; reinforce objective rooms; target Heroes nearest campaign objectives.
enemies.flavorText: Captains carry sealed orders signed only with Kharvek's hammer mark.

enemies.name: Stone Echo
enemies.abilities: Echo of Failure — if the target has discarded any card this Round, gain +1 Attack. Remembered Path — once per activation may Move through one blocked/Fractured connection as though clear.
enemies.behavior: Pressure Heroes resolving Memory/Resonance objectives; remain near ancestral locations.
enemies.flavorText: It is not a ghost of a person. It is a memory the mountain refused to forget.

enemies.name: Furnace Colossus
enemies.abilities: Node-Fed Armor — while any Q033 Forge Node remains, gain +1 Armor. Furnace Sweep — instead of a basic Attack, Attack up to 2 different Heroes in this Location at -1 Attack. Overheat — first time each Round Colossus suffers 6+ damage from one Attack, every Hero in its Location suffers 1 damage.
enemies.behavior: Remain in L115; prioritize Heroes attacking Nodes; use Furnace Sweep against multiple targets.
enemies.flavorText: The Worldforge built a guardian for wars nobody remembers fighting.

enemies.name: Kharvek Durn, Forge-Lord
enemies.abilities: Forge-Lord — other Ashen Compact and Construct enemies in this/connected Locations gain +1 Attack. Worldforge Harness — while any Q036 Mountain Ward remains, Kharvek cannot be reduced below 14 Health. Command the Core — once per activation, one allied non-Boss in Range may immediately Move 1 or Attack at -1 Attack.
enemies.behavior: Remain near Mountain Wards; command allies before attacking; target Heroes damaging Wards.
enemies.flavorText: Kharvek reaches the Heart certain that history is about to call him savior.

enemies.name: Heartforged King
enemies.abilities: Heart's Decree — at start of activation choose: all Heroes in Range lose Guarded, or move one Hero in Range 1 legal connection. Molten Crown — instead of a basic Attack, attack up to 2 different Heroes in Range at -1 Attack. Eternal Forge — cannot be finally defeated while any Q036 Mountain Ward remains. Heartquake — first time each Round a Hero damages a Mountain Ward, that Hero suffers 1 damage.
enemies.behavior: Control positioning; punish Ward interaction; use multiattack whenever two legal targets are available; never retreat.
enemies.flavorText: Kharvek is gone. What rises from the Worldforge wears him only as a shape.
enemies.recommendedUses: Q036 final boss; Campaign III finale

enemies.name: Blightling
enemies.abilities: Rot Cloud — first time each Round this Enemy is defeated, one Hero in its Location suffers 1 damage unless Guarded. Swarm — +1 Attack while another Blightling is here.
enemies.behavior: Cluster around vulnerable Heroes and objectives.
enemies.flavorText: Small roots pull a body of fungus and thorn across the forest floor.

enemies.name: Rotfang Wolf
enemies.abilities: Rotfang — if another Beast/Blighted Enemy is here, first Attack each activation gains +1 Attack. Pounce — after moving 2+ connections, ignore 1 Armor.
enemies.behavior: Hunt isolated or low-Health Heroes.
enemies.flavorText: Its teeth are black with sap that moves against gravity.

enemies.name: Sporeback Bear
enemies.abilities: Spore Burst — first time each Round it suffers 5+ damage, each Hero here discards 1 card or suffers 1 damage. Massive — ignores first forced movement each Round.
enemies.behavior: Engage clustered Heroes and hold objectives.
enemies.flavorText: Mushrooms bloom from its shoulders every time it breathes.

enemies.name: Spore Witch
enemies.abilities: Choking Spores — instead of attacking, choose a Hero in Range; that Hero loses Guarded and suffers -1 Attack until end next turn. Fungal Mend — one Blighted/Plant ally here recovers 2 Health at start activation.
enemies.behavior: Stay behind Blighted allies; strip protection.
enemies.flavorText: Her mask is grown, not carved.

enemies.name: Thorned Circle Stalker
enemies.abilities: Briar Shot — first Attack each encounter against a Hero with no ally in their Location ignores 1 Armor. Fade to Green — after attacking, may Move 1 connection if no Hero is here.
enemies.behavior: Target isolated Heroes and retreat.
enemies.flavorText: They wear leaves from trees that died years ago.

enemies.name: Blightheart Matron
enemies.abilities: Vein-Bound — while any Q039 Root Vein remains, cannot be reduced below 12 Health. Broodcall — once per activation, if fewer than 2 Blightlings are in play, spawn 1 E069 here or connected. Rotting Slam — damaged Hero loses Inspired if present.
enemies.behavior: Hold den and protect Root Veins.
enemies.flavorText: The beast's heart beats in three places at once.

enemies.name: Briarbound Warrior
enemies.abilities: Briar Armor — first melee Attack against this Enemy each Round deals 1 less damage, minimum 0. Rooted Stance — while guarding an objective, cannot be moved by Hero effects.
enemies.behavior: Guard objectives and screen druids.
enemies.flavorText: Living thorns grow through the gaps in their armor.

enemies.name: Ash Druid
enemies.abilities: Ashen Growth — at start activation, choose one Blight Patch in Range; Heroes there suffer 1 damage. Cinder Ward — one Thorned Circle ally here gains +1 Armor until next activation.
enemies.behavior: Stay near Blight Patches and objective guards.
enemies.flavorText: They burn healthy growth so the Bloom has fewer rivals.

enemies.name: Yselle Thornmother
enemies.abilities: Ward-Bound — while any Q042 Thorn Ward remains, cannot be reduced below 13 Health. Thorn Command — once per activation one Thorned Circle or Spirit ally in Range may Move 1. Grasping Crown — first Hero damaged each Round becomes Rooted until end next turn.
enemies.behavior: Remain near Wards and command spirits/guards.
enemies.flavorText: Thorns pierce her skin in a pattern she calls a crown.

enemies.name: Hollow Stag
enemies.abilities: Between Trees — once per activation may Move through one blocked connection or Difficult Terrain without extra cost. Antler Rend — if it moved before attacking, +1 Attack.
enemies.behavior: Circle around frontline and hit support.
enemies.flavorText: Its antlers branch into paths that are not there.

enemies.name: Mycelial Horror
enemies.abilities: Spore Field — Heroes in this Location recover 1 less Health, minimum 0. Bloom Burst — instead of Attack, every Hero here suffers 1 unavoidable damage.
enemies.behavior: Occupy objective spaces and suppress recovery.
enemies.flavorText: It walks on a forest of tiny legs that used to be roots.

enemies.name: Hollow Warden
enemies.abilities: Hollow Guard — while guarding a Quest objective, reduce first damage suffered each Round by 2. Spirit Lash — damaged Hero discards 1 card if they are Inspired.
enemies.behavior: Guard gates, roots, and shrines.
enemies.flavorText: The old guardian remembers its oath but not what it was protecting.

enemies.name: Bound Dryad
enemies.abilities: Bound Will — Quest effects may allow this Enemy to be Pacified instead of defeated. Root Snare — instead of attacking, Root one Hero in Range until end next turn.
enemies.behavior: Remain near binding objectives; control movement.
enemies.flavorText: The vines around her wrists are not jewelry.

enemies.name: Briar Colossus
enemies.abilities: Thorn Carapace — first damage suffered each Round reduced by 2. Sweeping Limbs — instead of basic Attack, attack up to 2 Heroes here at -1 Attack.
enemies.behavior: Block routes and punish groups.
enemies.flavorText: A walking wall of bark closes behind the Briar Path.

enemies.name: Rot Spirit
enemies.abilities: Withering Touch — damaged Hero loses one beneficial Status. Drift — ignores Engagement during movement.
enemies.behavior: Strip buffs and attack support Heroes.
enemies.flavorText: The spirit smells like wet leaves left too long in darkness.

enemies.name: Cathedral Treant
enemies.abilities: Feeding Armor — gains +1 Armor per remaining Q045 Feeding Root. Cathedral Sweep — instead of Attack, attack up to 2 Heroes here at -1 Attack. Deep Roots — cannot be moved.
enemies.behavior: Remain in Green Cathedral and protect roots.
enemies.flavorText: Its trunk is carved with prayers from before Eldergrove had a name.

enemies.name: Bloom Herald
enemies.traits: Humanoid; Thorned Circle; Blighted; Elite; Leader
enemies.abilities: Voice of Bloom — Blighted/Spirit allies in this or connected Locations gain +1 Attack. Command Flowering — once per encounter instead of attacking, spawn 1 E069 in a connected Blighted/Hollow Location.
enemies.behavior: Stay near groups; prioritize support Heroes.
enemies.flavorText: Flowers grow from the mask whenever the Herald speaks.

enemies.name: Maelor Briarheart, Bloom-Bound
enemies.abilities: Bloom-Bound — while any Q048 Bloom Root remains, cannot be reduced below 15 Health. Verdant Command — once per activation one Plant/Spirit/Thorned Circle ally in Range may Move 1 or Attack at -1 Attack. Wither Blessing — first Hero damaged each Round loses Guarded and Inspired if present.
enemies.behavior: Control Roots and support allies; target Heroes interacting with Roots.
enemies.flavorText: Maelor calls it surrender. The Bloom calls it germination.

enemies.name: The Hollow Bloom
enemies.abilities: Rootmind — at start activation choose: all Heroes in Range suffer -1 Attack until end next turn, or move one Hero in Range 1 legal connection. Flowering Storm — instead of Attack, attack up to 2 different Heroes in Range at -1 Attack. Endless Root — cannot be finally defeated while any Q048 Bloom Root remains. Feeding Pulse — first time each Round a Root is damaged, one Hero in L161 suffers 1 damage.
enemies.behavior: Control position and punish Root interaction; never retreat.
enemies.flavorText: The whole forest inhales through one flower.

enemies.name: Brinewalker
enemies.abilities: Waterlogged — ignores first Flood movement penalty each activation. Swarm — +1 Attack while another Drowned is here.
enemies.behavior: Close on nearest Hero/objective.
enemies.flavorText: A sailor's corpse walks with seawater pouring from its mouth.

enemies.name: Reef Stalker
enemies.abilities: Reef Leap — after moving 2+ connections, +1 Attack. Submerge — after attacking in Coast/Sea, may Move 1 if no Hero remains here.
enemies.behavior: Hunt isolated Heroes.
enemies.flavorText: A scaled shape moves beneath water too shallow to hide it.

enemies.name: Drowned Corsair
enemies.abilities: Boarding Rush — if entering a Hero Location this activation, first Attack ignores 1 Armor. Salt Grip — ignores first forced movement each Round.
enemies.behavior: Pressure objectives and wounded Heroes.
enemies.flavorText: Rusted cutlasses still remember old boarding drills.

enemies.name: Salt Witch
enemies.abilities: Salt Curse — instead of Attack, one Hero in Range loses Guarded and suffers -1 healing until end next turn. Brine Mend — one Drowned ally recovers 2 Health.
enemies.behavior: Stay behind frontliners.
enemies.flavorText: Crystals grow across her skin like a second skeleton.

enemies.name: Barnacle Brute
enemies.abilities: Barnacle Plate — first damage suffered each Round reduced by 2. Crushing Grip — damaged Hero's next Move costs +1 Action.
enemies.behavior: Hold chokepoints.
enemies.flavorText: Armor and shell have become the same thing.

enemies.name: Tidebound Gunner
enemies.abilities: Blackpowder Shot — if no Hero is in its Location, +1 Attack. Waterlogged Powder — cannot use bonus if Stunned or Rooted.
enemies.behavior: Stay at range and target objectives/support.
enemies.flavorText: The pistol fires despite being full of seawater.

enemies.name: Ghost Mariner
enemies.abilities: Phase Deck — may move through one blocked/Flooded connection without cost. Old Orders — may be Pacified when Quest/Encounter explicitly allows.
enemies.behavior: Circle and harry backline.
enemies.flavorText: It salutes a captain who died fifty years ago.

enemies.name: Breakwater Sentinel
enemies.abilities: Anchored — cannot be moved. Seawall Guard — first damage to a Breakwater objective in its Location each Round is prevented.
enemies.behavior: Guard structures.
enemies.flavorText: An old harbor automaton still fights beneath layers of salt.

enemies.name: Bell Thrall
enemies.abilities: Resonant Toll — at start activation, if a Bell objective is in play here, one Hero here discards 1 card or suffers 1 damage. Choir — +1 Attack with another Bell Thrall.
enemies.behavior: Cluster around bells.
enemies.flavorText: Its ribs ring like bronze when struck.

enemies.name: Morcant Bell-Keeper
enemies.abilities: Lock-Bound — while any Q051 Bell Lock remains, cannot be reduced below 13 Health. Drowning Toll — one Hero here loses Inspired or suffers 1 damage. Summon Thrall if none in play.
enemies.behavior: Protect Locks and hold tower.
enemies.flavorText: The keeper was buried at sea. The bells brought him home.

enemies.name: Undertow Wraith
enemies.abilities: Undertow — instead of Attack, move one Hero in Range 1 legal connection toward Flooded/Sea if possible. Phase Current — ignores Flood penalties.
enemies.behavior: Displace Heroes from objectives.
enemies.flavorText: Its body trails backward like water in a rip current.

enemies.name: Drowned Cantor
enemies.abilities: Choir Rise — Drowned allies here gain +1 Attack. Funeral Verse — first Hero healed here each Round recovers 1 less.
enemies.behavior: Stay behind ritual guards.
enemies.flavorText: Its song is heard through water and stone.

enemies.name: Sister Nerezza, Drowned Cantor
enemies.abilities: Bell-Bound — while Q054 Choir Bell remains, cannot be reduced below 14 Health. Drowned Hymn — one Drowned ally in Range may Move or Attack at -1. Crushing Chorus strips Guarded from first damaged Hero/Round.
enemies.behavior: Command Choir and punish Bell attackers.
enemies.flavorText: She conducts the sea with a broken silver censer.

enemies.name: Stormray
enemies.abilities: Storm Glide — ignores terrain movement costs. Arc Flash — if target is in Coast/Sea/Storm Location, +1 Attack.
enemies.behavior: Strike exposed Heroes.
enemies.flavorText: Blue light runs beneath translucent fins.

enemies.name: Kraken Spawn
enemies.abilities: Grapple — damaged Hero pays +1 Action for first Move before end next turn. Reach — may Attack connected Hero if none here, at -1 Attack.
enemies.behavior: Control movement near trench.
enemies.flavorText: Too small to be the thing casting the shadow beneath it.

enemies.name: Chainwarden Golem
enemies.abilities: Chain Guard — first damage to a Chain/Anchor objective here each Round is prevented. Anchored — cannot be moved. Chain Lash may pull a Hero from connected Location before Attack.
enemies.behavior: Guard Leviathan restraints.
enemies.flavorText: Its arms end in links forged for something larger than ships.

enemies.name: Tempest Herald
enemies.abilities: Call Tempest — Drowned/Sea allies here/connected gain +1 Attack. Storm Surge — once per encounter place one Gale/Flood Marker in a legal connected Location.
enemies.behavior: Support large groups.
enemies.flavorText: Lightning moves through the water dripping from its robes.

enemies.name: Admiral Serik Vane, Tidebound
enemies.abilities: Deep-Bound — while any Q060 Deep Chain remains, cannot be reduced below 16 Health. Admiral's Order — one Drowned/Sea ally in Range may Move or Attack at -1. Black-Tide Cutlass strips Inspired from first damaged Hero/Round.
enemies.behavior: Command allies and defend Chains.
enemies.flavorText: Serik still wears the coat of the man who once defended Ashenport.

enemies.name: The Leviathan Heart
enemies.abilities: Deep Pulse — move one Hero in Range or all Heroes in Range suffer -1 Attack until end next turn. Crushing Tide — attack up to 2 Heroes at -1. Endless Deep — cannot be finally defeated while Deep Chain remains. Heartshock — first Chain damage/Round hurts one Hero at L198 for1.
enemies.behavior: Control position and punish Chain interaction.
enemies.flavorText: The thing beneath the sea is too large to have a heart this close to shore.

enemies.name: Sunscar Raider
enemies.abilities: Dune Rush — after moving 2+ connections, +1 Attack. Sandstep — ignores first Difficult Terrain cost each activation.
enemies.behavior: Flank isolated Heroes/objectives.
enemies.flavorText: A scarf and curved blade are all the desert leaves visible.

enemies.name: Glass Scorpion
enemies.abilities: Glass Carapace — first ranged Attack against it each Round deals 1 less. Venom Tail — damaged Hero suffers -1 healing until end next turn.
enemies.behavior: Ambush weak Heroes.
enemies.flavorText: Its shell is transparent enough to see the venom move.

enemies.name: Cinder Zealot
enemies.abilities: Sunfire Blade — +1 Attack in Solar/Heat Location. Zeal — ignores first harmful Status each encounter on 5–6 d6.
enemies.behavior: Push objectives.
enemies.flavorText: Ash falls from armor that is never cool.

enemies.name: Mirage Stalker
enemies.abilities: False Step — may move through one blocked/Mirage connection. Afterimage — first Attack against it each Round suffers -1 Attack.
enemies.behavior: Harass backline and vanish.
enemies.flavorText: It casts three shadows and none point toward the sun.

enemies.name: Sandbound Guardian
enemies.abilities: Buried Frame — first damage suffered each Round reduced by2. Guardian Protocol — cannot be moved while near Quest objective.
enemies.behavior: Guard vaults.
enemies.flavorText: The statue moves only after the sand falls from its eyes.

enemies.name: Solar Archer
enemies.abilities: Sunshot — if target is in Desert/Solar Location, ignore1 Armor. High Ground — +1 Attack if no Hero here.
enemies.behavior: Hold range.
enemies.flavorText: Arrows leave bright lines in the darkened sky.

enemies.name: Crownscar Mage
enemies.abilities: Crownscar — one Hero in Range loses Inspired and suffers -1 Attack until end next turn. Solar Mend — Construct/Cinder ally recovers2.
enemies.behavior: Support cult/constructs.
enemies.flavorText: A piece of black glass is embedded in the mage's forehead.

enemies.name: Tomb Sentinel
enemies.abilities: Seal Guard — first damage to Seal/Ward here each Round is prevented. Tomb Anchor — cannot be moved.
enemies.behavior: Guard tomb objectives.
enemies.flavorText: The sentinel kneels until someone touches the seal.

enemies.name: Cinder Seer
enemies.abilities: Seal-Bound — while Q063 Solar Seal remains, cannot be reduced below15 Health. Burning Prophecy — one ally in Range may Move or Attack at -1. Foreseen Blow — first Hero Attack each Round against Seer suffers -1 Attack.
enemies.behavior: Control tomb and seals.
enemies.flavorText: The Seer speaks each wound before it happens.

enemies.name: Glass Revenant
enemies.abilities: Glass Body — first time each Round it suffers 5+ damage, attacker suffers1. Shard Step — after defeat, leave Shard Hazard if Quest uses hazards.
enemies.behavior: Pressure clustered Heroes.
enemies.flavorText: A dead soldier preserved inside a shell of desert glass.

enemies.name: Sunforged Golem
enemies.abilities: Sunforged Plate — first damage/Round reduced2. Heat Core — Heroes entering its Location recover 1 less Health that Round.
enemies.behavior: Hold Sunforge/palace.
enemies.flavorText: Its joints glow brighter as the eclipse darkens.

enemies.name: Eclipse Priest
enemies.abilities: Black Blessing — Cinder/Solar ally gains +1 Attack until next activation. Eclipse Veil — first healing in this Location each Round is reduced by1.
enemies.behavior: Stay behind guards.
enemies.flavorText: The priest's halo is a ring of darkness.

enemies.name: Palace Champion
enemies.abilities: Royal Guard — while guarding Ward/Crown objective, reduce first damage suffered each Round by2. Challenge — prioritizes highest-Attack Hero.
enemies.behavior: Bodyguard objectives.
enemies.flavorText: Its armor still bears an empire's erased crest.

enemies.name: Vizier Sahmet, Crown-Bound
enemies.abilities: Ward-Bound — while Q066 Mirror Ward remains, cannot be reduced below16 Health. Mirror Command — one ally in Range may Move or Attack at -1. Noon Reflection — first Attack each Round dealing 6+ damage reflects1.
enemies.behavior: Defend Palace wards.
enemies.flavorText: Sahmet has waited centuries for the Crown to return.

enemies.name: Solar Drake
enemies.abilities: Skyfire — ignores terrain costs. Solar Breath — instead of Attack, attack up to 2 Heroes in current Location at -1 Attack.
enemies.behavior: Strike exposed Heroes.
enemies.flavorText: Its wings are translucent membranes of heat.

enemies.name: Black Sun Knight
enemies.abilities: Eclipse Plate — first damage/Round reduced2. Black Sun Aura — Heroes here cannot gain Inspired while Knight is active unless explicit immunity.
enemies.behavior: Guard final routes.
enemies.flavorText: Its armor reflects the world without reflecting the sun.

enemies.name: Zenith Colossus
enemies.abilities: Anchor Armor — +1 Armor per 2 remaining Q069 Eclipse Anchors. Zenith Sweep — attack up to 2 Heroes here at -1. Immovable — cannot be moved.
enemies.behavior: Hold Black Sun Gate.
enemies.flavorText: A statue large enough to cast its own eclipse.

enemies.name: Prince Aurelian Sol, the Sunfallen
enemies.abilities: Crown-Bound — while any Q072 Solar Crown Ward remains, cannot be reduced below18 Health. Royal Decree — one Solar/Cinder ally in Range may Move or Attack at -1. Sunfall Brand strips Guarded and Inspired from first damaged Hero/Round.
enemies.behavior: Command final defenders and protect Wards.
enemies.flavorText: Aurelian wears sunlight like a wound.

enemies.name: The Fallen Sun
enemies.abilities: Solar Gravity — move one Hero in Range or all Heroes in Range suffer -1 Attack until end next turn. Corona Storm — attack up to 2 Heroes at -1. Crown Eternal — cannot be finally defeated while Ward remains. Burning Halo — first Ward damage/Round hurts one Hero at L235 for1.
enemies.behavior: Control position and punish Ward interaction.
enemies.flavorText: A star has learned the shape of a king.

locations.name: Forest Path
locations.specialRules: None.
locations.flavorText: A narrow dirt path winds through towering pines, its worn surface hinting at frequent travel by friend and foe alike.
locations.revealEffect: Fresh Tracks — Choose 1 Enemy in a connected revealed Location. That Enemy gets −1 Movement until the end of the round.
locations.firstVisitEffect: Draw 1 Travel Encounter when the first Hero enters this Location. Resolve it at Encounter Level 1.
locations.ongoingEffect: Open Trail — This Location has no inherent ongoing modifier. Apply only its Reveal, Encounter, Search, and Quest effects.
locations.designNotes: Baseline Forest connector; no combat modifiers.
locations.recommendedUses: Starting Locations; travel routes; patrol paths

locations.name: Dense Woods
locations.specialRules: Dense Undergrowth — this Location has Difficult Terrain. Limited Visibility — ranged attacks into/out suffer -1 Attack.
locations.flavorText: The forest grows thick here. Twisted roots, tangled brush, and towering pines conceal countless places for predators to hide.
locations.revealEffect: Concealing Brush — The revealing Hero may Hide.
locations.firstVisitEffect: Draw 1 Travel Encounter when the first Hero enters this Location. Resolve it at Encounter Level 1.
locations.ongoingEffect: Dense Undergrowth — this Location has Difficult Terrain. Limited Visibility — ranged attacks into/out suffer -1 Attack.
locations.designNotes: Tactical chokepoint; slows movement and ranged combat.

locations.name: Woodland Clearing
locations.specialRules: Open Sightlines — ranged attacks within/into/out gain +1 Attack. No Cover — figures here cannot benefit from Cover.
locations.flavorText: Sunlight pours through the broken canopy, illuminating a peaceful clearing untouched by the darkness surrounding it.
locations.revealEffect: Quiet Respite — Each Hero here may recover 1 Health.
locations.firstVisitEffect: Draw 1 Travel Encounter when the first Hero enters this Location. Resolve it at Encounter Level 1.
locations.ongoingEffect: Open Sightlines — ranged attacks within/into/out gain +1 Attack. No Cover — figures here cannot benefit from Cover.
locations.designNotes: Four-way hub; opposite of Dense Woods.

locations.name: River Crossing
locations.specialRules: Swift Current — this Location has Difficult Terrain. Exposed Crossing — no Cover.
locations.flavorText: A shallow river cuts across the forest floor. Though easy enough to cross, the rushing water leaves travelers exposed.
locations.revealEffect: Fresh Water — The revealing Hero may recover 1 Health or remove 1 Poison Token.
locations.firstVisitEffect: Draw 1 Travel Encounter when the first Hero enters this Location. Resolve it at Encounter Level 1.
locations.ongoingEffect: Swift Current — this Location has Difficult Terrain. Exposed Crossing — no Cover.

locations.name: Ancient Ruins
locations.specialRules: Crumbling Walls — figures gain Cover vs ranged. Unstable Masonry — first Push/Knockback each round is prevented.
locations.flavorText: Broken stone arches and weathered statues stand as the last reminders of a kingdom swallowed by the forest centuries ago.
locations.revealEffect: Forgotten Remains — The revealing Hero may immediately Search this Location without spending an Action.
locations.firstVisitEffect: Draw 1 Travel Encounter when the first Hero enters this Location. Resolve it at Encounter Level 1. After the Encounter resolves: Forgotten Cache — draw 1 Item card; if no Item Deck, gain 25 Gold.
locations.ongoingEffect: Crumbling Walls — figures gain Cover vs ranged. Unstable Masonry — first Push/Knockback each round is prevented.
locations.designNotes: First defensive terrain and Search reward.

locations.name: Goblin Lookout
locations.specialRules: Quest Trigger (Q001, Q003). High Ground — ranged attacks gain +1 Attack. Raised Alarm — first Enemy revealed here places 1 Alert Token on Quest or equivalent.
locations.flavorText: Built from rough timber lashed together with rope, the lookout tower rises above the trees.
locations.revealEffect: Abandoned Supplies — Gain 10 Gold.
locations.firstVisitEffect: Draw 1 Travel Encounter when the first Hero enters this Location. Resolve it at Encounter Level 2. After the Encounter resolves: Abandoned Supplies — draw 1 Item card or gain 1 Consumable.
locations.ongoingEffect: High Ground — ranged attacks gain +1 Attack. Raised Alarm — first Enemy revealed here places 1 Alert Token on Quest or equivalent.

locations.name: Abandoned Campsite
locations.specialRules: Temporary Shelter — at end of Hero activation, remove 1 Fatigue or recover 1 Stamina (per final resource rules). Old Fire Pit — first Hero to search gains +1 Morale/equivalent.
locations.flavorText: Cold ashes fill the fire pit, and abandoned bedrolls lie scattered beneath the trees.
locations.revealEffect: Left-Behind Supplies — Draw 1 source-matched Loot.
locations.firstVisitEffect: Draw 1 Travel Encounter when the first Hero enters this Location. Resolve it at Encounter Level 1. After the Encounter resolves: Left Behind — draw 1 Search card; if Item, active Hero claims it.
locations.ongoingEffect: Temporary Shelter — at end of Hero activation, remove 1 Fatigue or recover 1 Stamina (per final resource rules). Old Fire Pit — first Hero to search gains +1 Morale/equivalent.
locations.designNotes: Respite/story Location; resource terms pending final system.

locations.name: Spider Nest

locations.name: Stonebrook
locations.specialRules: Safe Haven — Heroes may not be targeted by random encounter effects while in Stonebrook unless a Quest states otherwise. Village Services — outside a Quest, Heroes may purchase/sell Equipment, recover all Health, and remove all Conditions. Gather Information — once per visit, one Hero may draw 1 Search card.

locations.firstVisitEffect: None — Stonebrook is the starting hub and does not trigger a first-visit Encounter.
locations.ongoingEffect: Safe Haven — Heroes may not be targeted by random encounter effects while in Stonebrook unless a Quest states otherwise. Village Services — outside a Quest, Heroes may purchase/sell Equipment, recover all Health, and remove all Conditions. Gather Information — once per visit, one Hero may draw 1 Search card.

locations.recommendedUses: Starting Location; Quest Hub; Trading; Recovery

locations.name: Valewatch

An active Quest may suspend or replace these benefits.

locations.designNotes: Primary Campaign II hub; replaces Stonebrook as the default between-Quest staging point while in the Crownlands.
