quests.name: Defend Stonebrook
quests.story: Stonebrook comes under attack. Rescue villagers, extinguish fires, and discover the source of the assault.
quests.locationPool: Include L001 Forest Path; L003 Woodland Clearing; L006 Goblin Lookout; L007 Abandoned Campsite; L017 Fallen Watchtower; L036 Hunter's Lodge; L043 Foggy Meadow; L047 Merchant Caravan.
quests.enemyDeck: E001 Goblin Raider ×4; E002 Goblin Archer ×2; E004 Goblin Scout ×2; E006 Goblin Captain ×1.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Start: 2 Goblin Raiders + 1 Goblin Archer in Stonebrook. Place 4 Villager Tokens in Stonebrook and Fire Tokens beside the Quest Card.
quests.questRules: At end of each Enemy Phase, if Goblin Captain is not in play, spawn 1 Goblin Raider in Stonebrook and one fire token. When Goblin Lookout (L006) is revealed, spawn Goblin Captain + 1 Goblin Scout there; Stonebrook reinforcements stop. If Goblin Captain is in play, spawn 1 Goblin Raider. Hero may spend 1 Action to remove 1 Fire Token. Hero may spend 1 Action to escort 1 Villager Token. Goblins will always attack villagers first.
quests.winningConditions: Defeat the Goblin Captain; rescue at least 2 Villagers; Stonebrook has fewer than 5 Fire Tokens.
quests.losingConditions: All Heroes defeated; all Villagers lost; Stonebrook reaches 5 Fire Tokens.
quests.rewards: 100 XP; 75 Gold; draw 1 Equipment Card; +1 General Reputation.+15 Gold if 4 villagers survive.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Return to WE001 and choose another available quest.
quests.locationConsistency: 8-tile pool; multiple Forest/Road/Meadow hubs support L006/L017/L036 objective routing.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: At each scripted combat spawn, remove 1 ordinary non-Boss Enemy (minimum 1 Enemy). End-of-Enemy-Phase Raider reinforcement occurs every other round. 2 Heroes: use printed setup. 3 Heroes: add 1 E001 Goblin Raider to Stonebrook start and to the L006 reveal spawn. 4 Heroes: as 3 Heroes, plus add 1 E002 Goblin Archer to Stonebrook start; after Captain enters play, the recurring Raider spawn becomes 2 Raiders.
quests.balanceNotes: Q001 scales bodies rather than Villager/Fire thresholds; objective remains identical.

quests.name: Rescue the Merchant Caravan
quests.story: A merchant caravan carrying food, weapons, and medical supplies failed to arrive in Stonebrook. Recover the caravan before its cargo is lost to the enemy.
quests.locationPool: Include L001 Forest Path; L003 Woodland Clearing; L004 River Crossing; L007 Abandoned Campsite; L010 Goblin Encampment; L013 Ancient Stone Bridge; L043 Foggy Meadow; L047 Merchant Caravan.
quests.enemyDeck: E001 Goblin Raider ×5; E002 Goblin Archer ×2; E004 Goblin Scout ×2; E006 Goblin Captain ×1.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: When Merchant Caravan (L047) is revealed, place 2 Wagon Tokens there, each with 3 Supply Tokens; spawn 2 Goblin Raiders + 1 Goblin Scout there.
quests.questRules: A Wagon cannot move unless escorted by a Hero in its Location. A Hero may spend 1 Action to move one Wagon to a connected Location. When a Wagon reaches Stonebrook, remove it; it is rescued. If a Goblin begins its activation in a Location with an unattended Wagon, remove 1 Supply Token from that Wagon. A Wagon at 0 Supply is destroyed.  Goblin Reinforcements — At the end of each Enemy Phase while the Goblin Captain is not in play, spawn 1 Goblin Raider at the Location of the Hero farthest from a Wagon. After the first Raider is spawned this way, spawn 1 Goblin Archer at the Merchant Caravan. After the second Raider is spawned this way, spawn 1 Goblin Scout at the Merchant Caravan. After the third Raider is spawned this way, spawn the Goblin Captain and 1 Goblin Archer at the Merchant Caravan. Once the Goblin Captain enters play, stop resolving Goblin Reinforcements. QUEST ITEMS — The first time L047 Merchant Caravan is Searched during this Quest, gain LT123 Caravan Manifest instead of a normal Search Loot reward. When the Goblin Captain is defeated, gain LT119 Merchant Strongbox Key. A Hero at L047 carrying LT119 may spend 1 Action to open the strongbox; return LT119 to the Loot Deck and draw 1 source-matched Loot from Merchant/Caravan sources. LT123 remains a Quest Item until the Quest ends, then return it to the Loot Deck.
quests.winningConditions: Rescue both Wagons and deliver at least 4 total Supply Tokens to Stonebrook.
quests.losingConditions: Both Wagons destroyed; all Heroes defeated.
quests.rewards: 125 XP; 100 Gold; draw 1 Equipment Card; gain 1 Supply for the next quest.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Return to WE001.
quests.locationConsistency: 8-tile pool; Forest/Road/Meadow connectors provide multiple routes to L047 and L010.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: L047 reveal spawn is 1 E001 + 1 E004; recurring Raider reinforcement occurs every other round. 2 Heroes: use printed setup. 3 Heroes: add 1 E001 at L047 reveal. 4 Heroes: add 1 E001 + 1 E002 at L047 reveal; recurring reinforcement adds 1 extra E001 on its third occurrence only.
quests.balanceNotes: Wagon/Supply objective stays fixed; scaling changes escort pressure.

quests.name: Clear the Abandoned Watchtower
quests.story: Goblin scouts have occupied an old watchtower overlooking the frontier. Reclaim it and relight its warning beacon.
quests.locationPool: Include L001 Forest Path; L002 Dense Woods; L003 Woodland Clearing; L005 Ancient Ruins; L009 Rocky Pass; L017 Fallen Watchtower; L036 Hunter's Lodge; L043 Foggy Meadow.
quests.enemyDeck: E004 Goblin Scout ×5; E002 Goblin Archer ×3; E001 Goblin Raider ×2.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: When Fallen Watchtower (L017) is revealed, place 2 Goblin Scouts, 1 Goblin Archer, and the Beacon Token there.
quests.questRules: LIGHT THE BEACON: A Hero in Fallen Watchtower may spend 2 Actions to light the Beacon. While the Beacon is unlit, Goblin Scouts gain +1 Range. Once the Beacon is lit, all Goblin Scouts lose 1 Movement for the remainder of the Quest. WATCHTOWER REINFORCEMENTS: At the end of each Enemy Phase while the Beacon is unlit, spawn 1 Goblin Scout at Fallen Watchtower. After the first reinforcement is spawned, also spawn 1 Goblin Raider. After the second reinforcement is spawned, also spawn 1 Goblin Archer. After the third reinforcement is spawned, also spawn 1 Goblin Raider. Once the Beacon is lit, Watchtower Reinforcements immediately stop. QUEST ITEMS —  After defeating Goblin Raider gain LT118 Watchtower Vault Key; a Hero carrying LT118 may spend 1 Action there to open the sealed armory, return LT118 to the Loot Deck, and draw 1 Equipment Card.
quests.winningConditions: Defeat all enemies occupying Fallen Watchtower and light the Beacon.
quests.losingConditions: All Heroes defeated; after Fallen Watchtower is revealed, 3 consecutive rounds pass with no Hero occupying it.
quests.rewards: 75 XP; 50 Gold; +1 General Reputation; during WE002 reduce first Travel Encounter by 1 Goblin Scout.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Optional WE001 bonus.
quests.locationConsistency: 8-tile pool; added Forest/Ruins/Hills connectors to provide multiple legal routes to L017.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: L017 reveal spawn is 1 E004 + 1 E002; Watchtower reinforcement occurs every other round. 2 Heroes: use printed setup. 3 Heroes: add 1 E004 at reveal. 4 Heroes: add 1 E004 + 1 E001 at reveal; first reinforcement also adds 1 E004.
quests.balanceNotes: Beacon cost and 3-round loss clock remain fixed.

quests.name: Into the Dark Forest
quests.story: Goblin warbands have disappeared into the wilderness, establishing hidden camps and launching raids. Track them and locate the main encampment.
quests.locationPool: Include L001 Forest Path; L002 Dense Woods; L003 Woodland Clearing; L006 Goblin Lookout; L007 Abandoned Campsite; L010 Goblin Encampment; L019 Goblin War Camp; L022 Hidden Grove; L043 Foggy Meadow.
quests.enemyDeck: E001 Goblin Raider ×4; E004 Goblin Scout ×4; E002 Goblin Archer ×3; E013 Goblin Wolf Rider ×2; E010 Goblin War Chief ×1.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Start with 2 Goblin Scouts in the first revealed non-Stonebrook Location. Place 3 Trail Marker Tokens beside Quest Card.
quests.questRules:
FOLLOW THE TRAIL: Place 1 Trail Marker whenever a Hero reveals a new Forest Location. When all 3 Trail Markers have been placed, immediately shuffle L019 – Goblin War Camp into the top 3 cards of the Location Deck if it has not already been revealed. 
While the Goblin War Camp is unrevealed, Goblin Scouts gain +1 Movement. GOBLIN PATROLS: When the first Trail Marker is placed, spawn 1 Goblin Raider in the newly revealed Location. When the second Trail Marker is placed, spawn 1 Goblin Archer + 1 Goblin Raider in the newly revealed Location. When the third Trail Marker is placed, spawn 1 Goblin Wolf Rider + 1 Goblin Scout in the newly revealed Location.WAR CAMP REVEALED: When L019 – Goblin War Camp is revealed, spawn: 1 Goblin War Chief, 1 Goblin Wolf Rider, 2 Goblin Raiders,  
1 Goblin Archer. Place them in the Goblin War Camp.
quests.winningConditions: Reveal the Goblin War Camp and defeat the Goblin War Chief.
quests.losingConditions: All Heroes defeated; Location Deck is exhausted before Goblin War Camp is revealed.
quests.rewards: 150 XP; 125 Gold; draw 1 Rare Equipment Card.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Unlock Q005.
quests.locationConsistency: 9-tile pool; seven non-objective tiles provide branching Forest exploration before gated L019.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: remove the first Trail-Marker E001 patrol; War Camp reveal removes 1 E001. 2 Heroes: use printed setup. 3 Heroes: add 1 E001 at War Camp reveal. 4 Heroes: add 1 E001 + 1 E002 at War Camp reveal.
quests.balanceNotes: War Chief remains single-copy; Trail requirement remains 3.

quests.name: Destroy the War Camp
quests.story: The goblins' forward operating base has been discovered. Destroy its supplies, eliminate its commander, and scatter the warband before it can reinforce the siege.
quests.locationPool: Include L001 Forest Path; L003 Woodland Clearing; L006 Goblin Lookout; L007 Abandoned Campsite; L010 Goblin Encampment; L017 Fallen Watchtower; L019 Goblin War Camp; L036 Hunter's Lodge; L043 Foggy Meadow.
quests.enemyDeck: E001 Goblin Raider ×5; E002 Goblin Archer ×3; E013 Goblin Wolf Rider ×2; E010 Goblin War Chief ×1; E016 Goblin Siege Engineer ×1.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: When L019 – Goblin War Camp is revealed, place 4 Supply Crate Tokens there and spawn: 2 Goblin Raiders, 1 Goblin Archer. Place 2 Alarm Tokens beside the Quest Card.
quests.questRules: DESTROY SUPPLIES: A Hero in the Goblin War Camp may spend 1 Action to destroy 1 Supply Crate. FIRST ALARM: When the second Supply Crate is destroyed, place the first Alarm Token and spawn:1 Goblin Archer, 1 Goblin Wolf Rider. SECOND ALARM: When the third Supply Crate is destroyed, place the second Alarm Token and spawn: 1 Goblin War Chief, 1 Goblin Siege Engineer, 1 Goblin Raider. FINAL DEFENSE: When the fourth Supply Crate is destroyed, spawn: 1 Goblin Wolf Rider, 1 Goblin Archer.CAMP REINFORCEMENTS: At the end of each Enemy Phase while at least 1 Supply Crate remains, spawn 1 Goblin Raider in the Goblin War Camp. If all Supply Crates have been destroyed, Camp Reinforcements immediately stop.
quests.winningConditions: Destroy all 4 Supply Crates and defeat the Goblin War Chief.
quests.rewards: 175 XP; 150 Gold; draw 1 Rare Equipment Card; remove 1 Elite Goblin from Q007 setup.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Advance progress toward WE003.
quests.locationConsistency: 9-tile pool; multiple Forest/Goblin-route connectors support reliable progression to L019.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: War Camp reveal is 1 E001 + 1 E002; Camp Reinforcement occurs every other round. 2 Heroes: use printed setup. 3 Heroes: add 1 E001 at War Camp reveal. 4 Heroes: add 1 E001 + 1 E002 at reveal; Camp Reinforcement becomes 2 E001 each round while Crates remain.

quests.campaignFollowOn: Optional WE002 bonus.
quests.locationConsistency: 10-tile pool; Forest/Goblin/Fortress chain supports reliable progression to L023.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: Prison Pens reveal removes 1 E001; first-prisoner Saboteur spawn is delayed until the second Prisoner freed. 2 Heroes: use printed setup. 3 Heroes: add 1 E001 at reveal. 4 Heroes: add 1 E001 + 1 E002 at reveal; third-Prisoner reinforcement adds 1 extra E001.
quests.balanceNotes: Prisoner count, rescue target, and execution threshold remain fixed.

quests.name: Burn the Supply Lines
quests.story: The goblin siege cannot continue without food, weapons, and ammunition. Destroy the supply convoy before it reaches the besieging army.
quests.locationPool: Include L001 Forest Path; L003 Woodland Clearing; L004 River Crossing; L006 Goblin Lookout; L007 Abandoned Campsite; L013 Ancient Stone Bridge; L036 Hunter's Lodge; L043 Foggy Meadow; L047 Merchant Caravan.
quests.enemyDeck: E001 Goblin Raider ×5; E002 Goblin Archer ×3; E013 Goblin Wolf Rider ×2; E006 Goblin Captain ×1.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: When L047 – Merchant Caravan is revealed: Place 3 Supply Wagon Tokens there. Spawn: 2 Goblin Raiders, 1 Goblin Archer, 1 Goblin Captain, 1 Goblin Wolf Rider.
quests.questRules: At end of each Enemy Phase, each Supply Wagon moves 1 connected Location away from Stonebrook toward the quest's designated exit path if possible. A Hero in a Wagon's Location may spend 1 Action to place 1 Sabotage Token on it. A Wagon with 2 Sabotage Tokens is destroyed. Wolf Riders prioritize protecting the nearest Wagon. CONVOY REINFORCEMENTS: At the end of each Enemy Phase, after the Wagons move, spawn 1 Goblin Raider at the Wagon farthest from Stonebrook. FIRST WAGON DESTROYED: Spawn 1 Goblin Archer at the surviving Wagon farthest from Stonebrook. SECOND WAGON DESTROYED: Spawn 1 Goblin Wolf Rider + 1 Goblin Archer at the final surviving Wagon. SUPPLY LINES DESTROYED: Once all 3 Supply Wagons are destroyed, Convoy Reinforcements immediately stop.
quests.winningConditions: Destroy all 3 Supply Wagons.
quests.losingConditions: Any 2 Supply Wagons escape; all Heroes defeated.
quests.rewards: 175 XP; 150 Gold; draw 1 Rare Equipment Card; remove 1 Siege Engine from Q008.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Weakens Q008.
quests.locationConsistency: 9-tile pool; multiple Road/Forest/Meadow crossings support wagon-route branching.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: L047 reveal removes 1 E001; Convoy Raider reinforcement occurs every other round. 2 Heroes: use printed setup. 3 Heroes: add 1 E001 at reveal. 4 Heroes: add 1 E001 + 1 E002 at reveal; Convoy Reinforcement spawns 2 E001 each round.
quests.balanceNotes: Three Wagons and Sabotage requirements remain fixed.

quests.name: Break the Siege
quests.story: Stonebrook's defenses are failing under relentless bombardment. Destroy the siege engines before the settlement's defenses collapse.
quests.locationPool: Include L001 Forest Path; L003 Woodland Clearing; L006 Goblin Lookout; L010 Goblin Encampment; L017 Fallen Watchtower; L019 Goblin War Camp; L020 Goblin Fortress Gate; L036 Hunter's Lodge; L043 Foggy Meadow; L047 Merchant Caravan.
quests.enemyDeck: E001 Goblin Raider ×6; E002 Goblin Archer ×4; E016 Goblin Siege Engineer ×2; E015 Goblin Champion ×1.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Place Stonebrook Wall Track at 6. When the first valid Goblin Structure/War Camp Location is revealed: Place Siege Engine #1 there and spawn: 1 Goblin Siege Engineer, 2 Goblin Raiders, 1 Goblin Archer. When the second valid Goblin Structure/War Camp Location is revealed: Place Siege Engine #2 there and spawn: 1 Goblin Siege Engineer, 2 Goblin Raiders, 1 Goblin Archer.
quests.questRules: BOMBARDMENT: At the end of each Enemy Phase, each active Siege Engine removes 1 Wall from the Stonebrook Wall Track. SIEGE REINFORCEMENTS: At the end of each Enemy Phase, after resolving Bombardment, spawn 1 Goblin Raider at an active Siege Engine. If both Siege Engines are active, spawn the Raider at the Siege Engine with the fewest Goblin enemies. If tied, the Heroes choose. If no Siege Engines remain active, Siege Reinforcements stop. WALL AT 4: The first time the Stonebrook Wall Track reaches 4 or less, spawn 1 Goblin Archer at an active Siege Engine. WALL AT 2: The first time the Stonebrook Wall Track reaches 2 or less, spawn 1 Goblin Archer at an active Siege Engine. FINAL DEFENDER: When the second Siege Engine is destroyed, immediately spawn E015 Goblin Champion in the nearest revealed Goblin Structure.
quests.winningConditions: Destroy both Siege Engines and defeat the Goblin Champion.
quests.losingConditions: Stonebrook Wall Track reaches 0; all Heroes defeated.
quests.rewards: 200 XP; 175 Gold; draw 1 Epic Equipment Card.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Required WE003 quest.
quests.locationConsistency: 10-tile pool; expanded approach network provides multiple routes toward L019/L020.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: each Siege Engine reveal spawn removes 1 E001; Siege Reinforcement occurs every other round. 2 Heroes: use printed setup. 3 Heroes: first Siege Engine reveal adds 1 E001. 4 Heroes: each Siege Engine reveal adds 1 E001; Siege Reinforcement spawns 2 E001 while both engines are active.
quests.balanceNotes: Wall Track and two Siege Engines stay fixed. Siege Engine combat stats still need print-lock definition.

quests.name: Rescue Captain Roland
quests.story: Captain Roland, commander of Stonebrook's militia, has been captured. Without his leadership, morale is failing. Find and rescue him before time runs out.
quests.locationPool: Include L009 Rocky Pass; L012 Cave Entrance; L018 Abandoned Mine; L026 Crystal Cavern; L028 Mushroom Grove; L029 Collapsed Tunnel; L031 Goblin Mines; L034 Echoing Chamber; L023 Prison Pens.
quests.enemyDeck: E001 Goblin Raider ×3; E002 Goblin Archer ×2; E006 Goblin Captain ×1; E011 Goblin Saboteur ×1.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: When L023 – Prison Pens is revealed: Place the Captain Roland Token in the Prison Pens. Spawn: 2 Goblin Raiders, 1 Goblin Archer, 1 Goblin Captain. Place the Execution Track at 5.
quests.questRules: EXECUTION TRACK: At the end of each Enemy Phase, reduce the Execution Track by 1. If the Execution Track reaches 0 before Roland is freed, the Quest is lost. PRISON BREAK:  A player can use an action to free Captain Roland. when Captain Roland is freed, immediately spawn: 1 Goblin Saboteur, 1 Goblin Archer, 1 Goblin Raider. Spawn them in the Prison Pens. Once Roland is freed, stop reducing the Execution Track. Remove the Execution Track from play.Roland moves with the rescuing Hero. Once freed, Roland has Attack 2 and may defend himself as an Ally. CAPTAIN ROLAND: Roland has 5 Health and Attack 2. If Roland is defeated after being freed, the Quest is immediately lost.
quests.winningConditions: Escort Captain Roland safely to Stonebrook.
quests.losingConditions: Execution Track reaches 0; all Heroes defeated.
quests.rewards: 125 XP; 100 Gold; +2 General Reputation; Captain Roland assists during Q010, allowing 1 additional Ally at setup.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Optional WE003 bonus.
quests.locationConsistency: 9-tile pool; Hills→Cave/Mine chain provides multiple underground routes toward the prison objective.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: Prison Pens reveal removes 1 E001; prison-break spawn is E011 + E001. 2 Heroes: use printed setup. 3 Heroes: add 1 E001 at reveal. 4 Heroes: add 1 E001 + 1 E002 at reveal; prison-break spawn adds 1 extra E001.
quests.balanceNotes: Execution Track stays 5 because exploration distance, not enemy count, is the primary timer.

quests.name: Assault the Fortress Gate
quests.story: The Goblin King's fortress stands between the heroes and the end of the invasion. Break through the defenses and establish a foothold within the stronghold.
quests.locationPool: Include L001 Forest Path; L003 Woodland Clearing; L006 Goblin Lookout; L009 Rocky Pass; L012 Cave Entrance; L017 Fallen Watchtower; L018 Abandoned Mine; L019 Goblin War Camp; L020 Goblin Fortress Gate; L031 Goblin Mines.
quests.enemyDeck: E001 Goblin Raider ×6; E002 Goblin Archer ×4; E018 Goblin Chieftain's Bodyguard ×2; E015 Goblin Champion ×1; E016 Goblin Siege Engineer ×1.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: When L020 – Goblin Fortress Gate is revealed: Place the Fortress Gate objective at 12 Health. Place 2 Ballista Tokens at the Fortress Gate or connected Goblin Structure Locations. Spawn at the Fortress Gate: 3 Goblin Raiders, 2 Goblin Archers, 1 Goblin Siege Engineer.
quests.questRules: Heroes may attack Fortress Gate. BALLISTAS: At the end of each Enemy Phase, each Ballista attacks the nearest Hero. Destroying both Ballistas reduces the Fortress Gate's Armor by 2. FIELD REPAIRS: While the Goblin Siege Engineer is in play, the first destroyed Ballista is placed beside the Quest Card instead of being discarded. At the end of the next Enemy Phase, if the Siege Engineer is still in play, return that Ballista to the Fortress Gate with full Health. A Ballista can only be repaired once. FORTRESS REINFORCEMENTS: The first time the Fortress Gate reaches 6 Health or less, immediately spawn:  1 Goblin Champion, 2 Goblin Chieftain's Bodyguards, at the Fortress Gate. GATE REINFORCEMENTS: At the end of each Enemy Phase while the Fortress Gate remains standing, spawn 1 Goblin Raider at the Fortress Gate. Once the Fortress Gate is destroyed, Gate Reinforcements stop. hen the first Ballista is destroyed, spawn 1 Goblin Archer at the Fortress Gate. When the second Ballista is destroyed, spawn 1 Goblin Archer at the Fortress Gate.
quests.winningConditions: Destroy the Fortress Gate and defeat the Goblin Champion.
quests.losingConditions: All Heroes defeated; 4 consecutive rounds pass after Gate is revealed with no Hero in the Gate Location or an adjacent valid assault Location.
quests.rewards: 225 XP; 200 Gold; draw 1 Epic Equipment Card.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Opens Q011.
quests.locationConsistency: 10-tile pool; expanded Forest→Hills/Cave/Mine→Stronghold approach reduces dead-end risk.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: Gate reveal spawn is 2 E001 + 1 E002 + E016; Gate Reinforcement occurs every other round. 2 Heroes: use printed setup. 3 Heroes: add 1 E001 at Gate reveal. 4 Heroes: add 1 E001 + 1 E002 at Gate reveal; Gate Reinforcement spawns 2 E001 each round.
quests.balanceNotes: Ballistas remain 8 Health / 2 Armor / Attack 4 / Range 3; Gate remains 12 Health, Armor 4, reduced to 2 after both Ballistas are destroyed.

quests.name: Through the Stronghold
quests.story: With the gate breached, the heroes fight through the stronghold toward the throne room while the Goblin King prepares his final defense.
quests.locationPool: Include L019 Goblin War Camp; L020 Goblin Fortress Gate; L021 Goblin Throne Room; L023 Prison Pens; L024 Ritual Circle; L025 Treasure Vault; L031 Goblin Mines; L018 Abandoned Mine; L010 Goblin Encampment.
quests.enemyDeck: E001 Goblin Raider ×5; E018 Goblin Chieftain's Bodyguard ×2; E002 Goblin Archer ×3; E017 Goblin Witch Doctor ×2; E019 Goblin High Shaman ×1.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Start with 2 Goblin Raiders at L020 – Goblin Fortress Gate. Place 3 Reinforcement Tokens beside the Quest Card.
quests.questRules: Reinforcement Token #1: The first time a Hero reveals a new Fortress or Goblin Stronghold Location: Remove 1 Reinforcement Token. Spawn: 1 Goblin Raider, 1 Goblin Archer, in the newly revealed Location. Reinforcement Token #2: The second time a qualifying Location is revealed: Remove 1 Reinforcement Token. Spawn: 1 Goblin Chieftain's Bodyguard, 1 Goblin Witch Doctor, in the newly revealed Location. Reinforcement Token #3: The third time a qualifying Location is revealed: Remove the final Reinforcement Token. Spawn: 1 Goblin, Chieftain's Bodyguard, 1 Goblin Archer, 1 Goblin Witch Doctor, in the newly revealed Location. If L021 – Goblin Throne Room has already been revealed, immediately spawn E019 Goblin High Shaman there. Otherwise, place the High Shaman beside the Quest Card. When the Goblin Throne Room is revealed, immediately spawn him there. When L021 – Goblin Throne Room is revealed: Spawn 1 Goblin Raider + 1 Goblin Archer there. If the Goblin High Shaman is waiting beside the Quest Card, spawn him there as well. Heroes may not Long Rest during Q011. The Goblin Throne Room cannot be entered until at least two other Fortress/Goblin Stronghold Locations have been revealed.
quests.winningConditions: Reach the Goblin Throne Room and defeat every enemy within it.
quests.rewards: 250 XP; 200 Gold; draw 1 Epic Equipment Card.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Unlocks Q012.
quests.locationConsistency: 9-tile pool; expanded Goblin Stronghold/Fortress/Mine network supports branching progression to L021.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: start with 1 E001; remove E018 from Reinforcement Token #2. 2 Heroes: use printed setup. 3 Heroes: start with +1 E001. 4 Heroes: start with +1 E001 + 1 E002; Reinforcement Token #3 also adds 1 E001.
quests.balanceNotes: High Shaman remains single-copy; no Long Rest rule unchanged.

quests.name: The Goblin King
quests.story: The Goblin King awaits upon his throne, surrounded by the banners of every conquered tribe. His defeat will shatter the alliance and end the invasion.
quests.locationPool: Include L020 Goblin Fortress Gate; L021 Goblin Throne Room; L023 Prison Pens; L024 Ritual Circle; L025 Treasure Vault.
quests.enemyDeck: E032 The Goblin King ×1; E018 Goblin Chieftain's Bodyguard ×2; E019 Goblin High Shaman ×1; plus Elite Goblins as directed.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Place L021 – Goblin Throne Room. Place: E032 The Goblin King, 2 Goblin Chieftain's Bodyguards, 1 Goblin High Shaman, and 4 Banner Tokens.
quests.questRules: BANNERS OF THE HORDE: The Goblin King cannot lose Health while 2 or more Banner Tokens remain. A Hero in the Goblin Throne Room may spend 1 Action to destroy 1 Banner Token. First Banner destroyed: Spawn: 1 Elite Goblin Raider. Second Banner destroyed Spawn: 1 Elite Goblin Archer. Third Banner destroyed. Spawn: 1 Elite Goblin Raider. Fourth/final Banner destroyed: When the final Banner is destroyed, the Goblin King immediately activates.
quests.winningConditions: Destroy all 4 Banner Tokens and defeat the final Goblin boss.
quests.rewards: 300 XP to each Hero; 1 Legendary Equipment Card per Hero; +3 General Reputation; unlock Defender of Stonebrook; complete Campaign 1.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Campaign Victory.
quests.locationConsistency: 5-tile finale pool centered on L021 with adjacent Fortress/Goblin Stronghold locations.
quests.enemyConsistency: Uses dedicated E032 – The Goblin King with E018/E019 support.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: start with E032 + 1 E018 + 4 Banners; Banner spawns occur only on banners 2 and 4. 2 Heroes: use printed setup. 3 Heroes: add 1 E002 at setup. 4 Heroes: add 1 E001 + 1 E002 at setup; final Banner also spawns 1 E006 Goblin Captain.
quests.balanceNotes: Uses dedicated E032 Goblin King. Do not add a second Last Stand: E032 already contains the half-Health immediate activation and twice-per-Enemy-Phase rule.

quests.name: The Missing Caravan
quests.story: A merchant convoy from the Stonebrook road never reached Valewatch. The Crown Watch found blood on the road but no wagons and too few bodies. The Heroes must follow the trail, rescue survivors, and discover why someone removed the dead.
quests.locationPool: Include L052 King's Road; L053 Waystone Crossing; L054 Old Tollhouse; L055 Abandoned Coach House; L056 Briarwood Verge; L057 Crownland Ford; L058 Crownland Farm; L059 Roadside Shrine; L060 Abandoned Manor; L061 Watch Outpost.
quests.enemyDeck: E033 Street Cutthroat ×4; E034 Crossbow Thug ×2; E036 Veiled Agent ×1; E039 Sewer Stalker ×1.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Place 3 Trail/Evidence markers in a pool. The first time Heroes successfully Search L054, L055, or L060, place 1 marker on that Location. When L055 – Abandoned Coach House is revealed, place 2 Survivor Tokens and spawn E033 ×2 + E034 ×1 there.
quests.questRules: FOLLOW THE TRAIL: The party must collect 2 Trail/Evidence markers before Survivors can be escorted. RESCUE: A Hero in L055 may spend 1 Action to free 1 Survivor; a freed Survivor follows that Hero and is lost if left in a Location containing an Enemy at end of Enemy Phase. AMBUSH LEADER: When the second Survivor is freed, spawn E036 Veiled Agent at a legal connected Location. If defeated, gain Black Wax Seal evidence.
quests.winningConditions: Rescue both Survivors, collect at least 2 Evidence, and defeat the Veiled Agent.
quests.losingConditions: Both Survivors are lost; all Heroes are Defeated.
quests.rewards: 100 XP; 100 Gold; draw 1 Equipment Card; retain LT161 Black Wax Seal as Campaign evidence.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Unlock Q014 and Q015. Return to WE005.
quests.locationConsistency: 10-tile Crownlands road pool with multiple Road/Meadow/Forest paths; L055 is the primary objective site.
quests.enemyConsistency: Uses new E033/E034/E036 with optional E039 encounter pressure.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: L055 spawn is E033 + E034; Veiled Agent still spawns. 2 Heroes: printed setup. 3 Heroes: add 1 E033 at L055. 4 Heroes: add 1 E033 + 1 E034 at L055.
quests.balanceNotes: Investigation objective is fixed; scale enemy bodies only.

quests.name: Blood in the Alleys
quests.story: Murders spread through the Low Ward. The victims appear unrelated until the Heroes begin comparing symbols, routes, and missing possessions. Someone is killing witnesses faster than the Watch can protect them.
quests.locationPool: Include L064 Crown Gate; L065 Grand Market; L066 Gilded Ward; L067 Temple Square; L068 Scholar's Row; L069 Low Ward; L070 River Docks; L071 Warehouse District; L072 Old Quarter; L074 Bell Tower Square.
quests.enemyDeck: E033 Street Cutthroat ×3; E034 Crossbow Thug ×2; E035 Masked Acolyte ×3; E036 Veiled Agent ×2; E047 Faceless Killer ×1.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Place Murder Track at 0 and 4 Evidence Tokens in the supply. The first successful Search in L069, L070, L071, and L072 gains 1 Evidence. When the party reaches 3 Evidence, place E047 Faceless Killer at the farthest revealed Urban Location with a legal connection path.
quests.questRules: MURDER TRACK: At end of each Enemy Phase, if the party has fewer than 3 Evidence, increase Murder Track by 1. At 2 and 4, spawn E033 at a revealed Urban edge Location. EXPOSE THE KILLER: E047 cannot use Smoke and Mirrors while a Hero carrying Evidence is in its Location. CULT REVEAL: The first Masked Acolyte defeated grants the phrase 'Quiet Crown.'
quests.winningConditions: Gain 3 Evidence and defeat E047 Faceless Killer.
quests.losingConditions: Murder Track reaches 6; all Heroes are Defeated.
quests.rewards: 125 XP; 125 Gold; +1 General Reputation; draw 1 Rare Equipment Card.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Complete the required WE005 path and reveal the Quiet Crown. Return to WE005; if Q013 is also completed, WE006 may begin.
quests.locationConsistency: Urban investigation pool; four evidence districts prevent a single mandatory path.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: first Murder Track spawn is skipped. 2 Heroes: printed. 3 Heroes: add 1 E035 when E047 appears. 4 Heroes: add 1 E035 + 1 E034 when E047 appears.
quests.balanceNotes: Evidence and timer remain fixed; boss stays single-copy.

quests.name: The Silent Witness
quests.story: A dockworker saw one of the masked killers remove their disguise. The Quiet Crown knows the witness survived. The Heroes must move them from the Low Ward to the Crown Watch before the assassins close in.
quests.locationPool: Include L064 Crown Gate; L065 Grand Market; L067 Temple Square; L069 Low Ward; L070 River Docks; L071 Warehouse District; L072 Old Quarter; L073 Watch Barracks; L074 Bell Tower Square.
quests.enemyDeck: E033 Street Cutthroat ×4; E034 Crossbow Thug ×2; E035 Masked Acolyte ×2; E036 Veiled Agent ×2; E037 Cult Enforcer ×1.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Place Witness Token with the Heroes at L069. Reveal L073 – Watch Barracks as a Gated destination; it becomes Unlocked after the party reveals any 3 new Urban Locations. Spawn E033 ×2 in the first newly revealed Urban Location after setup.
quests.questRules: ESCORT: Witness moves with one Hero in the same Location and cannot be left voluntarily. If no non-Downed Hero shares the Witness's Location at end of Enemy Phase, the Witness suffers 1 Harm. At 3 Harm, the Witness is lost. HUNTERS: First time the Witness enters a new Location each Round, roll 1d6; on 1–2 spawn E033 at a connected revealed Location, on 3–4 no effect, on 5–6 the party gains 1 Evidence.
quests.winningConditions: Escort the Witness to L073 – Watch Barracks alive.
quests.losingConditions: Witness reaches 3 Harm; all Heroes are Defeated.
quests.rewards: 80 XP; 75 Gold; +1 Crown Watch Reputation; record Witness Testimony.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Witness Testimony removes the first Suspicion marker that would be placed each Quest during WE006.
quests.locationConsistency: Urban escort route with an unlock gate rather than a fixed straight path.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: Witness Harm threshold becomes 4. 2 Heroes: printed. 3 Heroes: first Hunter spawn adds 1 E033. 4 Heroes: first two Hunter spawns add 1 E033.
quests.balanceNotes: Optional campaign advantage; do not over-reward with raw gear.

quests.name: Masks at Midnight
quests.story: Evidence leads to a masquerade in the Gilded Ward where nobles, guild officers, clergy, and Watch officials mingle behind masks. The Heroes must identify Quiet Crown agents without turning the entire city against them.
quests.locationPool: Include L062 Noble Estate; L064 Crown Gate; L065 Grand Market; L066 Gilded Ward; L067 Temple Square; L068 Scholar's Row; L072 Old Quarter; L074 Bell Tower Square; L075 Guildhall.
quests.enemyDeck: E035 Masked Acolyte ×4; E036 Veiled Agent ×3; E037 Cult Enforcer ×2; E038 Corrupt Watchman ×2.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Shuffle 6 Suspect Tokens face down: 3 Cult, 3 Innocent. Place 1 at starting L066. The first time each of L062, L067, L068, L074, and L075 is revealed, place 1 remaining Suspect there. Heroes begin with Suspicion 0.
quests.questRules: QUESTION SUSPECT: A Hero with a Suspect in their Location may spend 1 Action to reveal it. Revealing an Innocent increases Suspicion by 1; revealing Cult gains 1 Evidence and spawns E035 at that Location. At Suspicion 3, spawn E036; at Suspicion 5, all remaining unrevealed Cult Suspects are exposed and spawn their Acolytes. Witness Testimony: if recorded, ignore the first Suspicion increase. ESCAPE: after all 3 Cult Suspects are exposed, at least one Hero must reach L064 Crown Gate.
quests.winningConditions: Expose all 3 Cult Suspects, gain 3 Evidence, and have at least one Hero reach L064 – Crown Gate.
quests.losingConditions: Suspicion reaches 6 before all 3 Cult Suspects are exposed; all Heroes are Defeated.
quests.rewards: 150 XP; 150 Gold; draw 1 Rare Equipment Card; +1 General Reputation.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Unlock Q017 and Q018.
quests.locationConsistency: Social-infiltration mechanics use tokens and actions but stay within normal Location/Interact rules.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: use 5 Suspects (3 Cult/2 Innocent): place 1 at L066 and place the remaining 4 on the first four listed Suspect Locations revealed; Suspicion loss is 7. 2 Heroes: printed setup. 3 Heroes: printed setup. 4 Heroes: printed setup and add 1 E037 when the third Cult is exposed.
quests.balanceNotes: Challenge comes from information/suspicion, not only combat.

quests.name: Beneath the Guildhall
quests.story: Nightglass points the Heroes toward a hidden supply network beneath the guild district. Destroying it could weaken the Quiet Crown, but every hour spent underground gives the conspiracy more time to act elsewhere.
quests.locationPool: Include L071 Warehouse District; L072 Old Quarter; L075 Guildhall; L076 Sewer Junction; L077 Flooded Cistern; L078 Smuggler Tunnel; L084 Sealed Archive.
quests.enemyDeck: E035 Masked Acolyte ×3; E036 Veiled Agent ×1; E037 Cult Enforcer ×2; E038 Corrupt Watchman ×2; E039 Sewer Stalker ×3.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Place Hidden Cellar objective at L075. A Hero may spend 1 Action there after a successful Search to unlock L076 or L078 as a Gated Underground entrance. Place 3 Supply Cache Tokens; one each enters play with the first three Underground Locations revealed.
quests.questRules: DESTROY CACHE: A Hero in a Location with a Supply Cache may spend 1 Action to destroy it. Each destroyed Cache spawns either E035 or E039 at a connected legal Location. LEDGER: The third Cache contains the Quiet Crown Ledger; gain it when that Cache is destroyed. ESCAPE: after all Caches are destroyed, at least one Hero must return to an Urban Location.
quests.winningConditions: Destroy all 3 Supply Caches, gain the Quiet Crown Ledger, and escape to an Urban Location.
quests.losingConditions: All Heroes are Defeated; 4 consecutive Rounds pass after the first Cache is revealed without another Cache being destroyed.
quests.rewards: 100 XP; 100 Gold; +1 Nightglass Reputation; record Quiet Crown Supply Network Destroyed.
quests.campaignFollowOn: During Q021, remove the first non-Boss Cult reinforcement that would spawn.
quests.locationConsistency: Compact surface-to-sewer optional raid; L075/L076/L078 provide multiple entrances/exits.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: only 2 Supply Caches are placed; Victory requires all placed Caches. 2 Heroes: 3 Caches. 3 Heroes: add 1 E035 to the second Cache spawn. 4 Heroes: add 1 E037 to the third Cache spawn.
quests.balanceNotes: Optional quest trades Campaign Day for a concrete later reduction.

quests.name: The Broken Seal
quests.story: The Archive identifies an ancient seal beneath the Old Quarter. The Quiet Crown is already there. The Heroes cannot prevent the first breach, but they can determine how much of the buried city wakes when the doors finally open.
quests.locationPool: Include L068 Scholar's Row; L072 Old Quarter; L076 Sewer Junction; L077 Flooded Cistern; L078 Smuggler Tunnel; L079 Forgotten Crypt; L084 Sealed Archive; L085 Ancient Throneway.
quests.enemyDeck: E035 Masked Acolyte ×4; E036 Veiled Agent ×2; E037 Cult Enforcer ×3; E038 Corrupt Watchman ×2; E045 Veilspawn ×1.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Place Seal Track at 4 and 3 Ritualist markers. When L085 – Ancient Throneway is revealed, place 2 E035 + 1 E037 and all remaining Ritualist markers there. At end of each Enemy Phase with at least 1 Ritualist marker, reduce Seal Track by 1.
quests.questRules: DISRUPT RITUAL: A Hero at L085 may spend 1 Action to remove 1 Ritualist marker if no Enemy is in that Location. Each Ritualist removed before Seal Track reaches 0 reduces Breach by 1. When Seal Track reaches 0 or all Ritualists are removed, the Seal breaks and spawn E045 Veilspawn at L085. Record Breach = number of Ritualists remaining when the Seal breaks. The Heroes must defeat the Veilspawn and escape to L072 or L068.
quests.winningConditions: The Seal has broken, E045 is defeated, and at least one Hero escapes to L072 – Old Quarter or L068 – Scholar's Row.
quests.rewards: 175 XP; 175 Gold; draw 1 Rare Equipment Card; +1 Archive of Seven Reputation.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Begin WE007. If Breach is 0–1, no penalty. If Breach is 2, Q019 starts with 1 additional E040. If Breach is 3, Q019 starts with 1 E040 and its first Encounter gains +1 Severity.
quests.locationConsistency: Story requires the Seal to open; performance changes the scale of the consequence rather than creating an impossible 'perfect prevention' ending.
quests.enemyConsistency: Uses Cult enemies plus first E045 supernatural reveal.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: start L085 with E035 + E037 and use 2 Ritualists. 2 Heroes: printed. 3 Heroes: add 1 E035. 4 Heroes: add 1 E035 + E037.
quests.balanceNotes: Breach outcome carries into Q019; no fail state for the inevitable opening itself.

quests.name: The Forgotten City
quests.story: The opened passage descends into a city deliberately buried beneath Valewatch. The Archive needs a stable route before the Quiet Crown reaches the throne complex. Ancient waystones may still mark the old streets if the Heroes can reactivate them.
quests.locationPool: Include L077 Flooded Cistern; L078 Smuggler Tunnel; L079 Forgotten Crypt; L080 Ossuary; L081 Collapsed Avenue; L082 Buried Plaza; L083 Royal Catacombs; L084 Sealed Archive; L085 Ancient Throneway.
quests.enemyDeck: E039 Sewer Stalker ×2; E040 Gravebound Soldier ×5; E041 Crypt Archer ×3; E042 Wraith ×2; E043 Ossuary Keeper ×1.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Place 3 Waystone Tokens in the supply. The first time L081, L082, and L084 are revealed, place 1 Waystone Token there. Apply any Breach penalty from Q018 at setup.
quests.questRules: ACTIVATE WAYSTONE: A Hero at a Waystone with no Enemy in that Location may spend 1 Action to activate it. The first activation spawns E040 at a connected Location; the second spawns E041; the third spawns E042. ROUTE SECURED: Once all 3 are active, reveal/unlock L085 Ancient Throneway if it is in the Quest pool but still Gated.
quests.winningConditions: Activate all 3 Waystones and have at least one Hero reach L082 – Buried Plaza or L085 – Ancient Throneway.
quests.rewards: 175 XP; 175 Gold; draw 1 Rare Equipment Card.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Unlock Q020 and Q021.
quests.locationConsistency: Buried-city exploration with three distributed objective nodes to encourage branching.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: second Waystone spawn is skipped. 2 Heroes: printed. 3 Heroes: add 1 E040 at first Waystone activation. 4 Heroes: add 1 E040 at first and third activations.
quests.balanceNotes: Waystone count stays 3; enemy reinforcement scales.

quests.name: Tomb of the First King
quests.story: Records recovered below the city point to the tomb of the ruler who first resisted the Veiled Crown. If the Heroes can recover his royal seal, it may still carry authority over the wards surrounding the ancient throne.
quests.locationPool: Include L079 Forgotten Crypt; L080 Ossuary; L081 Collapsed Avenue; L082 Buried Plaza; L083 Royal Catacombs; L084 Sealed Archive; L085 Ancient Throneway.
quests.enemyDeck: E040 Gravebound Soldier ×4; E041 Crypt Archer ×2; E042 Wraith ×2; E043 Ossuary Keeper ×1; E044 Hollow Knight ×1.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Place Royal Tomb objective at L083 and 3 Seal Lock Tokens on it. Place E044 Hollow Knight at L083 when the Royal Tomb is first accessed.
quests.questRules: BREAK SEALS: A Hero in L083 may spend 1 Action to remove 1 Seal Lock if no Enemy is there. Each Lock removed triggers: first — spawn E040; second — spawn E042; third — E044 immediately activates if alive. After all Locks are removed and E044 is defeated, gain Royal Seal of the First King.
quests.winningConditions: Remove all 3 Seal Locks, defeat E044, and recover the Royal Seal.
quests.rewards: 125 XP; 100 Gold; +1 Archive of Seven Reputation; gain Royal Seal of the First King Campaign Quest Item.
quests.campaignFollowOn: At start of Q024, remove 1 Crown Ward before play begins.
quests.locationConsistency: Optional high-value relic Quest with a clear finale payoff.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: use 2 Seal Locks; Victory requires all placed Locks. 2 Heroes: printed setup. 3 Heroes: first Lock also adds 1 E040. 4 Heroes: first and second Locks each add 1 E040.
quests.balanceNotes: Reward is primarily campaign leverage rather than economy.

quests.name: The Black Cathedral
quests.story: The Quiet Crown has turned an ancient underground cathedral into a ritual fortress. Its leader, Ysara Keld—the First Mask—intends to prepare the Veiled Crown for a new bearer. The Heroes must shatter the ritual and force the truth into the open.
quests.locationPool: Include L080 Ossuary; L081 Collapsed Avenue; L082 Buried Plaza; L083 Royal Catacombs; L084 Sealed Archive; L085 Ancient Throneway; L086 Black Cathedral.
quests.enemyDeck: E035 Masked Acolyte ×2; E040 Gravebound Soldier ×4; E041 Crypt Archer ×2; E043 Ossuary Keeper ×2; E044 Hollow Knight ×2; E045 Veilspawn ×2; E048 Ysara Keld, First Mask ×1.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: When L086 – Black Cathedral is revealed, place 3 Ritual Focus Tokens, E048, E035 ×2, and E044 ×1 there. If Quiet Crown Supply Network Destroyed is recorded, remove 1 E035 from this setup.
quests.questRules: RITUAL FOCUS: While any Focus remains, E048 cannot be reduced below 10 Health. A Hero in L086 may spend 1 Action to destroy 1 Focus if no non-Boss Enemy is in L086. Each Focus destroyed spawns 1 enemy in a connected Location: E040, then E041, then E045. FIRST MASK FALLS: when E048 is defeated, reveal that Chancellor Severin Hale is the intended vessel.
quests.winningConditions: Destroy all 3 Ritual Focus Tokens and defeat E048 Ysara Keld.
quests.rewards: 200 XP; 200 Gold; draw 1 Epic Equipment Card; +1 General Reputation.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Complete WE007 required path and begin WE008 – The Veiled Sovereign.
quests.locationConsistency: Single-arena reveal objective but wider pool creates approach choices and resource attrition.
quests.enemyConsistency: Uses campaign undead/Veil roster and boss E048.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: Cathedral setup E048 + E035 + E044; Focus spawns only on first and third. 2 Heroes: printed. 3 Heroes: add 1 E040 at reveal. 4 Heroes: add 1 E040 + 1 E041 at reveal.
quests.balanceNotes: Boss damage floor prevents ignoring ritual objectives.

quests.name: The City Falls
quests.story: While Hale is dragged toward the buried throne, violence erupts across Valewatch. The Heroes can descend immediately—or spend precious time saving the districts and factions that will otherwise face the crisis alone.
quests.locationPool: Include L064 Crown Gate; L065 Grand Market; L066 Gilded Ward; L067 Temple Square; L068 Scholar's Row; L069 Low Ward; L070 River Docks; L072 Old Quarter; L073 Watch Barracks; L075 Guildhall.
quests.enemyDeck: E033 Street Cutthroat ×4; E034 Crossbow Thug ×2; E038 Corrupt Watchman ×4; E045 Veilspawn ×3; E046 Crown Herald ×2.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Choose 4 District Objectives: Grand Market, Temple Square, Scholar's Row, Watch Barracks. Place 1 Crisis Token at each when its Location is revealed. Place Crisis Track at 0.
quests.questRules: CRISIS: At end of each Enemy Phase, increase Crisis Track by 1. At 2, 4, and 6 spawn enemies at an unresolved District: E033, then E045, then E046. SAVE DISTRICT: A Hero at a Crisis Token may spend 1 Action to save it if no Enemy is in that Location. Remove the token and record that District Saved. The Quest ends immediately when 3 Districts are saved or Crisis reaches 7.
quests.winningConditions: Save at least 3 of the 4 Districts.
quests.losingConditions: Crisis Track reaches 7 before 3 Districts are saved; all Heroes are Defeated.
quests.rewards: 100 XP; 125 Gold; +1 General Reputation; record each saved District and its faction aid.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Each saved District grants its listed Q024 aid: Grand Market — each Hero gains 1 Common Healing Potion before Q024; Temple Square — each Hero begins Q024 Guarded; Scholar's Row — each Crown Ward begins Q024 with 1 damage; Watch Barracks — remove 1 non-Boss enemy from Q024 setup.
quests.locationConsistency: Optional city-defense quest with persistent World State; designed to make Valewatch feel worth saving.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: choose 3 Districts and must save 2; Crisis limit 7. 2 Heroes: printed. 3 Heroes: first Crisis spawn adds 1 E033. 4 Heroes: second Crisis spawn adds 1 E045.
quests.balanceNotes: District choices generate campaign-state variation; rewards are finale utility.

quests.name: The Descent
quests.story: Hale and the remaining Quiet Crown flee below the city. The Heroes pursue through collapsing streets, haunted catacombs, and the ancient processional way while the Veil closes behind them.
quests.locationPool: Include L076 Sewer Junction; L077 Flooded Cistern; L079 Forgotten Crypt; L080 Ossuary; L081 Collapsed Avenue; L082 Buried Plaza; L083 Royal Catacombs; L084 Sealed Archive; L085 Ancient Throneway; L086 Black Cathedral.
quests.enemyDeck: E040 Gravebound Soldier ×4; E041 Crypt Archer ×3; E042 Wraith ×2; E044 Hollow Knight ×2; E045 Veilspawn ×3; E046 Crown Herald ×2.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Place Collapse Track at 0. L085 Ancient Throneway is Gated until any 3 Buried Valewatch Locations have been revealed. L086 Black Cathedral is Gated until L085 is reached.
quests.questRules: COLLAPSE: At end of each Enemy Phase increase Collapse Track by 1. At 2, 4, and 6 choose the farthest revealed Location behind the leading Hero; it becomes Collapsed after all Heroes leave it and can no longer be entered. If Collapse reaches 8 before L086 – Black Cathedral is revealed, the Quest fails. PURSUIT: first time each new Underground/Buried Location is entered, if no Enemy is there roll 1d6; on 1–2 spawn E040, 3–4 no effect, 5 E041, 6 E045. The party may not return to L051 after entering L076. BLACK CATHEDRAL GUARD: The first time L086 – Black Cathedral is revealed, place E046 Crown Herald ×1 and E044 Hollow Knight ×1 there. These defenders are Quest-spawned and are not Random Travel Encounters.
quests.winningConditions: Reach L086 – Black Cathedral, defeat all enemies there, and unlock the route to L087 Veiled Sanctum.
quests.losingConditions: All Heroes are Defeated; Collapse Track reaches 8 before L086 – Black Cathedral is revealed.
quests.rewards: 225 XP; 225 Gold; draw 1 Epic Equipment Card.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Unlock Q024 – The Veiled Sovereign.
quests.locationConsistency: Gauntlet/one-way pressure. Collapse occurs behind the party and should not randomly sever the only forward route.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: Collapse advances every other Enemy Phase; when L086 is revealed, place only E046 Crown Herald. 2 Heroes: printed setup. 3 Heroes: first Pursuit spawn is automatic E040; when L086 is revealed, also add 1 E045 Veilspawn. 4 Heroes: first two Pursuit checks that spawn enemies add 1 E040; when L086 is revealed, also add 1 E045 Veilspawn + 1 E042 Wraith.
quests.balanceNotes: Movement pressure remains primary, but L086 now has a guaranteed final guard so the Quest cannot end on an empty Cathedral reveal.

quests.name: The Veiled Sovereign
quests.story: In the buried throne chamber, Chancellor Severin Hale is bound beneath the Veiled Crown. The Heroes must break the wards protecting the Crown, survive Hale's transformation, and destroy or seal the intelligence that has worn generations of rulers like masks.
quests.locationPool: Include L083 Royal Catacombs; L084 Sealed Archive; L085 Ancient Throneway; L086 Black Cathedral; L087 Veiled Sanctum.
quests.enemyDeck: E049 Severin Hale, Crown-Bound ×1; E050 The Veiled Sovereign ×1; E045 Veilspawn ×2; E046 Crown Herald ×2; E044 Hollow Knight ×1.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Place L087 – Veiled Sanctum, 3 Crown Ward Tokens, E049 Severin Hale, E046 Crown Herald ×1, and E045 Veilspawn ×1. If Royal Seal Recovered, remove 1 Crown Ward. Apply all Q022 District aid before the first Round. E050 begins out of play.
quests.questRules: CROWN WARDS: E049 and E050 cannot be reduced below half their printed Health while any Crown Ward remains. A Hero in L087 may spend 1 Action to damage a Crown Ward for 1; each Ward has 2 Health and 0 Armor. PHASE I — HALE: Immediately after E049 is reduced to 13 Health or gains its third Crown Strain, whichever occurs first, finish the current effect, remove E049, and place E050 at full Health. Remaining Crown Wards stay. PHASE II — SOVEREIGN: The first time E050 reaches 15 Health or less, it immediately activates once after the current effect resolves. This is a Quest-specific phase trigger and occurs only once. PHASE III — BREAK THE CROWN: E050 cannot be finally defeated while any Crown Ward remains. When the last Crown Ward is destroyed, all Veilspawn suffer 3 damage.
quests.winningConditions: Destroy all Crown Wards and defeat E050 The Veiled Sovereign.
quests.rewards: 300 XP to each Hero; 1 Legendary Equipment Card per Hero; +3 General Reputation; unlock Wardens of Valewatch; complete Campaign II.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Campaign II Victory. Record saved Districts, faction relationships, NPC survival, and the final fate of the Veiled Crown as World State.
quests.locationConsistency: 5-tile finale pool focused on L087. Prior optional Quest accomplishments provide concrete, non-mandatory advantages.
quests.enemyConsistency: Uses dedicated E049 phase-I boss and E050 legendary final boss with E044/E045/E046 support.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: setup E049 + E045 with 2 Crown Wards; E050 phase adds no enemy. 2 Heroes: use printed setup. 3 Heroes: add 1 E046 at setup. 4 Heroes: add 1 E044 at setup and the E050 phase transition spawns 1 E045.
quests.balanceNotes: Two-stage finale is balanced around Quest-owned half-Health/Strain triggers, Crown Ward Actions, and optional Campaign advantages. Do not duplicate the Q024 phase trigger on E050's Enemy card.

quests.name: The First Collapse
quests.story: A section of the Outer Mine caves in during a citywide tremor. Three work crews are cut off while the Liftworks groan under repeated aftershocks. Torren Pike asks the Heroes to enter before the tunnels settle—or finish collapsing.
quests.locationPool: Include L089 High Forge; L090 Liftworks; L091 Delvers' Hall; L093 Clan Ward; L094 Stonegate Pass; L095 Outer Mine; L096 Split Shaft; L097 Broken Gallery; L098 Survey Chamber.
quests.enemyDeck: E051 Shale Crawler ×4; E052 Deepmaw Brute ×2; E053 Ashen Compact Saboteur ×2.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Place Collapse Track at 0. Place 3 Trapped Crew Tokens: one each at L095, L096, and L097 when those Locations are first revealed. Place E051 ×2 at L095 when revealed.
quests.questRules: AFTERSHOCK: At end of each Enemy Phase increase Collapse Track by 1. At 2 and 4, place 1 Cave-In Token on the farthest revealed Mine/Cavern Location that contains no Hero; that Location costs +1 Action to enter or leave until a Hero there spends 1 Action to clear the token. RESCUE CREW: A Hero at a Trapped Crew Token may spend 1 Action to rescue it if no Enemy is there. Remove the token and record the crew saved. If Collapse reaches 6 before the Victory condition is met, the Quest fails. If all 3 crews are rescued, immediately reduce Instability by 1, minimum 0.
quests.winningConditions: Rescue at least 2 of the 3 Trapped Crew Tokens before Collapse reaches 6.
quests.losingConditions: All Heroes are Defeated; Collapse Track reaches 6 before at least 2 crews are rescued.
quests.rewards: 125 XP; 125 Gold; +1 Deepdelver Guild Reputation.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Record each rescued crew. If all 3 were rescued, reduce Instability by 1 and Torren Pike remains fully staffed for Q026/Q027. If exactly 2 were rescued, no Stability change.
quests.locationConsistency: Opening rescue scenario uses Ironhaven/mine locations and introduces Cave-In pressure without requiring deep-campaign routes.
quests.enemyConsistency: Uses first Campaign III Deep Creature and Saboteur enemies.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: place only L095 and L097 Crew Tokens and must rescue both; Collapse advances every other Enemy Phase. 2 Heroes: printed setup. 3 Heroes: add 1 E051 at L096 reveal. 4 Heroes: add 1 E051 at L096 and 1 E053 at L097 reveal.
quests.balanceNotes: Designed to teach Instability through recoverable action pressure. Full rescue is rewarded but not required.

quests.name: Lost Below
quests.story: One Deepdelver survey team failed to return before the collapse. Their route maps could reopen the eastern galleries, but the last signal came from an abandoned survey chamber beyond unstable shafts.
quests.locationPool: Include L090 Liftworks; L094 Stonegate Pass; L095 Outer Mine; L096 Split Shaft; L097 Broken Gallery; L098 Survey Chamber; L099 Old Ventworks.
quests.enemyDeck: E051 Shale Crawler ×4; E052 Deepmaw Brute ×2; E053 Ashen Compact Saboteur ×2; E054 Ashen Compact Forgemaster ×1.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Place 2 Survey Cache Tokens at L098 – Survey Chamber. Place 1 Delver Survivor Token at L099 – Old Ventworks. If all 3 crews were rescued in Q025, the first Cave-In Token that would be placed during this Quest is ignored.
quests.questRules: UNSTABLE ROUTE: The first time each Round a Hero enters a Mine/Cavern Location containing a Cave-In Token, that Hero suffers 1 damage after moving. RECOVER CACHE: A Hero in L098 may spend 1 Action to recover 1 Survey Cache if no Enemy is there. RESCUE SURVIVOR: A Hero in L099 may spend 1 Action to rescue the Survivor if no Enemy is there. The Quest ends when both Survey Caches are recovered; rescuing the Survivor is an additional objective. If the Survivor is rescued, reduce Instability by 1.
quests.winningConditions: Recover both Survey Cache Tokens. The Delver Survivor is optional.
quests.rewards: 100 XP; 100 Gold; gain LT167 Deepdelver Survey Map; +1 Deepdelver Guild Reputation if the Survivor was rescued.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Record Survey Network Restored if the Survivor was rescued and at least one Q025 crew survived. During Q027, if LT167 is held, ignore the first route-gating effect and one Relay Anchor begins with 1 damage.
quests.locationConsistency: Optional route-recovery quest. Benefits the next main Quest but is not required to win it.
quests.enemyConsistency: Uses E051-E054; emphasizes navigation and mixed Deep/Ashen pressure.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: place 1 Survey Cache at L098 and the Survivor at L099; Victory requires that Cache only. 2 Heroes: printed. 3 Heroes: add 1 E051 at L098. 4 Heroes: add 1 E053 at L098 and 1 E051 at L099.
quests.balanceNotes: Optional value is route leverage + Stability reduction rather than oversized economy.

quests.name: The Ember Relay
quests.story: The recovered surveys reveal an impossible pattern: every major tremor radiates from a sealed relay vault below the old mines. When the Heroes reach it, they find Ashen Compact smiths feeding power into a machine older than Ironhaven itself.
quests.locationPool: Include L094 Stonegate Pass; L095 Outer Mine; L096 Split Shaft; L097 Broken Gallery; L098 Survey Chamber; L099 Old Ventworks; L100 First Relay Vault.
quests.enemyDeck: E051 Shale Crawler ×4; E053 Ashen Compact Saboteur ×4; E054 Ashen Compact Forgemaster ×2; E055 Runic Sentry ×3; E056 Varrik Emberhand ×1.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Place 3 Relay Anchor Tokens at L100 – First Relay Vault, each with 2 Health and 0 Armor. Place E056 Varrik Emberhand, E055 Runic Sentry ×1, and E053 ×1 at L100 when revealed. If LT167 Deepdelver Survey Map is held, one Relay Anchor begins with 1 damage and the first Gated/blocked connection caused by this Quest is ignored.
quests.questRules: RELAY ANCHORS: While any Relay Anchor remains, E056 cannot be reduced below half Health. A Hero in L100 may spend 1 Action to damage a Relay Anchor for 1. Each Anchor destroyed triggers a surge: first — spawn 1 E051 in a connected Location; second — every Hero in L100 suffers 1 unavoidable damage; third — E056 immediately activates after the current effect resolves. FORGE REVEAL: When the final Anchor is destroyed, record Ashen Compact Relay Network Exposed. If Q026's Survivor was rescued, cancel the first surge-spawn enemy.
quests.winningConditions: Destroy all 3 Relay Anchors and defeat E056 Varrik Emberhand.
quests.rewards: 175 XP; 175 Gold; draw 1 Rare Equipment Card; gain LT168 Ember Relay Core.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Complete WE009 required path. Reduce Instability by 1 if all 3 Relay Anchors were destroyed before the end of Round 6; otherwise no change. Reveal that Forge-Lord Kharvek Durn is deliberately restoring deeper Worldforge relays.
quests.locationConsistency: Opening chapter boss/objective quest. Establishes Ashen Compact as antagonist and Worldforge relay technology as the source of the tremors.
quests.enemyConsistency: Uses E051, E053-E056; first Campaign III boss E056.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: use 2 Relay Anchors; reveal setup E056 + E055 only. 2 Heroes: printed. 3 Heroes: add 1 E053 at L100 reveal. 4 Heroes: add 1 E055 at reveal and the first destroyed Anchor also spawns 1 E053.
quests.balanceNotes: Anchor action tax mirrors later Campaign III forge objectives but should remain manageable at Level 7–8.

quests.name: Road of the Ancestors
quests.story: The Deep Gate opens onto an ancestral road that predates Ironhaven. To reach the lower mines safely, the Heroes must reactivate old Waymark Beacons while Fractures split the road behind them.
quests.locationPool: Include L101 Deep Gate; L102 Deep Road Threshold; L103 Echoing Causeway; L104 Abandoned Clan Hall; L105 Chasm Bridge; L106 Crystal Fault; L107 Forge-Shrine.
quests.enemyDeck: E057 Stonebound Miner ×4; E058 Deep Road Stalker ×3; E059 Ashen Compact Shieldbearer ×2.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Place 3 Waymark Beacon Tokens at L102, L103, and L105 when those Locations are revealed. Each Beacon has 2 inactive charges.
quests.questRules: WAYMARKS: A Hero at a Beacon may spend 1 Action to activate 1 charge if no Enemy is there. When both charges are active, remove the token and record that Waymark restored. FRACTURES: apply WE010 Fracture Tokens normally. When 2 Waymarks are restored, L105 Chasm Bridge may be revealed. When all 3 are restored, the safe route to the lower Deeps is open.
quests.winningConditions: Restore all 3 Waymark Beacons and have at least one Hero reach L105 – Chasm Bridge.
quests.rewards: 175 XP; 150 Gold; +1 Deepdelver Guild Reputation.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Record Ancestral Road Restored. If completed with no more than 1 Fracture Token still in play, reduce Instability by 1.
quests.locationConsistency: Deep Roads route-repair quest; introduces Fracture Tokens and persistent navigation pressure.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: use 2 Beacons at L102/L105, each with 1 charge. 2 Heroes: printed. 3 Heroes: add 1 E057 at L103 reveal. 4 Heroes: add 1 E059 at L105 reveal.
quests.balanceNotes: Action cost is route-focused rather than boss-focused; should be completable without Q026 support.

quests.name: The Last Clan Hall
quests.story: A sealed clan hall lies just off the restored road. Edda Runevoice believes its archives contain the key used by Ironhaven's founders to command the earliest forge relays—and proof that the Worldforge was meant to be restrained, not awakened.
quests.locationPool: Include L103 Echoing Causeway; L104 Abandoned Clan Hall; L106 Crystal Fault; L107 Forge-Shrine; L108 Hall of Names.
quests.enemyDeck: E057 Stonebound Miner ×3; E058 Deep Road Stalker ×2; E059 Ashen Compact Shieldbearer ×2; E065 Stone Echo ×2.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Place 3 Memory Seal Tokens at L108 – Hall of Names. Place 1 E065 Stone Echo there when first revealed.
quests.questRules: MEMORY SEALS: A Hero in L108 may spend 1 Action to break 1 Memory Seal if no Enemy is there. First Seal: each Hero in L108 discards 1 card or suffers 1 damage. Second: spawn 1 E065 in L107. Third: reveal the Clan Key and gain LT169. If Edda Runevoice support is available, ignore the first Seal consequence.
quests.winningConditions: Break all placed Memory Seals and recover LT169 Clan Key of Emberdeep.
quests.rewards: 125 XP; 100 Gold; gain LT169 Clan Key of Emberdeep; +1 Stone-Singer Circle Reputation.
quests.campaignFollowOn: During Q030, one Chain Lock begins removed. During Q035, the party may use the Emberdeep route if the Quest allows it. Reduce Instability by 1 if both E065 Stone Echoes were defeated or peacefully dismissed by an explicit effect.
quests.locationConsistency: Optional lore/relic quest with concrete route/finale leverage.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: use 2 Memory Seals. 2 Heroes: printed. 3 Heroes: second Seal also spawns 1 E057. 4 Heroes: first and second Seals each add 1 E057.
quests.balanceNotes: Reward value is campaign leverage rather than raw gear.

quests.name: The Chain Relay
quests.story: The restored road ends at a cavern where a second Worldforge relay hangs above a chasm on immense rune-chains. Ashen Compact engineers are using it to pull power upward from something deeper.
quests.locationPool: Include L104 Abandoned Clan Hall; L105 Chasm Bridge; L106 Crystal Fault; L107 Forge-Shrine; L108 Hall of Names; L109 Chain Relay.
quests.enemyDeck: E057 Stonebound Miner ×4; E059 Ashen Compact Shieldbearer ×3; E060 Dorga Chainforged ×1; E055 Runic Sentry ×2.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Place 3 Chain Lock Tokens at L109, each with 2 Health and 0 Armor. Place E060 + E055 ×1 + E059 ×1 when L109 is revealed. If LT169 is held, remove 1 Chain Lock before play at L109 begins.
quests.questRules: CHAIN LOCKS: While any Lock remains, E060 cannot be reduced below 14 Health. A Hero in L109 may spend 1 Action to damage a Lock for 1. Each destroyed Lock causes the relay to swing: first — move every Hero in L109 to a legal connected Location of their choice; second — spawn 1 E059; third — E060 immediately activates. If LT168 Ember Relay Core is held, once per Quest cancel one relay-swing consequence.
quests.winningConditions: Destroy all remaining Chain Locks and defeat E060 Dorga Chainforged.
quests.rewards: 200 XP; 200 Gold; draw 1 Epic Equipment Card.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Complete WE010 required path. Record Second Relay Disabled. Reduce Instability by 1 if no Chain Lock remained at end of Round 5.
quests.locationConsistency: WE010 boss/objective scenario; optional Q029 directly lowers objective tax.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: use 2 Chain Locks; reveal E060 + E055 only. 2 Heroes: printed. 3 Heroes: add 1 E059 at reveal. 4 Heroes: add 1 E055 and 1 E059 at reveal.
quests.balanceNotes: Boss floor prevents racing Dorga while ignoring the relay.

quests.name: Into the Foundry
quests.story: With two relays disabled, the Heroes descend into a forge complex large enough to build armies. Assembly lines have restarted, and Ashen Compact adepts are directing ancient constructs toward Ironhaven's upper shafts.
quests.locationPool: Include L109 Chain Relay; L110 Molten Works; L111 Smelter Walk; L112 Construct Assembly; L114 Magma Channel; L115 Worldforge Antechamber.
quests.enemyDeck: E059 Ashen Compact Shieldbearer ×3; E061 Magma Whelp ×3; E062 Forge Golem ×3; E063 Heartstone Adept ×2.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Place 3 Assembly Line Tokens: L110, L112, and L114 when revealed. Each has 2 Health and 0 Armor.
quests.questRules: ASSEMBLY LINES: At end of each Enemy Phase, each active Assembly Line with no Hero in its Location gains 1 Progress. At 2 Progress, reset it to 0 and spawn 1 E061 at that Location. A Hero there may spend 1 Action to damage the Line for 1. Destroyed Lines stop spawning. If all 3 are destroyed, reduce Instability by 1.
quests.winningConditions: Destroy at least 2 of the 3 Assembly Lines and reach L115 – Worldforge Antechamber.
quests.losingConditions: All Heroes are Defeated; 3 Forge Golems are simultaneously in play from Assembly Line spawns.
quests.rewards: 200 XP; 200 Gold; +1 Forge Council Reputation.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Record Foundry Breached. If all 3 Assembly Lines were destroyed, reduce Instability by 1 and Q033 begins with one fewer E062.
quests.locationConsistency: Production-pressure quest; teaches persistent forge machinery before finale nodes.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: use 2 Assembly Lines (L110/L112) and must destroy both. 2 Heroes: printed. 3 Heroes: add 1 E061 at L112 reveal. 4 Heroes: add 1 E062 at L114 reveal.
quests.balanceNotes: Spawn loop must pressure without creating an irreversible body flood.

quests.name: Songs in the Stone
quests.story: Edda hears a second rhythm beneath the Worldforge: the Mountain Heart itself. A hidden resonance chamber may contain the regulators once used to keep the Heart and forge in balance.
quests.locationPool: Include L107 Forge-Shrine; L108 Hall of Names; L110 Molten Works; L113 Resonance Chamber; L114 Magma Channel.
quests.enemyDeck: E061 Magma Whelp ×2; E063 Heartstone Adept ×2; E065 Stone Echo ×3.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: L113 – Resonance Chamber is Gated until at least 2 other listed Locations have been revealed. When L113 is revealed, place Resonance Track at 0, 3 Tone Tokens, and E065 Stone Echo ×1 there.
quests.questRules: ATTUNE: A Hero in L113 may spend 1 Action to resolve 1 Tone if no Enemy is there. For each Tone, roll 1d6: 1–2 suffer 1 damage; 3–4 no effect; 5–6 recover 1 Health. Then increase Resonance by 1. If Edda support is active, treat one roll of 1–2 as 3–4. At Resonance 3, gain LT170 Heartstone Regulator and reduce Instability by 1.
quests.winningConditions: Resolve all 3 Tone Tokens and recover LT170 Heartstone Regulator.
quests.rewards: 150 XP; 125 Gold; gain LT170 Heartstone Regulator; +1 Stone-Singer Circle Reputation.
quests.campaignFollowOn: During Q033, ignore the first Forge Heat damage each Round. During Q036, one Mountain Ward begins with 1 damage.
quests.locationConsistency: Optional non-boss objective quest centered on Stability/finale aid.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: use 2 Tone Tokens. 2 Heroes: printed. 3 Heroes: add 1 E061 at first Tone. 4 Heroes: first and second Tone each add 1 E061.
quests.balanceNotes: Should reward Stone-Singer support without requiring it.

quests.name: The Worldforge Wakes
quests.story: The Worldforge's central antechamber opens and a construct the size of a house tears free from its cradle. Kharvek uses the chaos to descend toward the Heartshaft while the Heroes fight to shut down the forge before it fully synchronizes with the Mountain Heart.
quests.locationPool: Include L110 Molten Works; L111 Smelter Walk; L112 Construct Assembly; L113 Resonance Chamber; L114 Magma Channel; L115 Worldforge Antechamber.
quests.enemyDeck: E061 Magma Whelp ×3; E062 Forge Golem ×3; E063 Heartstone Adept ×2; E066 Furnace Colossus ×1.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: L115 – Worldforge Antechamber is Gated until any 3 other listed Forge/Magma Locations have been revealed. quests.rewards: 225 XP; 225 Gold; draw 1 Epic Equipment Card; gain LT171 Worldforge Master Key.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Complete WE011 required path. Record Worldforge Access Secured. Reduce Instability by 1 if E066 is defeated by end of Round 7.
quests.locationConsistency: Pre-finale boss/objective scenario and culmination of forge-machine mechanics.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: use 3 Forge Nodes; reveal E066 + E063 only. 2 Heroes: printed. 3 Heroes: add 1 E061 at reveal. 4 Heroes: add 1 E062 at reveal and first destroyed Node also spawns 1 E061.
quests.balanceNotes: Four one-Action Nodes create objective tax without reproducing Q024's exact Ward structure.

quests.name: Ironhaven Holds
quests.story: Before descending after Kharvek, the Heroes can spend precious time securing Ironhaven's failing districts. The High Forge, Liftworks, and Clan Ward are all threatened by collapse as the city shakes itself apart.
quests.locationPool: Include L089 High Forge; L090 Liftworks; L092 Rune Chapel; L093 Clan Ward; L094 Stonegate Pass.
quests.enemyDeck: E053 Ashen Compact Saboteur ×3; E059 Ashen Compact Shieldbearer ×2; E063 Heartstone Adept ×2.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Place Crisis Tokens at High Forge, Liftworks, and Clan Ward. Place Crisis Track at 0.
quests.questRules: CRISIS: At end of each Enemy Phase increase Crisis by 1. At 2, 4, and 6 place/spawn: E053 at an unresolved facility, then E059, then E063. SAVE FACILITY: A Hero at a Crisis Token may spend 1 Action to save it if no Enemy is there. Remove the token and record the facility saved. Quest ends when 2 facilities are saved or Crisis reaches 7.
quests.winningConditions: Save at least 2 of the 3 facilities.
quests.losingConditions: Crisis reaches 7 before 2 facilities are saved; all Heroes are Defeated.
quests.rewards: 150 XP; 150 Gold; +1 General Reputation; record each saved facility.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Each saved facility grants a Q036 aid: High Forge — remove 1 E062 from finale setup; Liftworks — Heroes begin Q035 with the first Heartshaft movement cost ignored; Clan Ward — each Hero gains 1 Common Healing Potion before Q036.
quests.locationConsistency: Optional finale-prep quest; mirrors Campaign II district choice while using Ironhaven-specific services.
quests.enemyConsistency: Uses existing Campaign III humanoid/forge enemies.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: choose 2 facilities and must save 1; Crisis limit 7. 2 Heroes: printed. 3 Heroes: first Crisis spawn adds 1 E053. 4 Heroes: second Crisis spawn adds 1 E059.
quests.balanceNotes: Only 2 of 3 are required, preserving meaningful choice.

quests.name: The Heartshaft
quests.story: Kharvek descends through the forbidden Heartshaft while the Worldforge tears the mountain open around him. The Heroes must follow through broken lifts, molten bridges, and Heartstone galleries before the core seals behind him.
quests.locationPool: Include L116 Heartshaft; L117 Broken Foundry; L118 Ancient Lift; L119 Heartstone Gallery; L120 Crucible Bridge; L121 Core Approach; L122 Worldforge Core; L123 Heart Chamber Threshold.
quests.enemyDeck: E058 Deep Road Stalker ×3; E061 Magma Whelp ×3; E062 Forge Golem ×2; E063 Heartstone Adept ×2; E064 Ashen Compact Captain ×2.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Place Descent Track at 0. L122 is Gated until any 4 Heartshaft/Forge Locations have been revealed. L123 is Gated until L122 is reached.
quests.questRules: DESCENT: At end of each Enemy Phase increase Descent by 1. At 2, 4, and 6 the farthest revealed Location behind the leading Hero becomes Unstable after all Heroes leave; entering it thereafter costs +1 Action. If Descent reaches 8 before L123 is revealed, fail. PURSUIT: first time each new Location is entered with no Enemy there, roll 1d6: 1–2 spawn E058; 3–4 no effect; 5 E061; 6 E064. If LT169 is held, the first Pursuit spawn is ignored. If LT171 is held, L122 may be revealed after only 3 qualifying Locations.
quests.winningConditions: Reach L123 – Heart Chamber Threshold and defeat all enemies there.
quests.losingConditions: All Heroes are Defeated; Descent reaches 8 before L123 is revealed.
quests.rewards: 250 XP; 250 Gold; draw 1 Epic Equipment Card.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Unlock Q036. If Descent is 5 or less when L123 is cleared, record Fast Descent; Q036 begins with one fewer non-Boss enemy.
quests.locationConsistency: Final gauntlet. Pressure comes from movement/timing, not random campaign loss.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: Descent advances every other Enemy Phase; L123 guard E064 ×1. 2 Heroes: printed pursuit. 3 Heroes: first Pursuit spawn that occurs adds 1 E058. 4 Heroes: first two Pursuit spawns add 1 E058; L123 guard also includes 1 E062.
quests.balanceNotes: Target reveal timing is Descent 4–7 for 2–4 Heroes.

quests.name: Heart of the Mountain
quests.story: At the Mountain Heart, Kharvek binds himself to the Worldforge. Stone, metal, and flesh fuse around him as the Heart wakes. The Heroes must break the Mountain Wards, defeat the Forge-Lord, and decide whether the Heart will be sealed, harmonized, or shattered.
quests.locationPool: Include L121 Core Approach; L122 Worldforge Core; L123 Heart Chamber Threshold; L124 Mountain Heart Chamber.
quests.enemyDeck: E067 Kharvek Durn, Forge-Lord ×1; E068 Heartforged King ×1; E062 Forge Golem ×2; E063 Heartstone Adept ×2; E064 Ashen Compact Captain ×2.
quests.startingEnemiesTokens: Place 3 Mountain Ward Tokens at L124, each with 2 Health and 0 Armor. Place E067, E063 ×1, and E062 ×1. E068 begins out of play. Apply Instability and all recorded Campaign III finale aids before Round 1. If LT170 is held, one Ward begins with 1 damage. If Fast Descent is recorded, remove one non-Boss enemy from setup.
quests.questRules: MOUNTAIN WARDS: E067/E068 cannot be reduced below half printed Health while any Ward remains. A Hero in L124 may spend 1 Action to damage a Ward for 1. PHASE I — FORGE-LORD: when E067 reaches 14 Health or fewer after an effect resolves, remove E067 and place E068 at full Health. Remaining Wards stay. PHASE II — HEARTFORGED KING: first time E068 reaches 18 Health or fewer, immediately activate it once after the current effect. PHASE III — HEART'S CHOICE: E068 cannot be finally defeated while any Ward remains. When the last Ward is destroyed, choose and record Seal, Harmonize, or Shatter the Mountain Heart after E068 is defeated. FINAL INSTABILITY: at 0–2 remove 1 non-Boss enemy; at 3–5 printed setup; at 6–7 add 1 E064; at 8 add 1 E062 and 1 E064. Heartstone Harmonized cancels one added enemy.
quests.winningConditions: Destroy all Mountain Wards, defeat E068 Heartforged King, and resolve the Mountain Heart choice.
quests.rewards: 350 XP to each Hero; 1 Legendary Equipment Card per Hero; +3 General Reputation; gain LT172 Heartwarden Sigil; unlock Heartwardens of Ironhaven; complete Campaign III.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Campaign III Victory. Record final Instability, saved Ironhaven facilities, Emberdeep Alliance, Heartstone Harmonized, Kharvek's fate, and Mountain Heart choice as World State.
quests.locationConsistency: Campaign III finale combines persistent Stability, optional aid, objective Actions, two boss phases, and a final world-state decision.
quests.enemyConsistency: Uses E062-E064 and dedicated bosses E067/E068.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: use 2 Mountain Wards; setup E067 + E063 only. 2 Heroes: printed. 3 Heroes: add 1 E064. 4 Heroes: add 1 E062; E068 transition also spawns 1 E063.
quests.balanceNotes: Target 4–8 rounds. High Instability must be harder but still beatable; completionist aids must not trivialize E068.

quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: use 2 Nodes; setup E069 + E070. 2 Heroes: printed. 3 Heroes: add 1 E069. 4 Heroes: add 1 E071.
quests.balanceNotes: Action-tax tutorial; should remain forgiving at Blight 2.

quests.rewards: 225 XP; 200 Gold; +1 Eldergrove Circle Reputation.

quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: 2 Path Markers. 2 Heroes printed. 3 Heroes add E078 at L150. 4 Heroes add E080 at L152.

quests.rewards: 175 XP; 150 Gold; gain LT176 Heartseed Ward; +1 Spirit Court Reputation.
quests.campaignFollowOn: Record Free Spirits Allied. During Q045 cancel first Bound Spirit reinforcement; during Q048 one Bloom Root begins with 1 damage.
quests.locationConsistency: Optional spirit liberation / finale aid.
quests.heroCountScaling: 1 Hero: 2 Totems. 2 Heroes printed. 3 Heroes add E083. 4 Heroes add E080 + E083.

quests.locationPool: Include L158 Spore Cavern; L159 Bloom Gate; L160 Hollow Rootheart; L161 Hollow Bloom Core.
