worldEvents.Story: Scattered goblin tribes have begun raiding farms, caravans, and isolated villages across the frontier. Refugees crowd the roads while local lords struggle to defend their lands. What first appeared to be random attacks now shows signs of careful coordination. The kingdom needs heroes before these raids become an invasion.
worldEvents.Campaign_Effects: Enemies with the Goblin trait gain +1 Movement during their first activation each round. Heroes may only purchase Common Equipment between quests. Add +1 to all Travel Encounter rolls.
worldEvents.Available_Quests:
Q001 - Defend Stonebrook (Main)
Q002 - Rescue the Merchant Caravan (Main)
Q003 -  Clear the Abandoned Watchtower (Optional)
worldEvents.Advance_Condition: Players may advance to WE002 – Goblin Warbands when Q001 and Q002 are completed or 5 campaign days have happened.
worldEvents.Campaign_Rewards: If all three quests are completed: each Hero gains 50 XP; gain +1 Party Morale; remove one Goblin Scout from Q004.
worldEvents.Campaign_Penalties: If only the two required quests are completed: no additional effect. If fewer than two quests are completed: add one Goblin Raider to the first encounter of Q004 and lose 1 General Reputation.
worldEvents.Design_Notes: Opening campaign chapter. Focuses on fast Goblin raids, travel pressure, and limited purchasing.

worldEvents.Story: The scattered raids have evolved into organized warbands. Goblin clans now march beneath a single banner, establishing fortified camps throughout the frontier. Patrols roam the roads, supply lines are disrupted, and rumors spread of a powerful warlord uniting the tribes. If the warbands are not broken now, the kingdom will soon face a full-scale siege.
worldEvents.Campaign_Effects: Leader enemies gain +1 Health. During Travel Encounters, replace one normal Goblin enemy with an Elite Goblin whenever possible. Equipment prices increase by 25%. Goblin Camps discovered during quests remain on the campaign map until destroyed.
worldEvents.Available_Quests:
Q004 - Into the Dark Forest (Main)
Q005 - Destroy the War Camp (Main)
Q006 - Prisoners of the Horde (Optional)
worldEvents.Advance_Condition: Players may advance to WE003 – Siege of Stonebrook when Q004 and Q005 are completed or 6 campaign days have happened.
worldEvents.Campaign_Rewards: If all three quests are completed: each Hero gains 75 XP; draw 1 Rare Equipment Card for the party; remove 1 Elite Goblin from Q007; gain +1 General Reputation.
worldEvents.Campaign_Penalties: If only the two required quests are completed: no additional effect. If fewer than two quests are completed: add 1 Elite Goblin to the first encounter of Q007; increase Travel Encounter rolls by +1 during WE003; lose 1 Reputation.
worldEvents.World_Event_Modifier: replace one normal Goblin with an Elite whenever possible
worldEvents.Design_Notes: Mid-campaign escalation. Focuses on territory control, camps, patrols, leaders, and elite Goblins.

worldEvents.Story: The goblin warbands have united into a single invading force. Siege engines roll across the countryside while fires consume nearby farms. Stonebrook, the last fortified settlement protecting the frontier, now stands under siege. If the village falls, nothing remains to stop the Goblin King's army from sweeping across the kingdom.
worldEvents.Campaign_Effects: Siege Engines may appear in quests and Travel Encounters. Enemies with the Archer trait gain +1 Attack. Heroes begin each quest with 1 fewer Supply. Buildings can be Damaged; Damaged buildings cannot provide their normal benefits until repaired after the World Event.
worldEvents.Available_Quests:
Q007 - Burn the Supply Lines (Main)
Q008 - Break the Siege (Main)
Q009 -  Rescue Captain Roland (Optional)
worldEvents.Advance_Condition: Players may advance to WE004 – The Goblin King when Q007 and Q008 are completed or 6 campaign days have happened.
worldEvents.Campaign_Rewards: If all three quests are completed: each Hero gains 100 XP; gain 1 Epic Equipment Card; gain +2 Reputation; remove 1 Siege Engine from Q010; restore all Damaged Buildings before WE004.
worldEvents.Campaign_Penalties: If only the two required quests are completed: begin WE004 with 1 Damaged Building of your choice. If fewer than two quests are completed: add 1 Siege Engine to Q010; each Hero begins Q010 with 1 Wound Token; lose 2 Reputation; Stonebrook cannot be used to purchase Equipment before WE004.
worldEvents.World_Event_Modifier: add siege/pressure effects as printed
worldEvents.Design_Notes: Siege chapter. Focuses on protecting structures, supplies, civilians, and surviving under pressure.

worldEvents.Story: After months of battle, the heroes have shattered the goblin warbands and broken the siege of Stonebrook. The surviving goblins have retreated to their mountain stronghold, where the Goblin King prepares one final stand. Hidden deep within the fortress lies the throne from which he united the tribes. Defeat him, and the invasion will collapse. Fail, and the frontier will burn.
worldEvents.Campaign_Effects: The Goblin King and all Boss enemies gain their full printed abilities. Elite enemies may not be removed or replaced during this World Event. Heroes may not Retreat from quests during WE004. Random Travel Encounters no longer occur.
worldEvents.Available_Quests:
Q0010 - Assault the Fortress Gate (Main)
Q0011 - Through the Stronghold (Main)
Q0012 - The Goblin King (Final Quest)
worldEvents.Advance_Condition: There is no further World Event. The campaign ends when Q012 is completed or the party is defeated.
worldEvents.Campaign_Rewards: Campaign Victory: unlock Defenders of Stonebrook and record the campaign as Victory. Q012 provides the final Quest's XP, Equipment, and Reputation rewards; do not award those rewards a second time from WE004.
worldEvents.Campaign_Penalties: If the party fails Q012: campaign ends in Defeat; record Stonebrook Falls; no Campaign Victory rewards are gained.
worldEvents.World_Event_Modifier: no random Travel Encounters.
worldEvents.Design_Notes: Final campaign chapter. Q012 is the single source of tangible final-Quest rewards; WE004 records Campaign Victory and its unlock only. No retreat, no travel pressure, and no additional chapter after the final boss.

worldEvents.Story: Caravans vanish on the eastern road and a string of ritual murders spreads fear through Valewatch. Witnesses describe smooth white masks and a black-wax crown seal, but city officials insist the crimes are unrelated. The Heroes are asked to find the missing, stop the killings, and discover who is coordinating the violence.
worldEvents.Campaign_Effects: CURFEW: Valewatch is under curfew. During the first Travel Encounter in an Urban Location each Quest, if the Encounter produces enemies, add 1 E033 Street Cutthroat unless a Quest says otherwise. Crown Watch services remain available between Quests. Completing Q015 grants Witness Testimony for WE006.
worldEvents.Available_Quests:
Q013 - The Missing Caravan (Main)
Q014 - Blood in the Alleys (Main)
Q015 - The Silent Witness (Optional)
worldEvents.Advance_Condition: Players may advance to WE006 – The Hidden Hand when Q013 and Q014 are completed or 5 Campaign Days have elapsed.
worldEvents.Campaign_Rewards: If all three Quests are completed: each Hero gains 50 XP; gain +1 Reputation with the Crown Watch; record Witness Testimony. If only the two required Quests are completed: no additional effect.
worldEvents.Campaign_Penalties: If fewer than two required Quests are completed when time expires: begin WE006 with Suspicion 1; add 1 E035 Masked Acolyte to the first scripted combat of Q016; lose 1 General Reputation.
worldEvents.World_Event_Modifier: Curfew — first enemy-producing Urban Travel Encounter each Quest adds 1 E033 Street Cutthroat.
worldEvents.Design_Notes: Campaign II opening chapter. Mystery and street-level danger should dominate; the Quiet Crown is not fully revealed until Q014/Q015.

worldEvents.Story: The murders point toward a conspiracy reaching into noble houses, guilds, temples, and the city watch. No single faction is responsible. The same hidden organization has infiltrated all of them, using wealth, fear, and blackmail to search for something beneath Valewatch.
worldEvents.Campaign_Effects: SUSPICION: The Quiet Crown is actively hunting the Heroes. The first time each Quest a Hero gains an Evidence, Ledger, or Suspect objective, place 1 Suspicion marker. At 3 Suspicion, spawn 1 E036 Veiled Agent at the nearest legal unrevealed/reinforcement entry point when the Quest next calls for enemies. Q015's Witness Testimony removes the first Suspicion marker that would be placed each Quest.
worldEvents.Available_Quests:
Q016 - Masks at Midnight (Main)
Q017 - Beneath the Guildhall (Optional)
Q018 - The Broken Seal (Main)
worldEvents.Advance_Condition: Players may advance to WE007 – Beneath Valewatch when Q016 and Q018 are completed or 6 Campaign Days have elapsed.
worldEvents.Campaign_Rewards: If all three Quests are completed: each Hero gains 75 XP; gain +1 General Reputation; record Quiet Crown Supply Network Destroyed; during Q021, cancel the first enemy spawn caused by destroying a Ritual Focus.
worldEvents.Campaign_Penalties: If only the two required Quests are completed: no additional effect. If fewer than two are completed: Q019 begins with 1 additional E040 Gravebound Soldier and the first Underground Encounter in WE007 gains +1 Severity.
worldEvents.World_Event_Modifier: Suspicion — objective discoveries can call Veiled Agents; Witness Testimony mitigates the first marker each Quest.
worldEvents.Design_Notes: Political/infiltration chapter. Every major faction contains both allies and compromised members; avoid framing any entire faction as secretly evil.

worldEvents.Story: The Quiet Crown has opened passages into the buried city beneath Valewatch. Ancient dead stir in sealed avenues and forgotten crypts while cultists search for the throne complex of a ruler erased from history. The Heroes must descend, learn what was buried, and stop the ritual before the thing beneath the city can claim a new host.
worldEvents.Campaign_Effects: STIRRING DEAD: During Travel Encounters at Underground, Crypt, Catacomb, Ancient, or Buried City Locations, add +1 to a rolled Encounter Severity. Fixed Severity Encounters remain fixed. Undead enemies treat Difficult Terrain as normal terrain unless a specific effect says otherwise.
worldEvents.Available_Quests:
Q019 - The Forgotten City (Main)
Q020 - Tomb of the First King (Optional)
Q021 - The Black Cathedral (Main)
worldEvents.Advance_Condition: Players may advance to WE008 – The Veiled Sovereign when Q019 and Q021 are completed or 6 Campaign Days have elapsed.
worldEvents.Campaign_Rewards: If all three Quests are completed: each Hero gains 100 XP; gain +1 Reputation with the Archive of Seven; record Royal Seal Recovered. The Royal Seal disables one Crown Ward at the start of Q024.
worldEvents.Campaign_Penalties: If only the two required Quests are completed: no additional effect. If fewer than two are completed when time expires: begin Q023 with 1 additional E045 Veilspawn and Q024 begins with 1 additional Crown Ward.
worldEvents.World_Event_Modifier: +1 rolled Encounter Severity in Underground/Crypt/Ancient/Buried City Locations; Fixed Severity is unchanged.
worldEvents.Design_Notes: Exploration/horror chapter. Reveals that the Veiled Crown itself is the recurring Sovereign and that the modern city was built over a deliberately buried predecessor.

worldEvents.Story: Valewatch fractures as the Quiet Crown's plan reaches its final stage. Chancellor Severin Hale is taken below and forced into the Veiled Crown. Cultists, corrupted guards, and things from the buried city rise through the streets while the Heroes choose whether to protect the city or pursue the ritual before the Crown fully awakens.
worldEvents.Campaign_Effects: FINAL CRISIS: Random Travel Encounters no longer occur. Scripted Quest Encounters resolve normally. Elite Cult, Undead, and Veil enemies gain +1 Health. The party may not voluntarily Retreat from Q024. Districts saved during Q022 remain protected for the rest of the Campaign.
worldEvents.Available_Quests:
Q022 - The City Falls (Optional)
Q023 - The Descent (Main)
Q024 - The Veiled Sovereign (Final Quest)
worldEvents.Advance_Condition: There is no further World Event. Campaign II ends when Q024 is completed or the Campaign reaches a specific Defeat result.
worldEvents.Campaign_Rewards: Campaign Victory: unlock Wardens of Valewatch and record Campaign II Victory. Q024 is the single source of the finale's XP, Equipment, and Reputation rewards; do not award them again from WE008.
worldEvents.Campaign_Penalties: If Q024 is failed and its Quest text declares final Campaign defeat: record Valewatch Fallen. Saved districts and surviving factions remain part of World State for future Campaign use unless the failure text says otherwise.
worldEvents.World_Event_Modifier: No random Travel Encounters; Elite Cult/Undead/Veil enemies +1 Health; no voluntary Retreat from Q024.
worldEvents.Design_Notes: Final Campaign II chapter. Q022 is a meaningful optional rescue choice; Q023 is the gauntlet; Q024 is a multi-stage boss with prior Campaign accomplishments affecting the finale.

worldEvents.Story: A violent tremor tears through Ironhaven, collapsing mine galleries and severing lift routes beneath the city. Forge Council officials call it a natural disaster, but Delver surveyors report patterned pulses moving through the stone. The Heroes must rescue trapped workers, reopen safe routes, and discover why ancient mechanisms below Ironhaven have begun to wake.
worldEvents.Campaign_Effects: MOUNTAIN STABILITY: Campaign III begins at Instability 2. Apply the current Stability tier at the start of each Quest. Stable 0–2: no global penalty. Fractured 3–5: the first Cave-In or structural Hazard each Quest gains +1 Severity/effect. Critical 6–7: in addition, the first scripted non-Boss Construct or Deep Creature group placed each Quest gains +1 Health per enemy. Instability cannot exceed 8. Q025–Q027 may raise or lower it as printed.
worldEvents.Available_Quests:
Q025 - The First Collapse (Main)
Q026 - Lost Below (Optional)
Q027 - The Ember Relay (Main)
worldEvents.Advance_Condition: Players may advance to WE010 – The Broken Deeps when Q025 and Q027 are completed or 5 Campaign Days have elapsed.
worldEvents.Campaign_Rewards: If all three Quests are completed: each Hero gains 75 XP; gain +1 Deepdelver Guild Reputation; reduce Instability by 1 (minimum 0); record Survey Network Restored. If only Q025 and Q027 are completed: no additional reward.
worldEvents.Campaign_Penalties: If fewer than two required Quests are completed when time expires: increase Instability by 1; record Liftworks Damaged; Q028 begins with one additional blocked-route token.
worldEvents.World_Event_Modifier: Mountain Stability — begin Campaign III at Instability 2; current tier modifies structural hazards and high-Instability enemy pressure.
worldEvents.Design_Notes: Campaign III opening chapter. Rescue and route recovery come first; the Ashen Compact should be revealed as an organized force only during Q027.

worldEvents.Story: Beyond the Deep Gate, the ancestral roads are failing. Whole spans have split away into black chasms, ancient clan halls stand abandoned, and Ashen Compact work crews have begun restoring a second Worldforge relay far below Ironhaven.
worldEvents.Campaign_Effects: DEEP ROAD FRACTURES: At the start of each Quest, if Instability is 3–5 place 1 Fracture Token on the first Deep Road/Bridge Location revealed; at 6–7 place 2 Fracture Tokens on different eligible Locations. A Fracture Token adds +1 Action to enter or leave that Location and may be cleared for 1 Action. If Survey Network Restored is recorded, ignore the first Fracture Token placed each Quest.
worldEvents.Available_Quests:
Q028 - Road of the Ancestors (Main)
Q029 - The Last Clan Hall (Optional)
Q030 - The Chain Relay (Main)
worldEvents.Advance_Condition: Players may advance to WE011 – Furnace Below when Q028 and Q030 are completed or 6 Campaign Days have elapsed.
worldEvents.Campaign_Rewards: If all three Quests are completed: each Hero gains 100 XP; gain +1 Stone-Singer Circle Reputation; reduce Instability by 1; record Emberdeep Alliance.
worldEvents.Campaign_Penalties: If only the two required Quests are completed: no additional reward. If fewer than two required Quests are completed when time expires: increase Instability by 1; Q031 begins with 1 additional E062 Forge Golem.
worldEvents.World_Event_Modifier: Deep Road Fractures — Instability creates persistent route taxes; Survey Network Restored cancels the first Fracture each Quest.
worldEvents.Design_Notes: Exploration and clan-history chapter. The Ashen Compact becomes an open enemy, but Kharvek's larger plan remains only partly visible.

worldEvents.Story: The second relay points to an industrial complex far beneath the clan halls. Ancient furnaces relight one by one, constructs assemble themselves without smiths, and the Mountain Heart begins pushing heat and sound through the stone like blood through arteries.
worldEvents.Campaign_Effects: FORGE HEAT: The first time each Round a Hero enters a Forge or Magma Location, if Instability is 3–5 that Hero suffers 1 damage unless Guarded; at 6–7 the Hero suffers 1 unavoidable damage instead. Heartstone Regulator or Stone-Singer support may suppress specific Quest heat effects as printed.
worldEvents.Available_Quests:
Q031 - Into the Foundry (Main)
Q032 - Songs in the Stone (Optional)
Q033 - The Worldforge Wakes (Main)
worldEvents.Advance_Condition: Players may advance to WE012 – Heart of the Mountain when Q031 and Q033 are completed or 6 Campaign Days have elapsed.
worldEvents.Campaign_Rewards: If all three Quests are completed: each Hero gains 125 XP; gain +1 Ironhaven Forge Council Reputation; reduce Instability by 1; record Heartstone Harmonized.
worldEvents.Campaign_Penalties: If only the two required Quests are completed: no additional reward. If fewer than two required Quests are completed when time expires: increase Instability by 1; Q035 begins with 1 additional E063 Heartstone Adept.
worldEvents.World_Event_Modifier: Forge Heat — entering Forge/Magma terrain becomes increasingly dangerous as Instability rises.
worldEvents.Design_Notes: Campaign III escalation chapter. The Worldforge should feel like an operating ancient machine rather than ordinary ruins.

worldEvents.Story: Ironhaven shakes continuously as the Worldforge reaches full power. Kharvek descends through the Heartshaft toward the Mountain Heart while the city above begins to fracture. The Heroes must choose how much time to spend stabilizing Ironhaven before following him into the core.
worldEvents.Campaign_Effects: FINAL DESCENT: Random Ironspine Travel Encounters no longer occur in L122–L124. Scripted Quest encounters resolve normally. The party may not voluntarily Retreat from Q036. Final Instability and recorded Campaign III aids alter Q035/Q036 setup as printed.
worldEvents.Available_Quests:
Q034 - Ironhaven Holds (Optional)
Q035 - The Heartshaft (Main)
Q036 - Heart of the Mountain (Final Quest)
worldEvents.Advance_Condition: There is no further World Event. Campaign III ends when Q036 is completed or its final Defeat condition is reached.
worldEvents.Campaign_Rewards: Campaign Victory: each Hero gains the Q036 rewards; unlock Heartwardens of Ironhaven; record final Instability, surviving factions/NPCs, repaired facilities, Kharvek's fate, and Mountain Heart outcome. Do not duplicate Q036 tangible rewards here.
worldEvents.Campaign_Penalties: If Q036 ends in Campaign Defeat, record Ironhaven Broken. Surviving NPCs/factions and any stabilized facilities remain part of World State unless Q036 says otherwise.
worldEvents.World_Event_Modifier: Final Descent — no random Encounters in the Worldforge Core / Mountain Heart; no voluntary Retreat from Q036; finale setup uses accumulated Campaign III state.
worldEvents.Design_Notes: Final Campaign III chapter. Q034 is optional preparation, Q035 is the descent gauntlet, and Q036 is a multi-stage Kharvek/Mountain Heart finale.

worldEvents.Story: Leaves brown overnight across the Verdant Reach. Animals flee toward Eldergrove, herbalists vanish on familiar roads, and whole groves stop responding to druidic rites. The Heroes are sent beyond the Briar Gate to find the source before the sickness reaches the city.
worldEvents.Campaign_Effects: BLIGHT: Campaign IV begins at Blight 2. Verdant 0–2: no global penalty. Withering 3–5: first Blight/Poison/Spore Hazard each Quest gains +1 effect. Blighted 6–7: additionally, first scripted non-Boss Blighted/Plant/Spirit group gains +1 Health per enemy. Blight cannot exceed 8.
worldEvents.Available_Quests:
Q037 - The Sickened Grove (Main)
Q038 - The Missing Herbalist (Optional)
Q039 - Blightheart Den (Main)
worldEvents.Advance_Condition: Advance to WE014 when Q037 and Q039 are completed or 5 Campaign Days have elapsed.
worldEvents.Campaign_Rewards: If all three Quests are completed: each Hero gains 100 XP; +1 Lantern Apothecary Reputation; reduce Blight by 1; record First Cure Distilled.
worldEvents.Campaign_Penalties: If fewer than two required Quests are completed when time expires: increase Blight by 1; record Briar Gate Withered; Q040 begins with one extra Blight Patch.
worldEvents.World_Event_Modifier: Blight 0–8 modifies hazards and the first eligible corrupted group each Quest.
worldEvents.Design_Notes: Campaign IV opening. Establish disease, corrupted wildlife, and evidence that the spread is being cultivated.

worldEvents.Story: The blight follows old rootways toward forgotten spirit circles. Rootwarden scouts find Thorned Circle markers carved into trees and learn that Maelor Briarheart has been binding corrupted spirits into a network that carries the Hollow Bloom farther with every death.
worldEvents.Campaign_Effects: ROOT NETWORK: At start of each Quest, if Blight 3–5 place 1 Blight Patch on first Forest/Grove Location revealed; at 6–7 place 2 on different eligible Locations. A Hero at a Blight Patch may spend 1 Action to cleanse it if no Enemy is there. Locations with a Blight Patch suppress the first 1 Health that would be recovered there each Round.
worldEvents.Available_Quests:
Q040 - The Rotting Road (Main)
Q041 - Circle of Ash (Optional)
Q042 - The Thornmother (Main)
worldEvents.Advance_Condition: Advance to WE015 when Q040 and Q042 are completed or 6 Campaign Days have elapsed.
worldEvents.Campaign_Rewards: If all three Quests are completed: each Hero gains 125 XP; +1 Rootwarden Reputation; reduce Blight by 1; record Spirit Anchors Restored.
worldEvents.Campaign_Penalties: If fewer than two required Quests are completed when time expires: increase Blight by 1; Q043 begins with 1 additional E080 Hollow Warden.
worldEvents.World_Event_Modifier: Root Network — Blight Patches suppress healing and tax Actions until cleansed.
worldEvents.Design_Notes: Faction/revelation chapter. Thorned Circle becomes explicit antagonist network; Maelor remains physically absent.

worldEvents.Story: Beyond the restored circles lies a forest no map agrees on. Trees grow inward, dead spirits speak through flowers, and roots move beneath the ground like hunting animals. The Heroes enter the Hollow Grove to sever the Bloom's oldest feeding roots.
worldEvents.Campaign_Effects: HOLLOW PRESSURE: In Ancient Forest/Spirit/Hollow Locations, first time each Round a Hero gains a beneficial Status while Blight is 6–7, roll 1d6; on 1–2 remove that Status immediately after it resolves. Heartseed Ward can cancel one such loss per Round when available.
worldEvents.Available_Quests:
Q043 - Into the Hollow (Main)
Q044 - Spirits Unbound (Optional)
Q045 - The Green Cathedral (Main)
worldEvents.Advance_Condition: Advance to WE016 when Q043 and Q045 are completed or 6 Campaign Days have elapsed.
worldEvents.Campaign_Rewards: If all three Quests are completed: each Hero gains 150 XP; +1 Eldergrove Circle Reputation; reduce Blight by 1; record Heartseed Covenant Restored.
worldEvents.Campaign_Penalties: If fewer than two required Quests are completed when time expires: increase Blight by 1; Q047 begins with one additional E082 Briar Colossus.
worldEvents.World_Event_Modifier: Hollow Pressure — high Blight can consume beneficial statuses in ancient corrupted spaces.
worldEvents.Design_Notes: Exploration/horror chapter revealing the Hollow Bloom's age and partial intelligence.

worldEvents.Story: The Hollow Bloom erupts across the Reach. Thorned Circle cells attack Eldergrove, corrupted spirits tear open rootways, and Maelor enters the oldest grove to become the Bloom's living voice. The Heroes must choose what to save before pursuing him.
worldEvents.Campaign_Effects: FINAL WITHERING: Random regional Travel Encounters no longer occur in L159–L161. The party may not voluntarily Retreat from Q048. Final Blight, saved Eldergrove sites, spirit alliances, and Campaign IV Quest Items alter Q047/Q048 setup.
worldEvents.Available_Quests:
Q046 - Eldergrove Besieged (Optional)
Q047 - The Briar Path (Main)
Q048 - The Hollow Bloom (Final Quest)
worldEvents.Advance_Condition: Campaign IV ends when Q048 is completed or its final Defeat condition is reached.
worldEvents.Campaign_Rewards: Campaign Victory: resolve Q048 rewards; unlock Wardens of the Verdant Reach; record final Blight, Eldergrove sites saved, spirit alliances, Maelor's fate, and Hollow Bloom outcome. Do not duplicate Q048 tangible rewards.
worldEvents.Campaign_Penalties: If Q048 ends in Campaign Defeat, record Verdant Reach Withered. Surviving factions and protected sites persist as World State.
worldEvents.World_Event_Modifier: No random Encounters in final Hollow/Bloom locations; no voluntary Retreat from Q048; finale uses accumulated campaign state.
worldEvents.Design_Notes: Final chapter. Q046 is optional defense, Q047 pursuit, Q048 two-stage Maelor/Hollow Bloom finale.

worldEvents.Story: Ashenport wakes to black seawater flooding cellars and drowned sailors climbing onto the docks. The Harbor Council seals the inner gates while Tidewardens report that every corpse is walking toward the old bells beneath the bay.
worldEvents.Campaign_Effects: DOOMTIDE: Campaign V begins at 2. Low Tide 0–2: no global penalty. Rising 3–5: first Flood/Current/Storm Hazard each Quest gains +1 effect. Tempest 6–7: additionally, first scripted non-Boss Drowned/Sea group gains +1 Health per enemy. Doomtide cannot exceed 8; at 8 use Quest-specific Black Tide crisis.
worldEvents.Available_Quests:
Q049 - Harbor of Black Water (Main)
Q050 - The Lost Convoy (Optional)
Q051 - Bells Beneath the Bay (Main)
worldEvents.Advance_Condition: Advance to WE018 when Q049 and Q051 are completed or 5 Campaign Days have elapsed.
worldEvents.Campaign_Rewards: If all three Quests are completed: each Hero gains 125 XP; +1 Ashenport Admiralty Reputation; reduce Doomtide by 1; record Harbor Channels Secured.
worldEvents.Campaign_Penalties: If fewer than two required Quests are completed when time expires: increase Doomtide by 1; record Stormgate Flooded; Q052 begins with one additional Flood Marker.
worldEvents.World_Event_Modifier: Doomtide 0–8 modifies sea hazards and high-tide Drowned pressure.
worldEvents.Design_Notes: Campaign V opening. Ashenport is immediately threatened, but the deeper intelligence behind the tide is only hinted at.

worldEvents.Story: The bells beneath Ashenport ring without ropes. Ghost ships drift against the wind and a submerged cathedral appears at low tide where no chart records land. The Drowned Choir is calling the coast toward the sea.
worldEvents.Campaign_Effects: FLOODED ROUTES: At Doomtide 3–5 place 1 Flood Marker on the first Coast/Dock/Cavern route revealed each Quest; at 6–7 place 2 on different eligible Locations. Entering or leaving a Flooded Location costs +1 Action. A Hero there may spend 1 Action to clear a Flood Marker if no Enemy is present.
worldEvents.Available_Quests:
Q052 - Breakwater Watch (Main)
Q053 - The Ghost Fleet (Optional)
Q054 - Cathedral Below (Main)
worldEvents.Advance_Condition: Advance to WE019 when Q052 and Q054 are completed or 6 Campaign Days have elapsed.
worldEvents.Campaign_Rewards: If all three Quests are completed: each Hero gains 150 XP; +1 Beacon Order Reputation; reduce Doomtide by 1; record Drowned Choir Silenced.
worldEvents.Campaign_Penalties: If fewer than two required Quests are completed when time expires: increase Doomtide by 1; Q055 begins with one additional E104 Tempest Herald.
worldEvents.World_Event_Modifier: Flooded Routes tax movement until cleared; Tideglass/Beacon aids can negate specific markers.
worldEvents.Design_Notes: Submerged-ritual chapter. The Drowned Choir becomes a named enemy and Serik Vane's involvement is confirmed.

worldEvents.Story: A permanent storm forms over the Shattered Deep. Lightning reveals chains thicker than ships descending into the sea, and every broken link causes the storm to scream. Serik Vane is binding something beneath the waves.
worldEvents.Campaign_Effects: TEMPEST PRESSURE: At Doomtide 3–5 the first Storm Hazard each Round gains +1 printed effect. At 6–7, first time each Round a Hero enters an exposed Coast/Sea Location, roll 1d6; on 1–2 suffer 1 damage unless Guarded. Beacon Lens may suppress one such roll per Round.
worldEvents.Available_Quests:
Q055 - Into the Maelstrom (Main)
Q056 - Beacon in the Deep (Optional)
Q057 - Leviathan Chains (Main)
worldEvents.Advance_Condition: Advance to WE020 when Q055 and Q057 are completed or 6 Campaign Days have elapsed.
worldEvents.Campaign_Rewards: If all three Quests are completed: each Hero gains 175 XP; +1 Tidewarden Reputation; reduce Doomtide by 1; record Beacon Network Restored.
worldEvents.Campaign_Penalties: If fewer than two required Quests are completed when time expires: increase Doomtide by 1; Q059 begins with one additional E103 Chainwarden Golem.
worldEvents.World_Event_Modifier: Tempest Pressure makes exposed routes dangerous while preserving tactical counterplay.
worldEvents.Design_Notes: Deep-water expedition chapter. The Leviathan Heart is revealed as the power Serik intends to control.

worldEvents.Story: The sea rises over Ashenport's seawall as the storm tears open the Shattered Deep. Serik descends into the drowned palace below the coast while black water pours through the streets. The Heroes must decide what to save before following him.
worldEvents.Campaign_Effects: FINAL TIDE: Random Storm Coast Travel Encounters no longer occur in L196–L198. The party may not voluntarily Retreat from Q060. Final Doomtide, saved Ashenport sites, Beacon Network, and Campaign V Quest Items alter Q059/Q060 setup.
worldEvents.Available_Quests:
Q058 - Ashenport at High Tide (Optional)
Q059 - The Shattered Deep (Main)
Q060 - The Drowned Tide (Final Quest)
worldEvents.Advance_Condition: Campaign V ends when Q060 is completed or its final Defeat condition is reached.
worldEvents.Campaign_Rewards: Campaign Victory: resolve Q060 rewards; unlock Stormwardens of Ashenport; record final Doomtide, saved sites/factions, Serik's fate, and Leviathan Heart outcome. Do not duplicate Q060 tangible rewards.
worldEvents.Campaign_Penalties: If Q060 ends in Campaign Defeat, record Ashenport Drowned. Surviving sites/factions remain part of World State.
worldEvents.World_Event_Modifier: No random Encounters in final Drowned Palace/Leviathan locations; no voluntary Retreat from Q060.
worldEvents.Design_Notes: Final Campaign V chapter. Q058 is optional defense, Q059 the abyssal descent, Q060 a two-phase Serik/Leviathan finale.

worldEvents.Story: At noon, the sun dims over Sunspire and ash begins falling from a clear sky. Caravans vanish on roads they have crossed for generations, while buried obelisks ignite beneath the dunes.
worldEvents.Campaign_Effects: SUNFALL: Campaign VI begins at 2. Dawn 0–2: no global penalty. Scorched 3–5: first Heat/Mirage/Solar Hazard each Quest gains +1 effect. Eclipse 6–7: additionally, first scripted non-Boss Solar/Construct/Undead group gains +1 Health per enemy. Sunfall cannot exceed 8; at 8 use Quest-specific Black Sun crisis.
worldEvents.Available_Quests:
Q061 - The Burning Road (Main)
Q062 - Caravan of Glass (Optional)
Q063 - Tomb Beneath the Dunes (Main)
worldEvents.Advance_Condition: Advance to WE022 when Q061 and Q063 are completed or 5 Campaign Days have elapsed.
worldEvents.Campaign_Rewards: If all three Quests are completed: each Hero gains 150 XP; +1 Dune Wardens Reputation; reduce Sunfall by 1; record Eastern Roads Secured.
worldEvents.Campaign_Penalties: If fewer than two required Quests are completed when time expires: increase Sunfall by 1; record Caravan Gate Lost; Q064 begins with one additional Mirage Marker.
worldEvents.World_Event_Modifier: Sunfall 0–8 modifies desert hazards and Eclipse enemy pressure.
worldEvents.Design_Notes: Campaign VI opening. The false eclipse is revealed as deliberate rather than natural.

worldEvents.Story: Recovered inscriptions identify the source of the eclipse: the lost Crown of the Solar Dynasty. Its shards are being pulled from tombs and ruins by servants of Prince Aurelian Sol, last heir to an empire erased from history.
worldEvents.Campaign_Effects: MIRAGE ROUTES: At Sunfall 3–5 place 1 Mirage Marker on the first Desert/Ruin route revealed each Quest; at 6–7 place 2 on different eligible Locations. Entering a Mirage Location costs +1 Action the first time each Round unless a Hero spends 1 Action there to Dispel the marker.
worldEvents.Available_Quests:
Q064 - The Crownshard Vault (Main)
Q065 - Oasis of Echoes (Optional)
Q066 - Palace of Noon (Main)
worldEvents.Advance_Condition: Advance to WE023 when Q064 and Q066 are completed or 6 Campaign Days have elapsed.
worldEvents.Campaign_Rewards: If all three Quests are completed: each Hero gains 175 XP; +1 Sunspire Concord Reputation; reduce Sunfall by 1; record Oasis Covenant Restored.
worldEvents.Campaign_Penalties: If fewer than two required Quests are completed when time expires: increase Sunfall by 1; Q067 begins with one additional E117 Sunforged Golem.
worldEvents.World_Event_Modifier: Mirage Routes create action pressure; wayglass and oasis aids can suppress them.
worldEvents.Design_Notes: Relic/faction chapter. Aurelian's intent to restore the Crown becomes explicit.

worldEvents.Story: The eclipse stops moving. Sunforge mirrors turn toward the darkened sky and a column of black-gold fire rises over the desert. The Crown is almost whole, and the old solar engines are waking with it.
worldEvents.Campaign_Effects: ECLIPSE PRESSURE: At Sunfall 3–5 the first Heat/Solar Hazard each Round gains +1 printed effect. At 6–7, first time each Round a Hero recovers Health in a Desert/Solar Location, reduce that recovery by 1, minimum 0. First Dawn Prism can cancel one such reduction per Round.
worldEvents.Available_Quests:
Q067 - The Sunforge (Main)
Q068 - The Last Dawn (Optional)
Q069 - Black Sun Gate (Main)
worldEvents.Advance_Condition: Advance to WE024 when Q067 and Q069 are completed or 6 Campaign Days have elapsed.
worldEvents.Campaign_Rewards: If all three Quests are completed: each Hero gains 200 XP; +1 Order of First Dawn Reputation; reduce Sunfall by 1; record Dawn Beacon Restored.
worldEvents.Campaign_Penalties: If fewer than two required Quests are completed when time expires: increase Sunfall by 1; Q071 begins with one additional E122 Black Sun Knight.
worldEvents.World_Event_Modifier: Eclipse Pressure suppresses recovery and intensifies solar hazards at high Sunfall.
worldEvents.Design_Notes: Endgame escalation. The party learns the Crown can pull a fragment of the sun into the world.

worldEvents.Story: The Black Sun hangs directly above Sunspire. Aurelian ascends the ancient solar road as the city's mirrors crack and the desert begins glowing at night. The Heroes must choose what to save before following him to the Crown.
worldEvents.Campaign_Effects: FINAL ECLIPSE: Random Sunscar Travel Encounters no longer occur in L233–L235. The party may not voluntarily Retreat from Q072. Final Sunfall, saved Sunspire sites, Dawn Beacon, and Campaign VI Quest Items alter Q071/Q072 setup.
worldEvents.Available_Quests:
Q070 - Sunspire Under Eclipse (Optional)
Q071 - Road to Zenith (Main)
Q072 - Crown of the Fallen Sun (Final Quest)

statuses.Name: Poisoned
statuses.Effect: Suffer 1 damage at the start of your activation.
statuses.Removal: Antidote, Purifying Herbs, or another effect removes Poisoned.

statuses.Name: Burning
statuses.Effect: Suffer 1 damage at the end of your activation.
statuses.Removal: Burn Salve, water-related effect, or another effect removes Burning.

statuses.Name: Bleeding
statuses.Effect: Suffer 1 damage each time you perform an Attack.
statuses.Removal: Rest, Bandage Roll, Herbal Poultice, or another effect removes Bleeding.

statuses.Name: Stunned
statuses.Effect: Immediately end your activation if currently activating. You cannot perform Actions or activate.
statuses.Duration: Until the end of your next activation.
statuses.Removal: Expires automatically or another effect removes Stunned.

statuses.Name: Rooted
statuses.Effect: You cannot voluntarily Move. Other Actions are unaffected.

statuses.Name: Slowed
statuses.Effect: Lose 1 Action during your activation, minimum 1 Action.

statuses.Name: Weakened
statuses.Effect: Your Attack is reduced by 1.
statuses.Removal: Restorative Tonic or another effect removes Weakened.

statuses.Name: Vulnerable
statuses.Effect: Your Armor is reduced by 1, minimum 0.

statuses.Name: Guarded
statuses.Effect: Gain +1 Armor.
statuses.Removal: Another effect removes Guarded or its source ends.

statuses.Name: Inspired
statuses.Effect: Gain +1 Attack.
statuses.Removal: Another effect removes Inspired or its source ends.

statuses.Name: Hidden
statuses.Effect: You cannot be targeted by attacks unless the attacker is in your Location or another rule specifically allows it.
statuses.Duration: Until you Attack or another effect removes Hidden.
statuses.Removal: Attack or another effect removes Hidden.

statuses.Name: Regenerating
statuses.Effect: Recover 1 Health at the start of your activation.

statuses.Name: Exhausted
statuses.Effect: You cannot benefit from abilities that grant additional Actions.
statuses.Duration: Until the end of your next activation.

statuses.Name: Flying
statuses.Effect: Ignore terrain restrictions and may cross obstacles as allowed by Scenario rules.
statuses.Removal: Only another effect can remove Flying.

statuses.Name: Ethereal
statuses.Effect: You may move through units and terrain that would normally block movement, subject to card text.
statuses.Duration: As specified by the granting effect.
statuses.Removal: As specified by the granting effect.

statuses.Name: Knocked Down
statuses.Effect: Your first Action on your turn must be spent to Stand. While Knocked Down, you cannot voluntarily Move.
statuses.Removal: Spend 1 Action to Stand or another effect removes it.

statuses.Name: Grappled
statuses.Effect: You cannot voluntarily Move away from the source of Grappled.
statuses.Duration: Until the source leaves, is Defeated, or the effect is removed.
statuses.Removal: Defeat/leave source or another effect removes Grappled.

statuses.Name: Restrained
statuses.Effect: You cannot Move and your Attack is reduced by 1.

statuses.Name: Disarmed
statuses.Effect: You cannot use your equipped Weapon's Attack bonus or Weapon abilities.
statuses.Duration: Until the end of your next turn.
statuses.Removal: Expires automatically or another effect restores the Weapon.

statuses.Name: Crippled
statuses.Effect: Your Move Action costs 1 additional Action.

statuses.Name: Dazed
statuses.Effect: The next Action you perform costs 1 additional Action.
statuses.Duration: Until triggered or end of turn.
statuses.Removal: Removed after the increased cost is paid or at end of turn.

statuses.Name: Silenced
statuses.Effect: You cannot use abilities with the Arcane, Spell, Prayer, or Chant keyword.

statuses.Name: Blinded
statuses.Effect: You cannot target enemies outside your current Location.

statuses.Name: Marked
statuses.Effect: The source of Marked gains +1 Attack when attacking you.
statuses.Duration: Until the source's next turn ends.
statuses.Removal: Expires automatically or source leaves play.

statuses.Name: Taunted
statuses.Effect: If able, your next Attack must target the unit that applied Taunted.
statuses.Duration: Until you make an Attack or source leaves play.
statuses.Removal: Attack the source or another effect removes Taunted.

statuses.Name: Frightened
statuses.Effect: You cannot voluntarily Move closer to the source of Frightened.
statuses.Duration: Until the end of your next turn.
statuses.Removal: Expires automatically or another effect removes Frightened.

statuses.Name: Confused
statuses.Effect: At the start of your turn, roll 1d6. On 1-2, lose 1 Action; on 3-6, no effect.

statuses.Name: Charmed
statuses.Effect: You cannot target the source with Attacks or harmful abilities.
statuses.Duration: Until source is Defeated or effect ends.
statuses.Removal: Defeat source, source leaves play, or another effect removes Charmed.

statuses.Name: Panicked
statuses.Effect: Your first voluntary Action must be Move away from the nearest hostile unit if legal.
statuses.Duration: Until the end of your next turn.

statuses.Name: Shaken
statuses.Effect: Your first Attack each round suffers -1 Attack.
statuses.Removal: Rest or another effect removes Shaken.

statuses.Name: Pinned
statuses.Effect: You cannot voluntarily Move from your Location while a hostile Ranged enemy with line of effect remains able to attack you.
statuses.Duration: Until that condition is no longer true.
statuses.Removal: Break line of effect, defeat source, or another effect removes Pinned.

statuses.Name: Suppressed
statuses.Effect: You cannot gain free Move or free Attack Actions.
statuses.Duration: Until the end of the round.

statuses.Name: Staggered
statuses.Effect: Your next Attack suffers -1 Attack.

statuses.Name: Cracked Armor
statuses.Effect: Your Armor is reduced by 1.
statuses.Removal: Repair effect or another effect removes Cracked Armor.

statuses.Name: Corroded
statuses.Effect: Your Armor is reduced by 1 and cannot be increased above its printed value.
statuses.Removal: Cleaning, repair, or another effect removes Corroded.

statuses.Name: Wet
statuses.Effect: You cannot gain Burning. Lightning effects against you deal +1 damage if their text checks Wet.
statuses.Duration: Until end of round or removed.
statuses.Removal: Expires at end of round or another effect removes Wet.

statuses.Name: Chilled
statuses.Effect: Your first Move each turn costs 1 additional Action.
statuses.Duration: Until end of your next turn.
statuses.Removal: Expires automatically or another effect removes Chilled.

statuses.Name: Frozen
statuses.Effect: You cannot Move or perform free Move effects.
statuses.Duration: Until end of your next activation.
statuses.Removal: Expires automatically or a Fire effect removes Frozen.

statuses.Name: Shocked
statuses.Effect: The next time you would gain an additional Action, do not gain it.
statuses.Duration: Until triggered or end of round.
statuses.Removal: Removed when it prevents an Action gain or at end of round.

statuses.Name: Electrified
statuses.Effect: The next time you become Wet or take Lightning damage, suffer 1 additional damage.
statuses.Duration: Until triggered or end of round.
statuses.Removal: Removed when triggered or at end of round.

statuses.Name: Scorched
statuses.Effect: You recover 1 less Health from the next recovery effect that affects you, minimum 0.
statuses.Removal: Removed after reducing one recovery effect.

statuses.Name: Cursed
statuses.Effect: You cannot remove other harmful Conditions unless the removing effect also removes Cursed or says it ignores Cursed.

statuses.Name: Hexed
statuses.Effect: The first die you roll each turn is rolled twice; use the lower result.

statuses.Name: Mana Burn
statuses.Effect: When you play a card with an Arcane keyword, suffer 1 damage.
statuses.Removal: Rest or another effect removes Mana Burn.

statuses.Name: Withered
statuses.Effect: You cannot recover more than 1 Health from a single effect.

statuses.Name: Diseased
statuses.Effect: Recovery effects restore 1 less Health, minimum 0.

statuses.Name: Infected
statuses.Effect: At the end of each Scenario, if still Infected, suffer the Campaign penalty specified by the source.

statuses.Name: Fortified
statuses.Effect: Gain +1 Armor against the first Attack that damages you each round.
statuses.Removal: Source ends or another effect removes Fortified.

statuses.Name: Protected
statuses.Effect: Reduce the next damage you suffer by 1, then remove Protected.

statuses.Name: Barrier
statuses.Effect: Prevent the next 2 damage you would suffer, then remove Barrier.

statuses.Name: Ward
statuses.Effect: Ignore the next harmful Condition that would be applied to you, then remove Ward.
statuses.Removal: Removed when it prevents a Condition.

statuses.Name: Blessed
statuses.Effect: Your first Attack each round gains +1 Attack.
statuses.Removal: Source ends or another effect removes Blessed.

statuses.Name: Consecrated
statuses.Effect: You cannot gain Cursed or Hexed.
statuses.Removal: Leave source or another effect removes it.

statuses.Name: Empowered
statuses.Effect: Your next Attack gains +2 Attack.

statuses.Name: Focused
statuses.Effect: Ignore the next -1 Attack penalty applied to you, then remove Focused.
statuses.Removal: Removed after preventing one Attack penalty.

statuses.Name: Hasted
statuses.Effect: Gain 1 additional Action at the start of your turn.
statuses.Duration: Until end of your next turn.

statuses.Name: Quickened
statuses.Effect: Your next Move Action costs 0 Actions.
statuses.Duration: Until triggered or end of turn.
statuses.Removal: Removed after Move or at end of turn.

statuses.Name: Unstoppable
statuses.Effect: Ignore the next Rooted, Knocked Down, Grappled, or Restrained effect applied to you, then remove Unstoppable.
statuses.Removal: Removed when it prevents one listed Condition.

statuses.Name: Steadfast
statuses.Effect: You cannot gain Frightened, Panicked, or Shaken.
statuses.Removal: Source ends or another effect removes Steadfast.

statuses.Name: Resolute
statuses.Effect: The first time you would be reduced to 0 Health, remain at 1 Health instead, then remove Resolute.

statuses.Name: Vigilant
statuses.Effect: The first enemy that enters your Location each round satisfies enemy-entry Reaction triggers you possess.

statuses.Name: Prepared
statuses.Effect: The next Interact, Explore, or Rest Action you perform costs 0 Actions.
statuses.Duration: Until triggered or end of turn.
statuses.Removal: Removed after use or at end of turn.

statuses.Name: Camouflaged
statuses.Effect: Ranged enemies outside your Location cannot target you.
statuses.Duration: Until you Attack, enter a Settlement, or effect removes it.
statuses.Removal: Attack, enter Settlement, or another effect removes Camouflaged.

statuses.Name: Entrenched
statuses.Effect: While you remain in your current Location, gain +1 Armor.

statuses.Name: Elevated
statuses.Effect: Your Ranged Attacks gain +1 Range if their normal Range is at least 1 connected Location.

statuses.Name: Regrouped
statuses.Effect: The next time you Rest, recover 1 additional Health and draw 1 Hero card.

statuses.Name: Rallied
statuses.Effect: If an allied Hero shares your Location, gain +1 Attack on your first Attack each turn.
statuses.Removal: Source ends or no ally shares your Location.

statuses.Name: Linked
statuses.Effect: Choose another Hero at your Location. Once per round when either linked Hero gains Guarded or Inspired, the other gains the same Condition.

statuses.Name: Shielded
statuses.Effect: Gain +2 Armor against the next Attack that targets you, then remove Shielded.
statuses.Removal: Removed after next Attack against you.

statuses.Name: Braced
statuses.Effect: If an enemy Moves into your Location, your next Attack against that enemy this round gains +1 Attack.
statuses.Duration: Until triggered or end of round.
statuses.Removal: Removed after use or at end of round.

statuses.Name: Berserk
statuses.Effect: Gain +2 Attack, but your Armor is reduced by 1, minimum 0.

statuses.Name: Frenzied
statuses.Effect: After you Defeat an enemy, your next Attack this turn gains +1 Attack.
statuses.Duration: Until triggered or end of turn.
statuses.Removal: Removed after next Attack or at end of turn.

statuses.Name: Bloodthirsty
statuses.Effect: The first time each turn you Defeat an enemy, recover 1 Health.

statuses.Name: Aegis
statuses.Effect: Allied Heroes at your Location gain +1 Armor against the first Attack that damages them each round.

statuses.Name: Radiant
statuses.Effect: Your Attacks against Corrupted or Undead targets deal +1 damage after Armor.

statuses.Name: Arcane Shield
statuses.Effect: Reduce the next Arcane, Fire, Cold, or Lightning damage you suffer by 2, then remove Arcane Shield.

statuses.Name: Fireproof
statuses.Effect: You cannot gain Burning and reduce Fire damage you suffer by 1.

statuses.Name: Coldproof
statuses.Effect: You cannot gain Chilled or Frozen.

statuses.Name: Shockproof
statuses.Effect: You cannot gain Shocked or Electrified.

statuses.Name: Venomproof
statuses.Effect: You cannot gain Poisoned.

statuses.Name: True Sight
statuses.Effect: Ignore Hidden and Camouflaged when determining valid targets.

statuses.Name: Surefooted
statuses.Effect: Ignore Difficult Terrain and the first additional Move Action required by a terrain-based movement effect each turn.

statuses.Name: Fleet
statuses.Effect: After your first Move Action each turn, you may Move one additional connected Location if not Engaged.

statuses.Name: Evasive
statuses.Effect: The first Ranged Attack against you each round deals 1 less damage, minimum 0.

statuses.Name: Countering
statuses.Effect: The first time each round an enemy damages you with a melee Attack, your next Attack against it gains +1 Attack.

statuses.Name: Overwatch
statuses.Effect: You are prepared to use Reaction Attacks against hostile units that Move into valid range when another rule grants such a Reaction.

statuses.Name: Channeling
statuses.Effect: Your next Arcane card or ability costs 1 fewer Action, minimum 0.
statuses.Duration: Until triggered or end of turn.
statuses.Removal: Removed after use or at end of turn.

statuses.Name: Sanctified
statuses.Effect: When you gain a harmful Condition, roll 1d6. On a 6, ignore it.

statuses.Name: Alerted
statuses.Effect: Use aggressive/combat behavior instead of passive or patrol behavior.
statuses.Duration: Until no hostile Hero is revealed or Scenario states otherwise.
statuses.Removal: Scenario or behavior effect removes Alerted.

statuses.Name: Patrolling
statuses.Effect: Follow patrol route or Scenario movement instead of pursuing Heroes.
statuses.Duration: Until Alerted or Scenario changes state.

statuses.Name: Guarding
statuses.Effect: Remain within Guard Area and prioritize threats to the protected target.
statuses.Duration: Until protected target is gone or behavior changes.

statuses.Name: Enraged
statuses.Effect: Gain +1 Attack and prioritize the nearest Hero.
statuses.Duration: Until end of encounter or source says otherwise.

statuses.Name: Retreating
statuses.Effect: Prioritize moving toward the designated safe Location and avoid Attacks unless blocked.
statuses.Duration: Until reaching safety or behavior changes.

statuses.Name: Summoned
statuses.Effect: This unit was created by another effect and follows the source's removal rules.

statuses.Name: Objective Carrier
statuses.Effect: This unit is carrying a Quest Objective. Effects referencing the Objective Carrier apply to it.
statuses.Duration: Until objective is dropped, delivered, or removed.

statuses.Name: Escorting
statuses.Effect: This unit is linked to an Escort objective and follows the Quest or Scenario escort rules.

statuses.Name: Tracked
statuses.Effect: Effects that reference Tracked targets may locate or target this unit regardless of normal tracking restrictions.

statuses.Name: Favored
statuses.Effect: A faction considers this Hero or party favored. Campaign effects may unlock benefits tied to Favored.

statuses.Name: Cursed Item
statuses.Effect: The affected Equipment cannot be voluntarily unequipped unless a rule specifically allows it.

statuses.Name: Broken
statuses.Effect: The affected Equipment provides no abilities or stat bonuses.

statuses.Name: Exposed
statuses.Effect: The next Attack made against you gains +1 Attack. Then remove Exposed.
statuses.Removal: Removed after the next Attack against you resolves or another effect removes Exposed.

statuses.Name: Stealth
statuses.Effect: Stealth has no inherent targeting or combat effect by itself. Cards that reference Stealth provide its benefits. Lose Stealth when an effect says to lose or reveal it.
statuses.Duration: Until removed by a card or effect.
statuses.Removal: A card/effect removes Stealth; resolving an Attack removes it only when that card says so.

keywords.Definition: If a card directly contradicts this reference, the card takes precedence.
If an effect states a figure cannot do something, that restriction overrides an effect that would allow it.
The active Hero resolves their simultaneous effects in the order they choose; Enemy effects resolve in Scenario/AI order.
If no duration is listed, the effect resolves immediately and ends.
Different effects stack unless stated otherwise. Multiple copies of the same named effect do not stack unless specifically allowed.
Deal damage to a target using a weapon, skill, or ability.
The standard attack printed on a Hero or Enemy card; unless otherwise stated it targets one enemy and grants no additional effects.
A primary activity during a Hero turn.
A card played outside your turn when its trigger occurs; it does not use an Action unless stated.
A card or ability that may be played without using an Action.
Reduce the next instance of damage you would take by 2, then remove Guard; does not stack unless stated.
Melee targeting beyond normal current-Location range as defined by the card; current system uses Location connections, not grid spaces.
Forced movement moves a figure to a legal connected revealed Location in the indicated direction/context; forced movement ignores Engagement unless stated.
Cannot be Pushed, Pulled, or otherwise forcibly moved.
Lose 1 Health at the specified trigger; final timing should follow System 008 once reconciled.
Ongoing Fire damage until removed/extinguished; final timing should follow System 008 once reconciled.
Cannot recover Health until removed, unless the final System 008 definition supersedes this entry.
-1 Attack.
Cannot perform an Action/activation as specified by the finalized Condition rules.
Cannot voluntarily Move; may perform other Actions.
Cannot be targeted by attacks unless attacker is in same Location or another rule allows it; removed by attacking or specified effects.
+1 Attack until removed unless a card states another duration.
Fighter resource; maximum 3. Earned/spent as specified by Fighter cards.
Cleric resource concept from earlier rules; Sister Elara's current deck primarily uses Consecrated/Inspired rather than explicit Faith costs.
Wizard cards gain their listed Arcane bonus while Vaelis occupies an Arcane Location.
A magical Location created by Wizard abilities. It has no inherent effect; Arcane cards gain listed bonuses while the Hero occupies one.
A blessed Location created by Cleric abilities. It has no inherent effect; cards referencing Consecrated gain listed bonuses.
High Health front-line combatant.
Long-range attacker with lower durability.
Fast enemy that targets isolated Heroes.
Manipulates terrain, conditions, or Hero positioning.
High movement with charge-style attacks.
Heals or enhances allies.
Creates additional enemies or battlefield objects.
Powerful non-boss enemy with unique abilities.
Major enemy with multiple abilities and higher durability.
Protect a unit until it reaches its destination.
Prevent enemies from occupying an objective for the required duration.
Move all surviving Heroes to the designated exit.
Remain alive until the specified round or event.
The equipped Weapon's Attack Bonus added to the Hero's Attack Value.
Reduces incoming damage. Damage = Attack − Armor.
Roll 1d6 + Weapon + modifiers. Attacks automatically hit.
A random travel challenge resolved by drawing from the Encounter Deck and rolling Encounter Severity.
Roll 1d6 plus current World Event modifiers, then resolve the drawn Encounter card's 1–2, 3–4, 5–6, or 7+ result.
The deck of random travel encounters used between or during quests when a rule instructs Heroes to resolve a Travel Encounter.
Spend 1 Action to draw and resolve the top valid card of the Exploration Deck while occupying a revealed Location, unless another effect changes the cost.
The deck used whenever a Hero Explores. Exploration cards may provide discoveries, opportunities, hazards, encounters, NPCs, story effects, or rewards.
An Exploration card is valid if its Terrain is Any, Any Outdoor, or matches the current Location's Terrain, Traits, Keywords, or Location Type. Invalid cards are discarded and another card is drawn.
An Explore instructed by a card, ability, Quest, or other effect without an Action cost resolves without spending an Action.
The deck of tangible items gained from Exploration, Encounters, Quests, enemies, and other rewards. Gold is tracked separately.
A Loot card used for a one-time effect. After its effect resolves, discard it unless the card states otherwise.
A tag describing thematic sources for Loot, such as Goblin, Forest, Cave, Settlement, or Quest. Effects may request Loot with a specific Drop Tag.
A formula listing the Materials, Tool, Craft Time, Gold Cost, Result, and unlock requirement needed to create an item.
A progression requirement from Tier I through Tier V that limits access to more advanced recipes.
The Forge, Workbench, Alchemy Kit, Enchanting Table, or other facility required to perform a recipe.
A special crafting facility required by certain Tier V recipes. Possessing LT155 Eternal Forge Ember may also be required.
A standardized game state listed in the Status Effects database and identified by SE###.
A negative Status generally removed by recovery, cure, movement, or control-breaking effects.
A positive Status that improves offense, defense, recovery, movement, or utility.
A rules state used for movement forms, AI behavior, Equipment state, Quest state, or Campaign tracking.
A Hero Standard Action that normally costs 1 Action and moves the Hero to one adjacent connected revealed Location. Specific effects may grant a Move Action without spending an Action.

Leaving this Location voluntarily requires 1 additional unit of movement. A Hero must use 2 Move Actions to leave instead of 1; the first is spent overcoming the terrain and the second completes the move. An Enemy spends 1 additional Movement to leave. Forced Movement ignores this unless stated otherwise.
The next Attack against the affected Enemy gains +1 Attack; then remove Exposed.
A Hero-specific state with no inherent effect; cards that reference Stealth define its benefits and removal.
